job.title: Account Manager, Client Success
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Client Success Account Manager to support our advertising team!

Why it matters: In this role, you will join the Client Success team, leading post-sale account management for new and existing growth accounts, delivering best-in-class, turnkey client experiences from kickoff to wrap. This role requires a competent level of expertise, including the ability to apply skills independently in common situations, understand the broader business context, and contribute effectively with occasional support. A revenue mindset is key, as you will help drive client retention, identify growth opportunities, and support media planning efforts to maximize long-term value for both the client and Axios.

Go deeper: This role will serve as a trusted partner to many clients who are new to Axios, ensuring they feel confident and supported from day one. The ideal candidate will have the ability to quickly learn and articulate how Axios’ products work, guiding clients and agency partners through each stage of the post-sale process. They will work closely with stakeholders, providing clear communication, proactive solutions, and a high-touch service experience every step of the way.

Working closely with multiple cross-functional teams (Client Partnerships, Smart Brevity Studio, Events, Brand Journalism, and Ad Operations), you will develop and execute a wide range of campaigns across the Axios product suite. You’ll also work with your Client Partnerships colleagues to support media planning, proposals, and renewal activities.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will possess a growth mindset with a drive to learn, embody an entrepreneurial spirit, and have a passion for the Axios mission. They will also be a team player who operates with integrity, practices radical candor, and fosters a culture of collaboration, kindness, and support for colleagues.

This person should have 1- 2 years of client-facing digital campaign management experience, including planning and execution, while demonstrating the following attributes:

Campaign Management/Customer Service

  • Agile and adaptable in managing multiple campaigns simultaneously while meeting all deadlines and exceeding client expectations.
  • Responsible for building media strategies that support client objectives and campaign goals.
  • Develops a strong understanding of Axios products and effectively positions them to meet client objectives
  • Manages all post-sale campaign elements, including ownership across kick-off calls, production, launch and reporting.
  • Monitors campaign performance and delivery to ensure campaigns are on track to meet client and revenue goals.
  • History of building and maintaining strong relationships and orchestrating effective communication across a myriad of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of client business goals and industry context to inform campaign strategy and recommendations
  • Proactively identifies opportunities for account growth, renewal & upsell.
  • Outstanding communication, organization, and project management skills with obsessive attention to detail.
  • Takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.

Strategic Thinking/Problem-Solving

  • Ability to develop and implement long-term strategies aligned with team and company goals.
  • Capacity to analyze complex situations and foresee potential challenges and opportunities.
  • Proficient in identifying problems and formulating effective solutions independently.
  • Confident in pulling reporting and using analytics to make data-driven campaign optimization recommendations.

Overarching Skills

  • Growth mindset and enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.
  • Initiative to take on responsibilities and drive projects forward with minimal supervision.
  • Flexibility to pivot client marketing strategies in response to changing market conditions or organizational needs.
  • Willingness to embrace new ideas and approaches to enhance efficiency.
  • Proficiency in Google Office Suite (Slides, Sheets, Docs).
  • Prior professional experience in account management, customer support, media planning, digital marketing, ad operations, or business development is a plus.

job.title: Analytics Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster on what matters. As we continue to scale, data plays a critical role in how we drive that mission forward.

Why it matters: As an Analytics Engineer at Axios, you’ll serve as the primary interface for delivering insights to the business. You’ll design and maintain the curated layers of our data platform (Silver and Gold), and also own the dashboards and visualizations that translate those data products into actionable insights. By combining engineering rigor with business context and storytelling, you’ll ensure decision-making is faster, clearer, and aligned with Axios’ mission.

In partnership with data engineers, data scientists, and product managers, you’ll transform raw and complex source data into well-structured data products, certified dashboards, and compelling visualizations that underpin reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Silver and Gold layers of the medallion architecture: define, version, and maintain business metrics and semantic models.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards and visualizations that communicate key insights effectively.
  • Define and enforce best practices for data visualization, storytelling, and stakeholder adoption.
  • Build and maintain data marts and semantic layers that serve multiple domains across Axios.
  • Review and certify dashboards for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to standards.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to ensure Silver layer tables meet business needs.
  • Implement data quality tests, documentation, and lineage tracking to ensure trust in analytics outputs.
  • Serve as a bridge to data science, ensuring feature stores and model outputs are well-documented and reusable.
  • Contribute to the hub-and-spoke model: rotate through responsibilities such as intake, quality assurance, and participation in the analytics hub, while serving as a strategic partner to stakeholders, helping them shape the right questions and identify the decisions their data should inform.

Skills:

  • 2-5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or data visualization roles.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
  • Expertise in BI and visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, etc.).
  • Familiarity with modern data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent).
  • Experience designing and modeling curated datasets, semantic layers or metric stores, and data marts that drive consistent and reliable decisions.
  • Understanding of medallion architecture and data governance best practices.
  • Solid grasp of versioning, testing, and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
  • Strong data storytelling and presentation skills; ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.
  • Comfort working in a hub-and-spoke model, balancing central standards with domain-specific consulting.

What success looks like:

  • Business users rely on analytics engineers for both accurate data models and clear, actionable dashboards.
  • Stakeholders see insights delivered through compelling visualizations that drive decisions.
  • Data engineers know what to build in Silver because requirements are clearly defined upstream.
  • Data scientists can discover and reuse well-documented features and model inputs.
  • Leadership sees fewer instances of unreliable or inconsistent dashboards and more decisions influenced by consistent, well-visualized data.
  • You help establish analytics engineering as the cornerstone of the data-to-decisions lifecycle at Axios.

Why it matters: Associates manage event materials, client-facing documents, and multiple front-of-house and back-of-house tasks on-site at events and in a virtual environment. job.title: Local Advertising Account Executive - Denver
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are building a new category of local revenue generation and are hiring Local Market Builders to help scale Axios Local across key markets.

This is not a traditional Account Executive role. This is a foundational, in-market revenue leader responsible for building Axios’ local advertising business from the ground up.

Why it matters: The Local Market Builder is the face of Axios in their city or region—responsible for developing deep relationships with local business leaders and converting those relationships into long-term advertising partnerships.

This role is critical to unlocking hyperlocal revenue and proving a scalable model for Axios Local expansion.

Go deeper: Local Market Builders are highly entrepreneurial sellers focused on building a book of business through their existing network and local market presence. In this role, you will:

  • Build and own a book of business from day one, leveraging existing relationships with local decision-makers
  • Prospect, pitch, and close new local advertisers (restaurants, healthcare systems, law firms, real estate, financial services, dealerships, and more)
  • Develop repeatable revenue streams through renewals and long-term partnerships
  • Serve as the Axios brand ambassador in-market, attending events, building community presence, and collaborating with editorial teams
  • Create and manage a high-volume pipeline of deals (typical deal size: $5K–$15K)
  • Operate with a founder mindset—owning outcomes, testing approaches, and building momentum in-market

Yes, but: This is not a traditional AE role with inbound leads or established accounts.

  • No house accounts or inherited book — you are expected to bring and build your own
  • Heavy reliance on your existing network to accelerate early revenue
  • In-market presence is essential — this is a relationship-driven role
  • Higher deal volume, shorter cycles, and community-based selling
  • Success is driven by reputation, trust, and consistency, not just pipeline coverage

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody a collaborative spirit, revenue mindset, and passion for the Axios mission. This position requires the following:

  • 5–8+ years in sales, digital media, advertising, or related field
  • Be deeply connected in your market and know how to turn relationships into revenue.
  • Proven ability to build and monetize a book of business
  • Demonstrated success in closing new business and generating revenue from personal network
  • Strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, or business leaders in your market

Core Traits

  • Entrepreneurial and self-starting — comfortable building from zero
  • Highly networked in your local market
  • Strong hunter mentality with a bias toward action
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and longer ramp periods
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder
  • Deep curiosity about local businesses and community dynamics

What Success Looks Like

  • Rapid activation of your existing network into revenue-generating clients
  • Consistent pipeline of new local advertisers
  • Strong renewal rates and repeat business
  • Established presence as a trusted partner in your market

This role is designed for highly motivated, network-driven sellers who want significant upside tied to performance.

  • Competitive base salary + strong variable commission structure
  • Uncapped earnings potential tied to revenue generation
  • Early ramp support (non-recoverable draw)
  • Additional incentives for new logo acquisition and early market traction

This remote position offers a $60,000 annual base salary plus an uncapped commission structure with on-target earnings (OTE) up to $150,000+ designed to reward performance and significant upside potential for top performers. job.title: Local Advertising Account Executive - Miami
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are building a new category of local revenue generation and are hiring Local Market Builders to help scale Axios Local across key markets.

This is not a traditional Account Executive role. This is a foundational, in-market revenue leader responsible for building Axios’ local advertising business from the ground up.

Why it matters: The Local Market Builder is the face of Axios in their city or region—responsible for developing deep relationships with local business leaders and converting those relationships into long-term advertising partnerships.

This role is critical to unlocking hyperlocal revenue and proving a scalable model for Axios Local expansion.

Go deeper: Local Market Builders are highly entrepreneurial sellers focused on building a book of business through their existing network and local market presence. In this role, you will:

  • Build and own a book of business from day one, leveraging existing relationships with local decision-makers
  • Prospect, pitch, and close new local advertisers (restaurants, healthcare systems, law firms, real estate, financial services, dealerships, and more)
  • Develop repeatable revenue streams through renewals and long-term partnerships
  • Serve as the Axios brand ambassador in-market, attending events, building community presence, and collaborating with editorial teams
  • Create and manage a high-volume pipeline of deals (typical deal size: $5K–$15K)
  • Operate with a founder mindset—owning outcomes, testing approaches, and building momentum in-market

Yes, but: This is not a traditional AE role with inbound leads or established accounts.

  • No house accounts or inherited book — you are expected to bring and build your own
  • Heavy reliance on your existing network to accelerate early revenue
  • In-market presence is essential — this is a relationship-driven role
  • Higher deal volume, shorter cycles, and community-based selling
  • Success is driven by reputation, trust, and consistency, not just pipeline coverage

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody a collaborative spirit, revenue mindset, and passion for the Axios mission. This position requires the following:

  • 5–8+ years in sales, digital media, advertising, or related field
  • Be deeply connected in your market and know how to turn relationships into revenue.
  • Proven ability to build and monetize a book of business
  • Demonstrated success in closing new business and generating revenue from personal network
  • Strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, or business leaders in your market

Core Traits

  • Entrepreneurial and self-starting — comfortable building from zero
  • Highly networked in your local market
  • Strong hunter mentality with a bias toward action
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and longer ramp periods
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder
  • Deep curiosity about local businesses and community dynamics

What Success Looks Like

  • Rapid activation of your existing network into revenue-generating clients
  • Consistent pipeline of new local advertisers
  • Strong renewal rates and repeat business
  • Established presence as a trusted partner in your market

This role is designed for highly motivated, network-driven sellers who want significant upside tied to performance.

  • Competitive base salary + strong variable commission structure
  • Uncapped earnings potential tied to revenue generation
  • Early ramp support (non-recoverable draw)
  • Additional incentives for new logo acquisition and early market traction

This remote position offers a $60,000 annual base salary plus an uncapped commission structure with on-target earnings (OTE) up to $150,000+ designed to reward performance and significant upside potential for top performers. We will also provide a guaranteed additional $5,000 per month for the first 4 months of employment.

job.title: Part Time-Temp Reporter, Axios Local
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios Local is hiring reporters and writers near our existing markets in regions across the U.S. to support our growing network of local newsletters.

Why it matters: We’re looking for sharp, fast and curious journalists who can help us deliver smart, essential news and lifestyle coverage that young professionals in our cities care about.

Go deeper: Assignments vary based on market needs, with some opportunities for consistent, ongoing contributions.

  • Write high-impact local news items in Axios’ Smart Brevity style (typically short-form, daily pieces)
  • Jump on timely stories, events and trends
  • Contribute to Axios Local newsletters (we're in 39 cities and counting), plus their websites and social media accounts as needed, often with a daily turnaround

  • Ability to move quickly and hit deadlines
  • Omnivorous curiosity and enthusiasm for reporting & writing about numerous subject areas, from sports to business to dining to development to how we get around
  • Comfort writing in a conversational, reader-first voice
  • Equally comfortable doing original reporting and smart aggregation
  • Experience with newsletters or audience-focused writing
  • Familiarity with our Smart Brevity style (or willingness to learn fast)

job.title: Production Manager, Axios Live (Part-time Temporary)
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. Axios Live brings our journalism to life through dynamic, high-quality live experiences that spark meaningful conversations across business, politics, technology, and culture.

We’re looking for a part-time, temporary Production Manager to join our team, a hands-on technical producer who ensures flawless, high-caliber event execution across Axios’s public and branded experiences.

Why It Matters: This role is central to delivering Axios’s smart, efficient, and creative approach to live events. As Production Manager, Axios Live, you’ll lead technical production and on-site execution for mainstage programs, filmed receptions, and other editorially driven events. You’ll serve as the connective tissue between creative vision and real-world production — translating concepts into precise, high-quality experiences that reflect Axios’s standards of excellence.

Go Deeper: This is a part-time role requiring approximately 15 - 20 hours per week for 8 weeks with the potential to extend the term. The Production Manager will manage technical planning, vendor execution, and on-site operations. This role requires an agile, solutions-oriented producer who thrives in live, fast-paced environments and balances technical precision with editorial sensitivity. Core responsibilities include:

Technical Production & On-Site Execution

  • Lead on-site technical execution for Axios Live events, including audiovisual systems, lighting, staging, livestream, and broadcast operations.
  • Create graphics with Adobe After Effects.
  • Serve as show-caller and stage manager for various Axios Live event products.
  • Coordinate site-specific builds, talent rehearsals, and technical run-throughs.
  • Oversee vendor setup, show cues, asset management, and technical execution to ensure seamless, brand-aligned experiences.
  • Support rapid post-event wrap processes, including media clipping and delivery to editorial and marketing teams.

Vendor & Logistics Management

  • Manage all pre-event logistics, timelines, and technical deliverables across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Coordinate production vendors, venue teams, and freelance technicians to ensure Axios standards are met.
  • Create floor plans in collaboration with the operations team.

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for an experienced, technically skilled producer who embodies a calm, solution-oriented presence and thrives under pressure.

  • 6-8 years of experience in event production, with a focus on A/V systems, livestream, and show execution.
  • Strong understanding of live event and technical workflows, including rigging, lighting, comms, and streaming platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with show-calling, stage management, and backstage coordination.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple events simultaneously while maintaining precision, extreme attention to detail, and quality deliverables.
  • A “can do” and team-centered attitude with a positive approach to quality work.
  • Strong ability to work independently on specific projects.
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments and solving technical issues in real time.
  • Knowledgeable in production documentation (Run of Show , Tech Flows, Shoflo, Asset management)
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Wrike, Airtable)
  • Experience in Adobe products, specifically Adobe Premiere & After Effects.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when required.

Contract details:

  • Target engagement period: 8 weeks with the potential to extend.
  • Compensation:
    • Pre-Production Hourly -$38.50-$44.00/hour (15-20 hours per week)
    • On-Site Flat Rate - $1,500/day (12-hour day)

job.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations.

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

job.title: Senior Associate, Marketing & Growth
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios Live is looking for a strategic, data-driven marketer to lead audience growth and lifecycle marketing for our Essential events portfolio. This role will own the end-to-end attendee journey—from audience acquisition and CRM strategy through registration, engagement, retention and reporting—building scalable marketing programs that grow high-value audiences and deepen long-term engagement across Axios Live.

Why it matters: Axios Live is entering its next phase of growth. As our events portfolio expands, we're evolving from simply driving registrations to intentionally building and nurturing high-quality executive audiences. This role will help shape that transformation by developing lifecycle marketing strategies, strengthening audience segmentation, leveraging paid and owned channels for acquisition, and using data and automation to deliver more personalized experiences that increase audience quality, repeat attendance and long-term loyalty.

What you’ll do: This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, audience development and lifecycle marketing. You'll build and nurture high-value audiences across Axios Live products while leveraging data, automation and paid media to drive measurable growth. You'll serve as the marketing lead for Axios Live local and national events, partnering closely with Editorial, Events, Partnerships, Audience Development and Design to create scalable marketing programs that increase registrations, strengthen audience loyalty and improve lifetime engagement.

Audience Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Own lifecycle marketing strategy across audience acquisition, registration, engagement, retention and repeat attendance for Axios Live Essential events.
  • Build automated, behavior-driven marketing journeys that personalize the attendee experience before, during and after every event.
  • Develop audience nurture programs for key audience segments including newsletter subscribers, previous attendees, sponsors, partners, Axios Pro members and new prospect audiences.
  • Create lifecycle strategies that increase repeat attendance, strengthen audience loyalty and improve long-term audience value.

Audience Acquisition

  • Lead audience acquisition strategy for Axios local and national events.
  • Develop multi-channel marketing campaigns leveraging:
    • Email marketing
    • Paid social
    • Organic social
    • House advertisements
    • Newsletter promotions
    • Partner marketing
    • Referral campaigns
  • Manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn and emerging platforms to efficiently grow registrations and qualified audiences.
  • Continuously optimize acquisition performance through audience targeting, creative testing and conversion analysis.

Email Marketing & CRM

  • Own email marketing strategy and execution for Axios Live Essential events.
  • Develop campaign calendars, messaging strategies and promotional timelines aligned with event objectives.
  • Build targeted audience segments using engagement and behavioral data to improve personalization and conversion.
  • Draft, QA and deploy the complete event email lifecycle including:
    • Invitations
    • Speaker announcements
    • Registration confirmations
    • Reminder campaigns
    • Know Before You Go communications
    • Post-event follow-up
    • Thank-you campaigns
  • Partner with Editorial and Event Leads to develop messaging that reflects Axios' editorial voice while maximizing audience engagement.

Audience Strategy & Segmentation

  • Build and maintain audience profiles across industries, executive functions and geographic markets.
  • Lead audience segmentation efforts to identify high-value audiences and improve campaign targeting.
  • Analyze registration trends, attendance behavior and audience composition to inform future marketing strategies.
  • Develop recommendations that strengthen audience quality, diversity and long-term growth.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Build and maintain centralized marketing dashboards tracking campaign performance across Axios Live events.
  • Monitor registrations, attendance, engagement, conversion and marketing channel performance.
  • Translate data into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Design and execute A/B tests that improve registration conversion, email engagement and audience acquisition performance.
  • Develop recurring reporting that measures marketing effectiveness across campaigns, channels and event portfolios.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Serve as marketing lead for Axios Live essential events.
  • Partner closely with Events, Editorial, Partnerships, Design and Audience Development throughout campaign planning and execution.
  • Lead weekly marketing updates, sharing registration performance, audience insights, campaign priorities and recommendations with internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure audience-first thinking is embedded throughout the event planning process.

The details: The ideal candidate is a strategic marketer with strong analytical instincts who enjoys building audiences, experimenting with new marketing channels and using data to drive growth.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, CRM or event marketing.
  • Experience managing integrated marketing campaigns across email, paid media and owned channels.
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing principles, customer journeys and marketing automation.
  • Experience developing audience segmentation and personalization strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience managing paid social campaigns with a focus on audience acquisition and conversion.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting campaign performance and audience data.
  • Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Exceptional written communication skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Sailthru or similar marketing automation platforms.

job.title: Senior Manager, Experience Optimization
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Senior Manager of Experience Optimization to own the conversion layer of the Axios funnel: the subscription, registration, and paywall experiences where readers become subscribers and subscribers become members.

Why it matters: By continuously improving conversion rates, you'll increase the impact of every growth initiative while helping Axios maximize the value of its investment in subscriptions, paywalls, and audience growth.

Go deeper: In this role, you'll own the registration, subscription, and paywall ecosystem, lead landing page and first-party data capture testing, drive SEO/GEO conversion strategies, and orchestrate personalized onsite experiences to create a seamless journey across web and email. Reporting to the SVP of Audience & Growth, you'll partner across subscriptions, membership, and event marketing to optimize every step of the conversion experience.

Responsibilities:

Subscription, Registration & Paywall Optimization

  • Own the performance and optimization of Axios's subscription, registration, and paywall experiences across national and local products.
  • Lead ongoing experimentation across offers, messaging, templates, and access rules to improve conversion.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for the Piano platform, driving platform capabilities and performance.
  • Establish conversion benchmarks, reporting, and scalable optimization processes across the business.

Conversion Optimization & First-Party Data

  • Design and execute experiments across landing pages, lead generation, and first-party data capture to improve acquisition and conversion.
  • Partner with Audience Insights and Lifecycle Marketing to strengthen first-party data collection and personalization.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized experimentation roadmap, using data and testing to drive continuous improvement.

Search, AI & Onsite Experiences

  • Optimize conversion experiences for SEO, GEO, and AI-driven traffic, partnering with Analytics to measure performance and identify new opportunities.
  • Own onsite audience segmentation and personalization in Segment, ensuring a seamless customer journey across web and email.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Editorial, Revenue, Analytics, Design, and Marketing to deliver high-impact growth initiatives.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders while driving a shared roadmap for onsite experience optimization.
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by documenting learnings, sharing insights, and scaling best practices across the Growth organization.

Skills

  • 6+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization (CRO), growth marketing, growth product, or digital experience optimization.
  • Proven success improving conversion through A/B testing and experimentation.
  • Experience with subscription, membership, or digital media businesses.
  • Hands-on experience with paywall or subscription platforms (Piano preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills, including funnel analysis, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Experience with marketing technology platforms such as Segment, Braze, Sailthru, or similar tools.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

  • Increase subscription and registration conversion rates through continuous experimentation.
  • Establish a scalable testing program with measurable improvements across the conversion funnel.
  • Improve first-party data capture to support personalization and audience growth.
  • Create seamless onsite experiences that work in concert with lifecycle marketing.
  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Editorial, Analytics, Revenue, and Growth to drive measurable business impact.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster on what matters. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help scale the systems that power Axios’ core products.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver news that’s clinical, trustworthy, and informative — reaching millions of readers every day. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help power the services, APIs, and data flows that make our audience-facing products fast, reliable, and scalable. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Software Engineer, you’ll develop high-quality, reliable services in a Golang and Python codebase, ensuring performance and stability across Axios’ publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • API development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable REST APIs to power Axios products.
  • Service reliability: Build and optimize backend services using Golang and Python, ensuring they are resilient, performant, and maintainable.
  • Data modeling: Design and evolve database schemas and performant queries to support new features and business requirements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with front-end engineers, quality engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Testing & quality: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; contribute to Axios’ quality efforts by ensuring backend systems are covered with automated tests.
  • Performance & observability: Monitor system health, contribute to our logging/metrics implementation, and proactively improve performance and scalability.
  • AI fluency: Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or other assistants to accelerate development, improve code quality, and explore creative solutions.
  • Continuous improvement: Participate in code reviews, propose improvements to architecture and practices, and stay up to date with evolving backend technologies.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a thoughtful engineer who cares about reliability, scalability, and writing clean, maintainable code. You should have:

  • Experience: 2–5+ years in backend or full-stack development, with hands-on experience in Golang and/or Python.
  • API expertise: Strong understanding of designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Databases: Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL) and ORMs (e.g., Gin, Django)
  • Testing: Experience with unit and integration testing in Golang and/or Python, and a mindset of embedding quality into development.
  • Performance & scalability: Awareness of common patterns for scaling backend services and optimizing performance.
  • AI tooling: Comfort using tools like GitHub Copilot or Claude Clode as part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally in an agile environment.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar).
  • Experience with gRPC services.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience working with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb).
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing of backend services.

What success looks like:

  • Reliable systems: You build services that are stable, scalable, and meet the needs of Axios’ products and readers.
  • Quality code: You write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that reduces defects and simplifies future development.
  • Collaboration: You work closely with teammates across front-end, product, and QE to deliver features efficiently and effectively.
  • AI-driven efficiency: You integrate AI tools into your workflow to accelerate development, improve code quality, and continuously learn.
  • Performance focus: You monitor and improve backend performance, ensuring services are fast and resilient.
  • Continuous growth: You sharpen your skills, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to improving Axios’ engineering practices.

Work with business leaders to define desired outcomes, success metrics and value drivers for AI initiatives. Mentor technical teams on AI architecture best practices. Vendor-specific certifications such as the Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect or equivalent AWS/GCP architecture credentials are highly valued. Your Role Serving as the leading cybersecurity authority for CBC/Radio-Canada, you will shape the Corporation’s strategic technology road map by aligning security imperatives with business objectives. In this role, you will elevate security from a traditional support function to a core pillar of enterprise architecture that drives tangible business value. Vision and Cross-Functional Leadership Defining the Vision: Lead, define and promote the integration of a unified security architecture vision within Enterprise Architecture (EA), ensuring technical alignment and consistency across all software, platforms and infrastructure. Stakeholder Engagement: Establish clear direction on security roles, responsibilities and priorities, collaborating with key stakeholders to ensure technology investments are secure by design. Strategic Alignment: Partner with Architecture and Strategic Development leadership to shift security architecture from an IT-centric model to one driven by business needs and value. Technical Standardization: Establish secure configuration standards and minimum technical requirements to support the Corporation’s overall compliance framework. Collaboration and Architectural Alignment Architectural Synergy: Work closely with enterprise and solution architects to ensure security requirements are thoroughly understood, integrated and respected across all levels of the organization. Strategic Alignment: Ensure that technological solutions proposed by business units align with the Corporation’s unified, secure technology vision. Strategic Evaluation and Project Compliance Audit and Validation: Conduct rigorous security assessments for large-scale projects, critical applications and new data centre infrastructure. Standards Assurance: Ensure all technology initiatives strictly adhere to the established compliance framework throughout their design and implementation phases. Adjudication: Evaluate and recommend the approval or remediation of solutions based on their alignment with organizational security requirements and technology goals. Advisory, Influence and Industry Engagement Strategic Partnership: Translate complex cyberthreats into clear business risks for senior leadership to drive informed decision-making and justify security budgets. Navigating Organizational Dynamics: Build consensus on major security initiatives and effectively overcome roadblocks across diverse corporate teams. Industry Representation: Represent CBC/Radio-Canada on international committees (such as NABA or EBU) to influence global media technology standards. Innovation and Mentorship Research and Feasibility: Develop business cases for adopting emerging and disruptive technologies (e.g., AI, automation) and perform comprehensive cost-benefit analyses. Talent Development: Mentor architects and analysts within the team, guiding them through complex technical challenges and supporting their professional growth. What You Bring University degree in the field of computer science, IT or information security. Minimum five years’ experience in a security architecture role. 10 or more years’ overall experience in the cybersecurity field. Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Ability to work independently and multitask effectively. Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities. Strong knowledge of and experience with IP networks and security infrastructure (firewalls, routers, switches, access control, etc.). Knowledge of the following: Web infrastructure and application security (OWASP). Network security tools (IDS/IPS, firewalls, etc.). Encryption technologies and concepts. Database architecture concepts. Physical security controls. Disaster recovery concepts. Multifactor authentication concepts. Single sign-on concepts. Zero-trust concepts. Security-by-design concepts. Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Unposting Date: 2026-09-15 11:59 PM News Editor/Presenter (English Services) (On-Site) Your role: CBC Edmonton is looking for an experienced news editor/presenter to lead our weekday morning newscasts for audiences listening live on the radio, and on digital platforms. As a key member of CBC Edmonton’s morning on-air team, you thrive on setting the news agenda for listeners starting their day. You are passionate about providing breaking news to audiences, and injecting their mornings with some joy. You believe in collaborating with colleagues to make material resonate across CBC’s platforms. As the morning newsreader, you will play an integral editorial and leadership role in gathering, preparing and presenting the daily news, keeping our audiences informed about what’s happening now in Edmonton and northern Alberta. In this role, you will work closely with the Edmonton AM current affairs radio programming team coordinating coverage off-air and bringing a high-energy, team-first presence on-air. You effortlessly balance core news delivery with the show’s lively pace and agenda-setting interviews. You’re the kind of journalist who loves the adrenaline rush of chasing breaking news and you’re not intimidated by the prospect of changing lineups and rewriting newscasts under very tight deadlines. You embrace the challenge of keeping your newscasts as up-to-date as possible, chasing stories yourself and adding essential context to build trust, show care for your audience and ensure listeners get the full story. You understand the diverse and changing population in Edmonton and northern Alberta, and the importance of broadening the range of perspectives, experiences and points of view reflected on our programming, especially from people who have been traditionally underrepresented in the media. In your work, you will ensure CBC journalistic standards are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful and immediate. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence. The successful candidate will generally be assigned to work weekdays, 4:30 a.m. to 12:45 p.m., though flexibility to work other days and shift times will be required. We also are hiring an afternoon news presenter, along with several jobs in our Edmonton station and northern Alberta bureaus. You can see them all here . www.cbc.ca/workwithus Your responsibilities: Plan, organize, line up and deliver newscasts and news breaks. Respond quickly to breaking news, collaborating with journalists across platforms to chase, gather, write and package stories to ensure our coverage is as up-to-date as possible. Write and edit scripts; cut audio clips and package stories. Conduct interviews on and off air. Self-operate the studio audio board during live newscasts. Vet scripts written by other journalists, providing feedback to help them develop their skills and produce content of the highest quality. Report live and breaking news on-air, interacting with hosts and program participants to provide news updates, analysis and context to enhance the audience’s understanding of issues. Present news on other platforms (streaming, podcasts, digital, video) as required. Your profile: Demonstrated experience working in live and breaking news in a fast-paced, multiplatform news environment. Ability to generate, pitch and pursue strong, original story ideas. Strong news judgment and a demonstrated ability to react quickly to breaking news and changing priorities, and chase multiple stories at once. Excellent critical thinking skills, including knowledge of the legal and ethical issues related to journalism. Engaging on-air presence, a strong presentation style and an ease with live, on-air work. Ability to present material with credibility and authority in a range of situations including live events and breaking news. Ability to quickly cut audio clips from a variety of audio and video sources. Superior script writing and script editing skills. An understanding of Alberta’s political landscape, economic drivers and demographics, and a strong proven connection to the communities we serve in and around Edmonton and northern Alberta. Your Role At CBC/Radio-Canada, the Technology & Infrastructure Rapid Innovation Pod is an agile, cross-functional unit dedicated to accelerating the co-development of emerging technologies. Our mission is to explore technology pathways critical to our strategic goals and drive knowledge sharing across flagship projects. As a technology leader and seasoned expert, you will spearhead the exploration of emerging technologies through rapid prototyping and proofs of concept (PoCs), ensuring a seamless transition to full implementation. As an influential strategic advisor and active contributor to international working groups, you will shape the organization’s technical future through inspiring mentorship and cutting-edge expertise. Agile Iteration Management: Proactively manage scope creep and resolve technical roadblocks to maximize the value-to-effort ratio during experimentation. Technical Leadership and Oversight: Provide technical guidance within the team, and lead and mentor analysts. Technical Integration and Knowledge Transfer Cross-Departmental Support and Guidance: Act as the primary technical liaison for integrating systems with emerging technology dependencies, offering high-level guidance across departments. Advanced Technical Expertise: Resolve complex technical roadblocks and provide technical evaluations for major initiatives, including target architecture reviews and large-scale RFPs. Knowledge Sharing: Structure, document and disseminate experimental findings and advanced expertise across delivery teams and the broader organization to ensure seamless handoffs. Continuous Improvement Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to refine our rapid experimentation frameworks (Agile) and optimize collaboration tools (Jira/Confluence) to boost team velocity. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in engineering (electrical, software, computer or telecommunications), computer science or IT; a master’s degree or relevant professional certifications considered assets; Membership in the Ordre des ingénieurs du Québec (OIQ) or an equivalent professional body an asset. Ten or more years of proven success in media technologies and digital transformation within complex organizational environments. Strategic vision with a demonstrated ability to anticipate technology trends, lead complex innovation processes and capitalize on disruptive opportunities. Strong curiosity about emerging technologies, combined with initiative and learning agility in a fast-evolving market. Cross-Functional Leadership and Industry Networking: Proven track record of aligning internal teams and external partners around ambitious technology goals. Exceptional strategic communication skills, with a talent for demystifying cutting-edge technical concepts for leadership and non-technical audiences. Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Superior systems analysis and complex problem-solving skills. Cloud-native ecosystems and advanced virtualization strategies for organizational agility (Kubernetes, Ansible, Git, Terraform, RDMA network architectures, AWS, etc.). Generative AI integration and process automation. Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), open-source practices and collaborative methodologies. Ensure compliance with RF exposure limits at transmission sites located across the country (500+ sites) (Safety Code 6 - Health Canada). Perform specialized engineering studies and complex analyses applying the rigour and scientific approach of a professional engineer to meet the emerging needs of our internal partners and of new technologies. Job Opportunity CBC/Radio-Canada is currently looking to fill two permanent Spectrum Engineer positions, based in Toronto or Montreal. Perks you can look forward to: Four weeks vacation. Teleworking: hybrid mode with up to 3 days of teleworking per week. Good compensation package. Opportunities to work with various technologies. Language lessons. Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development. Creative and dynamic work environment where your ideas and contribution are listened to, valued and respected. Supportive leadership team committed to upholding the highest levels of diversity and inclusion. As a new Spectrum Engineer, you will be involved in a wide variety of projects: Complete coverage analyses to optimize the parameters (antenna, transmitter, transmission site, etc.) of radio (AM, FM, HD) and digital televisions stations (CRC-COVLAB). Write technical briefs (radio - television) according to the requirements of ISED's Broadcasting Rules and Procedures (BPR) (python programming). Submit applications to obtain broadcasting certificates and licenses from ISED (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada) and CRTC (Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission). Develop programs or scripts to automate redundant tasks, implement new calculation methods, or speed up the production of engineering reports. Travel to different cities in Canada to perform signal measurements to assess our broadcasting services coverage (extent, intensity, quality). Perform RF exposure analyses (RNI, Safety Code 6 (SC6)) for the general public and workers for CBC/Radio-Canada transmission sites: Simulations of RF exposure levels. Perform RF measurements at transmission sites. Completed SC6 compliance reports. Make recommendations for transmission sites to remain compliant with Canadian safety standards. Perform point-to-point link analyses: Studio-Transmitter Link (Pathloss). Support satellite distribution systems. (C-Band & Ku-Band, LEO, 5G Broadcast, etc.) through analysis, evaluations, or licensing requests. Evaluate different technologies and write comprehensive technical reports (ATSC 3.0, HD radio, LEO, etc.). In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to transform HR data into strategic insights that inform executive decision-making and continuous improvement. You will contribute to process implementation, analyze workforce trends, and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) to maximize the organization impact of our People & Culture initiatives. Your work will directly support CBC/Radio-Canada’s strategic pillars of Proximity, Digital agility, and Bringing people together. This position can be based in Ottawa or Montreal. Main Responsibilities and Impact: 1. Data Analytics & Strategic Insights Metric Management: Define, generate, and analyze key metrics for talent cycles (succession planning, performance, engagement), the enterprise mentorship program, and official language requirements, ensuring absolute data integrity and archiving standards. Insight Generation: Interpret analytical data to identify key trends, workforce risks, and formulate actionable recommendations to elevate program impact. Ad-Hoc Reporting: Prepare strategic documentation, executive summaries, presentations, and process guides for internal stakeholders. People Analytics Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for the corporate People Analytics team to co-create custom dashboards, build reports, and manage complex data extractions, ultimately increasing the team’s data autonomy. Survey Design: Design and evaluate impact/satisfaction surveys to measure the efficacy of HR initiatives. 2. HRIS Optimization & Process Improvement Platform Governance: Serve as the primary operational contact for talent platforms (Workday, Peakon, 10 Thousand Coffees), collaborating closely with the People Systems and analytics team and external vendors. Data Management: Build dynamic tracking tools using advanced formulas (e.g. VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) to streamline talent management workflows. People Systems Optimization: Ensure all available Workday functionalities are maximized following updates. 3. Performance Metrics & KPIs Dashboard Development: Work in collaboration with People Systems & Analytics team to build dynamic dashboards that tell the “story” behind the data, tracking process efficiency and official language compliance. job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description: Location: WA-Seattle Job Title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle Position Overview Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts. This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7. We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences. This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business. In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately. Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling. Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline. Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts. Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers. Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists. Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs. Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives. Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business. Effectively negotiates advertising rates. Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers. Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships. Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process. Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting. Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results. Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections. Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. Minimum Qualifications Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role. Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills. Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines. Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment. Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients. Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot. Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. Preferred Qualifications BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience. Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting Fluent in Spanish This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience. Benefits for this role include: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2025 Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave Employee assistance program All other benefits required by applicable law. About Cox Media Group CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 14 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com Req #: 1853 #LI-Onsite

job.description: Location: MA-Boston Job Title: Anchor/Reporter - WFXT TV Position Overview WFXT TV Boston is looking for a dynamic, curious, and engaged Anchor/Reporter who is interested in breaking stories, making strong ties in the community, and representing the station at public events. At least 5 years of experience as an Anchor and Reporter required. Strong writing and editorial skills required. Consistent demonstration of the following skills: Narrate, ad-lib, and add value to live breaking news and severe weather coverage. Engage in investigative reporting that adds depth to the newscast. Understand social media and demonstrate the ability to move audiences between all platforms. Demonstrate consistent high proficiency with the necessary technical, writing, and presentation skills for television broadcasts. job.title: HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist
job.description: Location: GA-Atlanta Job Title: HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist Position Overview Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking a detail-oriented, service-minded HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist to join the People Solutions team. Reporting to the SVP of People Solutions, this role partners with HR, Legal, managers, employees, and external vendors to deliver compliant, well-documented, and employee-centered outcomes across Television, Radio, and Corporate functions. This role strengthens CMG’s employment compliance foundation by managing critical programs with accuracy, discretion, and disciplined follow-through. The HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist will help ensure workers’ compensation, workplace accommodations, policy governance, immigration administration, FCC/EEO reporting, and annual compliance training are executed consistently, documented appropriately, and aligned with legal, regulatory, and business expectations. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Workers’ Compensation & Return-to-Work: Own workers’ compensation claim administration from intake through resolution, including documentation, tracking, stakeholder communication, and coordination with managers, HR, carriers, administrators, and providers. Advise employees and managers on claim requirements, timelines, documentation, return-to-work expectations, and related employment practices. Policy Governance & Employment Practices: Lead updates to employment policies, procedures, templates, and job aids in partnership with HR leadership and Legal. Drive policy governance by tracking changes, maintaining version control, preparing stakeholder updates, and reinforcing consistent policy application. Immigration Administration: Manage immigration administration by coordinating documentation, tracking cases, partnering with vendors and attorneys, communicating with employees, monitoring renewals, and ensuring compliance follow-up. Workplace Accommodations: Coordinate with ASKHR to support workplace accommodation case management, including intake, documentation, employee and manager communication, and timely follow-through. Gather and review job descriptions, essential job functions, and other role-specific information to support the interactive process. Partner with Prudential to manage required documentation, case updates, and vendor coordination while maintaining appropriate confidentiality. When an accommodation is approved, coordinate with the HRBP and manager to support implementation, communication, and ongoing follow-up as needed. Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued) Compliance Training & Regulatory Reporting: Execute the annual compliance training cycle, including assignments, launch communications, completion tracking, overdue escalations, reporting, and follow-up. Deliver FCC/EEO reporting support by gathering and validating data, maintaining documentation, coordinating stakeholders, and submitting reports on time. Reporting, Records & Risk Management: Develop metrics and reports to surface trends, risks, gaps, and process improvement opportunities. Flag emerging compliance risks using trackers, metrics, reporting, and program data. Track critical deadlines for FCC/EEO reporting, immigration renewals, workers’ compensation follow-up, and compliance training completion. Maintain accurate records and data integrity while safeguarding sensitive employee information. Escalate complex or high-risk matters and help drive practical, compliance-minded resolution. Year One Critical Success Factors Program Execution & Service Delivery: Delivers accurate, timely, and employee-centered administration of workers’ compensation, workplace accommodations, immigration, policy governance, FCC/EEO reporting, and annual compliance training. Partnership & Compliance Credibility: Builds trusted partnerships with HR, Legal, managers, and external vendors while providing practical guidance and escalating risk appropriately. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement: Maintains accurate records, strengthens reporting discipline, closes compliance gaps, and improves processes that support accountability and consistency. Career Growth Opportunities: This role provides meaningful exposure to enterprise HR compliance, employment practices, regulatory reporting, and cross-functional problem-solving. The HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist will deepen expertise in risk management, policy governance, program administration, data reporting, and stakeholder partnership while gaining visibility across HR, Legal, business leaders, and external partners. Over time, this experience can support growth in broader HR compliance, employee relations, HR operations, or people program leadership roles. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, preferred. 5+ years of HR, employment practices, compliance, benefits, or related experience, including exposure to workers’ compensation, policy administration, immigration, FCC/EEO reporting, compliance training, or regulatory program support. Experience managing sensitive, deadline-driven processes with HR partners, Legal, business leaders, vendors, carriers, administrators, or immigration counsel. Strong understanding of HR compliance, employment documentation, policy governance, case or program management, and multi-state employment environments. Skilled in using HRIS, learning management systems, case management tools, vendor portals, Excel, and reporting tools to track activity, maintain records, and identify risks or trends. Strong communication, judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through; able to work independently and escalate risk appropriately. Preferred Qualifications HR certification (PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP). job.description: Location: FL-Orlando-South Job Title: Weekend Anchor - WFTV Position Overview WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week. The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering. The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Weekend Anchor Responsibilities Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling. Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms. Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day. Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community. Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis. Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know. Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports. Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events. Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure. Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms. Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories. job.title: Senior Product Manager II, Content & Media Platform
job.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Management is responsible for driving the overall user experience, feature strategies and concepts, and engagement paradigms for Disney Entertainment & ESPN's global portfolio of consumer-facing streaming and digital products – including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars. About the Role At The Walt Disney Company, we believe in the power of storytelling to inform, connect, and inspire. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager II to lead the evolution of the Media Platform within the ABC News CMS, which powers content creation and publishing to ABC News websites, mobile apps, and digital platforms. In this role, you will own the media platform end-to-end - including asset models, ingestion pipelines, AI integrations and metadata systems - and shape how editors create, manage and publish media within the CMS, ensuring workflows are intuitive, scalable, and tightly integrated across authoring and downstream experiences. This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives in complex, technical environments and brings strong product judgment to ambiguous problems - translating cross-system complexity into clear, scalable solutions and driving alignment across teams to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes. Responsibilities Strategy & Vision Define and drive a clear product strategy for media capabilities within the ABC News CMS that support digital publishing across web and mobile experiences. Establish success metrics that reflect editorial efficiency, system performance and reliability. Own the long-term strategy for ABC News media platform evolution, including integration of future capabilities such as video authoring, platform consolidation and AI workflow optimizations. Set cross-domain strategy for media capabilities, ensuring alignment across authoring, media, and curation workflows. Media Platform Leadership Define the media object model - structure, metadata, and lifecycle - for video and image assets used in digital publishing. Own the experience of media workflows within the ABC News CMS, including how editors upload, manage, and edit media metadata, ensuring workflows are intuitive, efficient, and aligned to editorial needs. Drive convergence of fragmented workflows into a unified, platform-driven approach. Cross-Functional Collaboration Deliver end-to-end media capabilities in partnership with engineering, design, and editorial teams. Drive integration of media workflows across authoring and curation domains in partnership with product leads. Build alignment across stakeholders, ensuring shared understanding of goals, priorities, and outcomes. Execution & Delivery Translate strategy into actionable roadmaps and deliver in iterative, measurable phases. Lead complex, cross-system initiatives such as media migration and workflow consolidation. Launch products with strong coordination, clear communication, and a focus on impact. Audience-Centered Product Development Reduce friction in editorial workflows, enabling users to spend more time focused on journalism and less on technical processes. Partner closely with design and authoring product leads to improve the CMS experience for publishing and managing media, including metadata editing and asset management workflows. Balance editorial needs with technical feasibility and long-term platform scalability. Stakeholder Leadership Build strong, trusted relationships across product, engineering, editorial, and business teams. Communicate product strategy, progress, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership. Act as a platform leader, ensuring the broader ecosystem evolves in a cohesive and scalable way. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in content platforms or media technology. Experience building and scaling platform products, such as content management systems, asset management systems, or enterprise products. Proven ability to define product vision and align cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and editorial stakeholders. Experience delivering complex products with measurable impact on performance, scalability, or workflow efficiency. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort using both qualitative insights and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas to diverse audiences. Technical fluency and experience working closely with engineering teams in agile environments. Experience navigating ambiguity and making high-impact tradeoffs across multiple product domains. A user-focused mindset with a passion for enabling high-quality content creation and publishing experiences.
