job.title: Broadcast Operations Technician
job.description: WTAE-TV, the ABC affiliate in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced Broadcast Operations Technician to join our Engineering team. This position is responsible for delivering and monitoring the station’s on-air signals from content acquisition through distribution. The successful candidate will support both in-studio and remote production operations and report directly to the Assistant Chief Engineer . Responsibilities Operate and manage file-based broadcast workflows, including media preparation, playlist management, recording schedules, and robotic camera shot recall. Provide creative input and work with newscast producers and production crew. Staff the master control room to operate and monitor studio and transmission equipment, including: Broadcast automation systems Robotic cameras Satellite downlinks HD video servers Ensure the accurate execution of on-air playlists, commercial breaks, and programming. Perform floor directing duties during live and recorded productions, communicating effectively with anchors, reporters, and other on-air talent to ensure seamless coordination between the production control room and the studio. Operate and monitor news automation systems to ensure clean technical execution of the newscast. Monitor video and audio quality using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and other quality control equipment to ensure broadcast standards are met. Quickly identify technical issues and communicate equipment problems promptly to Engineering staff to minimize operational disruptions. Support station operations during live broadcasts, special events, and remote productions. Qualifications Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues and respond effectively under time-sensitive conditions. Highly proficient with computers and comfortable learning new software and broadcast technologies. Understanding of newsroom ENPS and video playback systems. Technical know-how to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live newscasts. Experience with file-based media workflows and modern broadcast automation systems is strongly preferred. Reliable, punctual, and able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed. Valid Pennsylvania driver’s license and dependable transportation. Able to stand for long periods of time. Able to lift and carry 50 lbs. Preferred Experience Television control room and studio operations experience. Education or training in Broadcast Communications, Electronics, or a related technical field. Technical School degree, Electronics Certification, and/or Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) Certification. Military technical experience is welcomed and will be considered. production, sales, and design around performance-driven workflows Partner closely with Content Operations on captioning, upload readiness, and publishing workflows to ensure consistent execution against platform best practices Flag potential monetization, rights-management, or platform policy issues early and coordinate with internal stakeholders and platform partners to resolve them proactively Qualifications Minimum of 6 years experience in digital video strategy, YouTube programming, audience development, or video analytics (media company, creator network, or agency preferred) Demonstrated success programming or operating a major YouTube channel or network, including packaging strategy (titles/thumbnails), launch scheduling, and performance optimization Avid and natural consumer of YouTube with strong ties to creators, producers, and networks in the space Advanced fluency in YouTube Studio analytics, content measurement, and experimentation frameworks; ability to translate metrics into creative direction without overfitting to noise Experience building repeatable reporting systems and dashboards (e.g., Sheets/Excel + Looker Studio/Tableau; bonus for SQL, APIs, or lightweight scripting/automation) Knowledge of YouTube monetization and sponsorship tooling (new DAI Brand Partnerships tools, creator-brand workflows, measurement, and brand-safety guidelines) Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to influence talent/creators, producers, editors, designers, and sales partners with clarity and credibility Highly organized, proactive operator with strong project management instincts and comfort solving problems with small teams Genuine passion and knowledge for pets and the industry’s creator ecosystem Education Related experience and/or training considered as well as a combination of education and experience HMPG is a proud supporter of military veterans. Related military training and experience will be considered Compensation The estimated base salary range for this role is between $95,000 and $105,000. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Values in Action At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve. Benefits Eligible employees will have access to enroll in health coverage through our partnership with Entertainment Partners’ EP Cares program. Medical Dental Vision Emotional Wellness Support Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs About Hearst Media Production Group Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in nearly 100 countries. Its popular shows include the Emmy® Award-winning educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks airing weekends nationwide including “Weekend Adventure,” on ABC stations; “CBS WKND,” on the CBS Network; “The More You Know,” on the NBC Network; “One Magnificent Morning,” on the CW Network; “Mi Telemundo” on the Telemundo Network and “Go Time” on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including Matter of Fact with Soledad O’Brien , America’s #1 nationally syndicated public affairs news magazine; Consumer Reports TV , and the company’s dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel and Rovr Pets, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms. HMPG has offices in New York, Los Angeles, Washington, D.C. and Charlotte. HMPG is represented by United Talent Agency.

job.title: Writer Producer
job.description: Promotions Writer Producer WYFF 4, the NBC and CBS affiliate in Greenville, SC is looking for a creative Promotions Writer Producer to write, shoot, edit and design promotion for all media platforms. As a Promotions Writer Producer, you will create station image promotion for all platforms that advances our brand and gets noticed in a competitive market. You will write and produce daily news promos that help with station campaigns and marketing projects and assist the promotions department in other tasks, as assigned. If you are motivated and creative, then this job could be ideal for you! Responsibilities Produce, write, shoot and edit compelling on-air promos and image campaigns from start to finish that increases viewer interest, the brand awareness and ratings for all multi-platforms Organize and build projects from concept through delivery, directing and supervising video editors, sound editors and on-air announce talent and video editing Create station on-air image, entertainment promos and graphics- this includes daily program episodes for air Produce and implement community outreach events, including on-air promotion and event planning Help with street team vehicle and events Hands-on editing and online editing management Contribution to brainstorms across all departments Requirements 3+ years experience in Television writing or producing Experience with Adobe applications such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Photoshop required Working knowledge of AVID and Adobe Creative Suite Writing skills; can write compelling, conversational copy Knowledge of production process including linear and non-linear editing Proficient in videography and lighting Image and promotion writing skills Work well under extreme deadlines Must be a team player and creative Related military experience will be considered Values in Action At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve. Medical | Dental | Vision 401(k) matching Emotional Wellness Support Paid Time Off Paid Parental Leave LGBTQ+ Health Services Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.title: Account Executive
job.description: Hearst Times Union Media Group is looking for a driven Account Executive to join our Capital Region sales team. This is a full-cycle, new business-focused sales role where you’ll be responsible for prospecting, closing, and growing new accounts, while building long-term partnerships with local and regional companies. You’ll also have a book of existing accounts that generate commissions and you can upsell on our wide swath of digital marketing solutions. You’ll have the backing of one of the most recognized media brands in the country, plus access to cutting-edge AI tools that help you prospect smarter, close faster, and maximize your earning potential. If you’re competitive, resourceful, and motivated by uncapped earnings , this is an opportunity to take your sales career to the next level. Why Join Hearst Times Union Media Group? Uncapped Earnings Potential Base salary + aggressive commission structure. Top performers consistently exceed targets. Sell with a Competitive Edge Leverage advanced tools like ChatGPT Enterprise to streamline prospecting, sharpen presentations, and accelerate deal cycles. High-Impact Role in a Strong Market Albany is a dynamic market for SMB’s, with endless opportunity to build new business and expand client relationships. Trusted Brand & Premium Products Represent a respected media organization with a powerful portfolio of advertising solutions and a massive audience reach. Our team makes sales from $5000 to $500,000. Career Growth & Mobility We invest in our people. Whether you want to grow your book, move into leadership, or expand into new markets, there’s a path here. Be part of a team of six AE’s reporting to a Sales Director who invests their time in you, making you better every day! Work inside (presenting on Microsoft Teams) and Go outside , we highly value in person meetings. Regular get togethers , happy hours, be part of a Sales office of over 30 sales and support staff. Hybrid schedule , Monday and Friday remote, Tues/Wed/Thursday in office. What You’ll Do: Own the Full Sales Cycle Prospect, pitch, close, and grow accounts across digital, event, and print solutions. Drive New Business Proactively identify and connect with small, medium and large businesses through outreach, networking, and market awareness. Present a compelling suite of products including best in class Content Marketing, Hearst Any Screen Streaming Television Advertising, SEO, SEM, display including programmatic, paid social media marketing, Email marketing, print solutions, and more. Build & Manage Your Pipeline Maintain a strong pipeline of new and existing business using Salesforce, Outreach, ChatGPT Enterprise, and consistently meet activity and revenue targets. Deliver Compelling Presentations Lead discovery conversations and present media plans that clearly demonstrate value and ROI. Leverage AI to Win More Deals Use over a dozen of our customized GPT’s, AI-powered tools that increase your efficiency, improve client engagement, and close business faster. What Sets You Apart: You’re a hunter who thrives on winning new business You are dynamic on the phone and in person. You know Albany and the Capital Region well. You’re competitive and goal-oriented , with a track record of exceeding targets You’re confident in client-facing situations , from cold outreach to executive presentations You’re adaptable and resourceful , able to navigate challenges and find solutions You’re strategic in your approach , not just transactional You bring strong communication and relationship-building skills Qualifications: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience. 2+ years of B2B sales experience (media, advertising, business or related industry preferred) Proven success in new business development and revenue growth Experience managing a full sales cycle Adept at using CRM tools (Salesforce, Outreach, or similar. Existing relationships in the Albany market are a plus Our Benefits: At Times Union Media Group we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family). Our industry-leading benefits include: Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets. Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation. Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents. Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones. Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits. LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs. Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey. Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy. And more, click here for additional benefits and details. Ready to Make an Impact? Join us and be part of a team that’s transforming local media through technology and human connection. Apply now to launch your next chapter as a trusted media partner to businesses across Albany. Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York State. The reasonable estimated starting base salary, if hired in New York State, would start at about $50,000 (base salary), plus commissions with on target first year earnings potential of $75,000 - $125,000 (annualized) based on individual performance. There is no commission cap. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York State. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York State, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education. About Us: Based in Albany, the Times Union (www.timesunion.com) is the leading news organization in New York’s Capital Region, Hudson Valley and beyond. The news organization is widely respected for its focus on local news and watchdog reporting, particularly on state government and politics. It has won numerous state and national awards for its work on both print and digital platforms and has repeatedly been named New York’s ‘Newspaper of Distinction’ by the state editors association. Through the Times Union Media Group, we offer innovative marketing and advertising solutions to local, regional, and national clients. These include event marketing, a full complement of digital marketing solutions, targeted and total market coverage print solutions and more. HNP Overview: With 2,500 employees across the nation, Hearst Newspapers (HNP) represents a network of 28 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the Austin American-Statesman, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, San Francisco Chronicle and Times Union (Albany). Our portfolio also includes several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites such as Chron., CT Insider, MySA and SFGATE, along with marketing services businesses like Medium Giant and entertainment brands such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we’re investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories — growing newsrooms, diversifying tools and evolving platforms — to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. Be part of something bigger — Your Headline Awaits #LI-DH1 #LI-Hybrid

job.title: Account Coordinator
job.description: KATZ Radio Group Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution. Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation. Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: At Katz Media Group, we strive for success and support our teams that are dedicated to excellence in client service. You’ll play a vital role in helping our sales teams deliver on our mission to super-serve our clients and listeners. You’ll be the operational backbone that ensures our sales process runs smoothly, efficiently, and with heart. What You'll Do: Support Account Executives in the pre-sale and post-sale process, including proposal development, order entry, campaign tracking, and reporting. Coordinate with internal departments (traffic, production, digital, promotions) to ensure flawless execution of campaigns across radio, digital, podcast, social, and event platforms. Prepare sales materials such as presentations, recaps, and client-facing documents using tools like PowerPoint, Salesforce, and internal systems. Monitor campaign performance and assist in compiling data for client reporting and renewals. Manage deadlines and deliverables to ensure all client expectations are met or exceeded. Serve as a liaison between sales, programming, and operations to ensure alignment and communication. Assist with billing and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timely processing. What You'll Need: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint); Salesforce experience is a plus. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional client service. What You'll Bring: Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts Compensation: Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. $19.78 - $24.73 Location: Atlanta, GA: 3495 Piedmont Rd, Bldg 11, Suite 215, 30305 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Hourly Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law. Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here to learn about E-Verify.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description: iHeartMedia Markets Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America , reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined; We’re the largest podcast publisher , with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix; iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers , who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America; We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour; iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America; Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio , from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone. Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia! If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations. What You'll Do: As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations. What You'll Need: You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list. You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment . Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts. A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required. You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms. Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential. Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns , analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market. What you’ll get You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission , and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club a nd iHeartMedia President’s Club programs Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time , paid company holidays , a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching , learning and development resources, and career navigation support. Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster , and legal insurance, student loan refinancing , and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more. The support of fellow team members invested in your success. Envision your first 30 days Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role. Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app! What You'll Bring: Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return General understanding of business principles and sales environment Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance Skills managing assigned projects to completion Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs Understanding of impact of your own decisions Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize Compensation: This position will be paid on a 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 4.0%-11.0%. Location: Burbank, CA: 3400 West Olive Avenue, Suite 550, 91505 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Salaried Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law. Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here to learn about E-Verify.

job.title: Software Tester
job.description: iHeartMedia Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider. RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape. Here is what makes us different: We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics. We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward. If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. What We Need: Florical Systems is hiring an Intermediate Software Tester to join the team responsible for developing and validating software used at the core of the world's largest and most recognized broadcast television operations. As a Software Tester, you will evaluate the functionality, reliability, and performance of our software across a broad range of technologies. You will identify and investigate issues, clearly communicate your findings, and work closely with developers and other team members to help ensure our products meet the standards required for mission-critical broadcast environments. This position provides an opportunity to expand your software testing and technical skills while gaining experience with the systems and technologies that support modern television operations. This is a full-time, non-exempt position. What You'll Do: Develop and execute manual and automated test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for broadcast television software. Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing. Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects through resolution using Atlassian Jira. Verify software fixes and perform appropriate regression testing to identify unintended effects. Analyze software and system behavior using application logs, diagnostic tools, SQL queries, databases, APIs, and other available data. Write SQL queries and analyze SQL Server and MongoDB databases as part of software testing and troubleshooting. Review and modify JSON, XML, and other configuration or data files used by the systems under test. Deploy and configure software in containerized test environments and troubleshoot associated container platforms. Install, configure, and troubleshoot broadcast industry equipment used in software test environments. Install and configure COTS hardware used in test systems, including servers, network switches, and related equipment. Configure and troubleshoot LAN connectivity and other networking required within non-production test environments. Create documentation, as needed, including test results, defect details, procedures, and installation or configuration notes. Collaborate with software developers, product owners, support personnel, and other team members to understand requirements, investigate issues, and validate expected behavior. Participate in Agile development activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Contribute to the continued improvement of test processes, test coverage, automation, and product quality. What You'll Need: Skills and Experience Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related technical field, or equivalent relevant work experience. Ability to develop and execute test cases and test scenarios from requirements, specifications, and expected system behavior. Experience identifying, reproducing, documenting, and communicating software defects. Working knowledge of LAN/WAN networking concepts, including TCP/IP and common network troubleshooting techniques. Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows operating systems. Working knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases. Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to investigate application logs, configuration files, databases, and system behavior. Ability to communicate technical information clearly and professionally in written and verbal form, including defect reports, test results, and technical documentation. Preferred Professional experience performing software testing, including functional, regression, integration, or system testing. Experience working within a software development lifecycle and an Agile development environment. Experience developing or maintaining automated software tests. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies. Experience with cloud platforms or cloud-based application environments. Experience with or knowledge of a modern programming or scripting language, such as C#, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar. Experience testing distributed, networked, real-time, or hardware-integrated software systems. What You'll Bring: Location: Gainesville, FL: 4500 NW 27th Ave, Building B-1, 32606 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Hourly Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance (pursuant to the collective bargaining agreement if applicable) Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! job.title: Safety Supervisor
job.description: Title: Safety Supervisor Reports to: Sr Safety Director Herman Weissker Power, Inc. (HW Power) , a proud subsidiary of Meruelo Enterprises , is California’s go-to electrical utility contractor powering the state’s most critical infrastructure with precision and passion. Since 2011, from our headquarters in Norwalk, we’ve been leading the charge in overhead and underground electrical systems, including expert vault installations, conduit placement, and high-voltage power line construction. But we don’t stop there. Our team also brings cutting-edge planning, design, and traffic control services to the table making even the most complex utility projects run smoothly. Driven by an unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and high performance, HW Power is the trusted partner for public and private sector clients who demand reliable, future-ready energy solutions. About the Role: The Safety Supervisor will be responsible for training and administer Train and administer the Company safety, health and accident prevention program and ensure all employees have a safe environment in which to work. Key Responsibilities: ² Administer the Company safety program; implement and coordinate safety and health activities. ² Able to conduct safety training classes; safety certification classes and maintain all related records. ² Monitor and evaluate training program’s effectiveness, success and periodically report on them. ² Able to review accidents and incidents, take corrective action as needed and make recommendations to prevent future occurrences. ² Analyze inspection findings to determine the need for employee safety training. ² Recommend safety equipment to be used or worn; coordinate with safety committees and the purchasing departments concerning the purchase, storage and issuance of approved safety equipment and products for employees. ² Able to coordinate fleet safety programs; keep current on new trends and methods in accident prevention field; keep current on OSHA reports and standards. ² Able to analyze all loss data to determine causes of injuries; develop trend analysis and statistical summary of accidents and injuries. ² Conduct studies concerning the interest and need for safety training programs; administer safety awareness awards program. ² Able to attend and participate in professional safety organization projects. ² Able to supervise and administer safety, first aid and rescue squad activities including work assignments, personnel administration, staffing, training, etc. ² Able to review documentation to insure all required records and reports are complete, accurate and submitted per established procedures, and implement appropriate corrective action as required. ² Perform additional duties as assigned by the Safety Director. Qualifications: ² Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Industrial Hygiene or related discipline or a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge. ² Minimum 3 years safety related experience or field related experience in the underground construction industry. ² OSHA 30 Construction required. ² Possession of a valid class A or C California driver's license ² Thorough understanding of and ability to enforce federal, state, local and company regulations. ² Ability to recognize hazardous situations and implement corrective measures. ² Good interpersonal and communication skills required. ² Must have extensive knowledge of applicable safety regulations, regulatory requirement and industry standards for construction and general industry; knowledge of EPA, DOT and NEPA standards. ² Experience in high voltage utility construction a plus At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Sr. Human Resources Generalist
job.description: Herman Weissker Power Inc. is a leading company in the construction and engineering industry. We perform engineering & construction work in a variety of market segments. We are headquartered in Chino, CA with business units in LA, Riverside, San Diego and Ventura performing work throughout California. Herman Weissker Power Inc. is searching for a Senior Human Resources Generalist who will provide a wide range of HR support and guidance. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the organization by offering guidance on recruitment, terminations, performance management, employee relations, compliance, and HR best practices while facilitating positive working relationships between employees, supervisors, and management. Duties and responsibilities • Implement, administer, and communicate employee policies and procedures in alignment with company practices and applicable employment laws. • Ensure company compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, including required reporting and recordkeeping obligations. • Support compliance with governmental and labor requirements, including those related to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA), the Department of Labor, workers’ compensation, the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), and other applicable employment laws and regulations. • Protect the interests of the company and employees by consistently applying company Human Resources policies and applicable laws and regulations. • Administer new employee onboarding and orientation processes. • Serve as a link between management and employees by responding to questions, interpreting and administering company policies and applicable agreements, and helping resolve work-related concerns. • Provide high-quality guidance and support to management on employee relations, performance management, corrective action, and related workplace matters. • Support the HR department in implementing programs and initiatives that help improve the employee experience, engagement, retention, and overall workplace culture. • Maintains employee-related databases and prepares and analyzes reports necessary to support the functions of the Human Resources department and the company. • Prepares periodic reports for management, as necessary or requested. • Utilize Human Resources systems and technology to improve efficiency, reporting, data accuracy, and overall HR department effectiveness. • Provide proactive recruiting support, including assisting with job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, and communication with hiring managers. • Identify opportunities to improve HR policies, procedures, workflows, and employee-facing processes. • Prepare termination, separation, and severance-related letters and documentation in coordination with HR leadership and legal counsel, as appropriate. • Provide guidance, training, and support to HR team members on HR processes, systems, and best practices, as needed. Qualifications • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible Human Resources experience, with hands-on experience supporting employee relations, performance management, recruiting, onboarding, policy administration, and compliance with federal and California employment laws in a complex, multi-site organization. • General knowledge of employment laws and practices • Expertise in HR policies and procedures • Strong knowledge of hiring processes • Understanding of HR best practices and current regulations • Sound judgment and problem-solving skills Customer-focused attitude, with high level of professionalism and discretion • Familiarity with MS Office. • Excellent communication skills Education and Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant Human Resources experience may be considered. Master’s degree preferred. • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in Human Resources positions, preferably in a construction, utility, field-operations, or multi-site environment. • Specialized training in employment law, compensation, organizational planning, organization development, employee relations, safety, training, and preventive labor relations, preferred. • Professional in Human Resources (PHR) certification preferred. Herman Weissker Power Inc. offers a competitive pay and benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Herman Weissker Power Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of the work performed by employees assigned to this position. This description assists in ADA compliance, and is not intended for any other purpose such as compensation. All employees must comply with company policies and applicable laws. Management retains the right to assign additional duties periodically and the discretion to add or change the duties of this position at any time.

job.title: News Anchor/MMJ — Apple Valley News Now | Kennewick, Washington
job.description: About Us Apple Valley News Now is the local ABC affiliate serving the Yakima/Tri-Cities market of Washington state and is part of Morgan Murphy Media. We are a family-owned, people-first company, and our communities are at the core of what we do and who we are. Local journalism is changing — and so are we. We serve our audience wherever they are: on television, streaming, our website and app, and the social platforms they use every day. We believe strong reporting, compelling video and meaningful community connection matter on every screen. About This Opportunity Apple Valley News Now is seeking an innovative, audience-focused News Anchor/MMJ to anchor local newscasts and create distinctive journalism across broadcast, digital, streaming and social platforms. This role is based at KVEW-TV in Kennewick, Washington. The right candidate is a trusted on-air communicator and a curious, versatile journalist who can identify what matters to our community, report it with accuracy and empathy, and adapt each story for the platform and audience it serves. You are comfortable moving quickly on breaking news, connecting directly with viewers and experimenting with new ways to tell local stories. What You'll Do Anchor newscasts, live reports, breaking-news coverage and news briefs with credibility, urgency and personality. Research, pitch, shoot, write, edit and deliver original local stories for television, web, streaming and social platforms. Create platform-native content, including vertical video, live social updates and concise explainers that help audiences understand why a story matters. Turn daily reporting into timely, accurate digital stories, video, headlines, captions and audience-facing updates. Enterprise compelling stories that reflect the people, issues and opportunities shaping the Yakima/Tri-Cities region. Use sound editorial judgment and uphold journalism ethics, accuracy standards, fairness and libel law. Collaborate with producers, digital staff, and newsroom leadership on the strongest presentation for every story. Engage with the community online and in person; build trusted source relationships and listen for story ideas. Participate in producing newscasts and other newsroom responsibilities as assigned by the news director. Operate TV news cameras, mobile devices, editing software and production apps to produce high-quality visual journalism. What You'll Bring At least four years of experience as a multimedia journalist, reporter and/or anchor. A bachelor's degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. Demonstrated ability to anchor professionally from the studio and report effectively in the field and live. Strong broadcast, digital and AP Style writing skills. A proven ability to tell clear, engaging stories with video, sound, text and social-first formats. Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalism ethics, accuracy standards and libel law. A collaborative, self-directed mindset, with excellent organization and the ability to meet daily deadlines. Curiosity about changing audience habits and enthusiasm for learning new tools, formats and platforms. Experience with Inception and Adobe is preferred but not required. Ability to lift and carry up to 15 pounds. What You'll Get in Return You'll join a supportive newsroom and management team that value your work, your time and your perspective. We are committed to a culture where employees can grow professionally and personally while doing meaningful journalism for the communities we serve. Pay range: $20–$27 per hour Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, prescription, life insurance and Employee Assistance Program benefits for employees and their families. Employees are also offered long-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k), health savings account, employee referral program and paid time off, including vacation time equivalent to 80 hours per year depending on start date, one hour of sick time for every 40 hours worked, two personal days and nine paid holidays. Apple Valley News Now is an equal opportunity employer. APPLY NOW

job.title: Technical Manager, Local Media
job.description: WORK OPTION: In Office _________________ Position Summary The Technical Manager, Local Media serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the execution, performance, and continuous improvement of production technology services supporting the NBA's Local Media ecosystem. Reporting to the Vice President, Production Technology, this role leads the day-to-day technical operations supporting Local Media league program facilitated game broadcasts, ensuring reliable, scalable, and consistent execution across NBA arenas and NBA Secaucus. Serving as an operational owner of the technical production service function for the Local Media team, the Technical Manager oversees production technology operations supporting broadcast contribution, routing, monitoring, transmission, master control, HSAN connectivity, and distribution workflows. This position provides leadership to freelance Technical Managers, establishes operational standards and best practices, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and partners closely with GPM Broadcast Engineering & Broadcast Operations, technical production operations vendors, NBA teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver best-in-class live broadcasts. The Technical Manager serves as the primary technical liaison between engineering, production, and broadcast operations, ensuring technical readiness, operational excellence, and seamless execution across all League-supported productions. This role partners closely with the Vice President, Production Technology to translate strategic technology initiatives into scalable operational capabilities while continuously improving the League's production technology service model. This position is based in the NBA Secaucus office and requires regular in-office attendance five (5) days per week. This role supports live NBA game productions and League events and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours in accordance with the NBA game schedule and other League programming. Occasional domestic travel to NBA arenas and other League event locations may be required. Major Responsibilities Operational Leadership Lead the League's Technical Manager function, providing leadership, coaching, scheduling, onboarding, performance feedback, and operational oversight for freelance Technical Managers supporting NBA Local Media productions. Serve as the primary point of contact for the Local Media production operation working with the GPM Broadcast Engineering team on the HSAN connectivity platform, ensuring reliable contribution, routing, monitoring, transmission, and distribution of live NBA game broadcasts. Own, in conjunction with the NBA with Broadcast Engineering & Operations team, the operational performance, service delivery, and reliability of production technology services supporting League-produced broadcasts. Establish operational priorities, technical standards, service levels, governance processes, and best practices supporting production technology operations across League-supported productions. Oversee day-to-day production technology operations between NBA arenas, NBA Secaucus, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, production operations vendors, distribution, and participating NBA teams. Lead operational readiness planning for all supported productions, ensuring technical infrastructure, connectivity, transmission paths, communications systems, and production technologies are fully prepared prior to each event. Partner with the Vice President, Production Technology in developing the long-term operational roadmap for production technology services, ensuring operational readiness, scalability, and alignment with evolving business priorities. Support implementation and operational transition of new production technologies, workflows, and infrastructure initiatives developed by Production Technology leadership. Live Broadcast Operations Coordinate production technology, transmission, signal acquisition, routing, monitoring, master control, and broadcast distribution workflows supporting live NBA game productions. Serve as a primary technical escalation point during live productions, leading cross-functional troubleshooting efforts and coordinating rapid resolution of production technology issues. Lead technical incident response during live broadcasts, directing cross-functional teams to restore service while minimizing operational impact. Develop contingency plans, operational playbooks, and technical readiness procedures supporting mission-critical live productions. Provide operational leadership for preseason games, NBA All-Star, NBA Summer League, international games, and other League events. Participate in after-hours operational support and on-call rotations supporting live productions and critical production technology systems. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures, engineering runbooks, technical documentation, and operational support workflows. Establish, monitor, and report on operational KPIs, service levels, incident trends, and system performance metrics to identify opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency. Lead post-event operational reviews, root cause analyses, corrective action planning, and lessons learned following technical incidents. Recommend workflow enhancements, automation opportunities, and operational improvements that improve service quality, scalability, resiliency, and production efficiency. Coordinate maintenance windows, software deployments, network changes, and system upgrades while minimizing operational impact to live productions. Ensure operational compliance with League technical standards, broadcast quality expectations, and established production technology procedures. Evaluate production technology operations and recommend process improvements that support long-term operational excellence and organizational scalability. Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership Lead onboarding, mentoring, scheduling, performance management, and ongoing development of freelance Technical Managers and technical support personnel. Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, customer service, innovation, and continuous improvement. Build and maintain strong partnerships with NBA teams, internal departments, broadcast partners, and key stakeholders to ensure consistent technical execution and exceptional service delivery. Provide subject matter expertise supporting new production workflows, operational planning, and League-wide production technology initiatives. Support annual operational planning, staffing strategies, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and production technology expense management. Represent Production Technology within cross-functional planning meetings and operational governance forums, ensuring alignment across engineering, production, operations, and distribution teams. Required Education / Professional Experience Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Media Production, or a related field preferred. 8â10+ years of progressively responsible experience supporting live broadcast production, production technology, broadcast engineering, or technical operations. Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical personnel supporting live sports broadcasts or large-scale broadcast operations. Experience supporting multi-venue production environments and mission-critical live event operations. Experience coordinating production technology operations across engineering, production, transmission, and broadcast operations teams. Demonstrated experience establishing operational standards, service delivery models, and technical governance processes. Experience leading technical incident response and troubleshooting complex broadcast technology environments. Professional sports or major live event production experience strongly preferred. Required Skills / Knowledge Attributes Expert knowledge of live broadcast production systems, workflows, and end-to-end signal flow. Strong understanding of IP-based broadcast infrastructure, contribution networks, transmission systems, and cloud-enabled production workflows. Experience supporting REMI, centralized production, master control operations, contribution networks, and broadcast distribution. Familiarity with SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, SRT, NDI, JPEG XS, multicast networking, and other modern broadcast technologies preferred. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, incident management, and root cause analysis skills. Demonstrated leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development capabilities. Excellent communication, collaboration, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple functional groups. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent productions and competing priorities. Proven ability to lead operational change, implement process improvements, establish governance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to make sound technical and operational decisions in high-pressure, fast-paced live production environments. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and technical documentation platforms. Working Conditions This position is based in NBA Secaucus and requires regular in-office attendance five (5) days per week. Must be available to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on the NBA game schedule and other live production requirements. Must participate in on-call support rotations and respond to critical production technology issues outside of normal business hours as necessary. Requires occasional domestic travel to NBA arenas and other League event locations to support game productions, technical deployments, testing, and special events. Ability to work in fast-paced live broadcast environments where priorities may shift rapidly to support live productions. Salary Range: $130,000 - $165,000 Job Posting Title: Director Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. job.title: Account Executive (Local Ad Sales), The California Post
job.description: Job Description : California Post is a brand-new digital-first news organization backed by the trusted legacy of the New York Post. Our mission is to deliver breaking news, compelling storytelling, and innovative content to readers across the West Coast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing team, shape the future of a newsroom, and help advertisers connect with a highly engaged audience. We are looking for a hungry, results-driven local Ad Sales Account Executive to join our Los Angeles team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for driving new business, managing client relationships, and delivering revenue growth for California Post , with a strong focus on local and regional advertisers. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in media sales, deep local market knowledge, and understands how to prospect, negotiate, and close deals in a competitive marketplace. Responsibilities: Develop and execute a sales strategy to drive revenue growth across digital advertising, sponsorships, and brand partnerships, with an emphasis on local and regional accounts. Identify, prospect, and secure new clients across key local verticals, including Tier 2 automotive, casinos and gaming, real estate, hospitals and healthcare systems, legal services, and other local service-based businesses. Build and maintain strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, and key regional stakeholders. Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and editorial, to craft integrated, custom advertising solutions tailored to local market needs. Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, RFP responses, contract negotiations, and post-sale account management. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipelines, and CRM data. Stay up to date on industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities to effectively advise clients and position California Post as a trusted local media partner. Requirements: Minimum of 5 years of advertising sales experience, preferably within media or digital news organizations. Demonstrated success selling to local or regional advertisers, ideally across verticals such as automotive, gaming, real estate, healthcare, or professional services. Proven ability to prospect, close deals, and consistently exceed revenue targets. Strong network of media and advertising contacts in the Los Angeles market. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail. Ability and willingness to travel as needed. Note: This role is primarily based in our Los Angeles office. Occasional remote work may be permitted, with the expectation of on-site presence for core team collaboration and client-facing activities, excluding external sales meetings or required travel. Compensation : $100,000 - $125,000 Base + commission/sales bonus plan. A final decision on the successful candidate's starting salary will be based on a number of factors, including but not limited to competitive market practice, internal equity, experience, tenure, and essential skills. At The New York Post Media Group we recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, our ranges reflect our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process. In addition to compensation, the company provides eligible employees a comprehensive and highly competitive benefits package, with a variety of physical health, retirement and savings, caregiving, emotional wellbeing, transportation, and other benefits, including “elective” benefits employees may select to best fit the needs and personal situations of our diverse workforce. Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations. job.title: Associate Commerce Editor
job.description: Job Description : About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce. The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed. This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network. What You’ll Do: ● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output. ● Edit 15+ fast-turn deals and standard shopping content daily from reporters. Move copy from draft to live with speed, ensuring clean formatting, airtight affiliate linking and FTC compliance. ● Take point on executing sponsored content and flat-fee product placements, seamlessly weaving revenue-driven partnerships into daily coverage while maintaining reader trust and the iconic Post voice. ● Step in to report, write or co-edit larger, high-priority features and tentpole packages (Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Week) as assigned by leadership. ● Share ownership of the evergreen strategy. Audit and update top-performing posts for price, stock and SEO/AEO/GEO optimization to maximize long-tail revenue. ● Write sharp, on-brand headlines (providing 3-5 variants for testing). Begin providing actionable, constructive feedback to reporters to maintain voice and standards. ● Monitor performance dashboards to iterate headlines, framing and placement. Pitch high-intent stories based on search data, real-time signals and competitor coverage. How We Measure Success: ● Output Balance: Consistent daily writing output (2–3 stories) combined with reliable, rapid editing of assigned copy and on-time handoffs. ● Quality & Accuracy: Clean copy (both written and edited), rigorous fact-checking, zero avoidable corrections and strict link hygiene. ● Impact: Measurable lift in CTR, conversion rates, revenue per session and search visibility for both authored and edited pieces. ● Ownership: Demonstrated progress in editorial decision-making, proactive pitching and the ability to seamlessly pivot between writing and editing mindsets. What You’ll Bring: ● Professional experience commensurate with an associate-level role in features, news or commerce writing, backed by a portfolio of strong clips and early experience (or a demonstrated aptitude) for editing. ● Obsession with the commerce landscape, reader value and producing service-oriented content with a commercial focus. ● Command of the iconic NY Post voice and a proven track record of writing crisp, authoritative headlines. ● Working knowledge of SEO, AEO and GEO, plus social media best practices. ● Comfort reading dashboards (Search Console, GA4, Looker or similar) and using data to pivot quickly to trends or live news without losing accuracy. ● CMS fluency and sharp attention to detail, including mastery of AP style and FTC-compliant disclosures. ● A collaborative, growth-oriented mindset – highly organized, adaptable and ready to take on coaching responsibilities. Nice to Have ● Hands-on familiarity with affiliate dashboards and networks (Amazon Associates, Skimlinks or similar), project management platforms and SEO tools. ● Experience jumping between categories and services that help shoppers protect value. ● Deeper understanding of AEO, GEO and AI overviews. ● Newsletter experience. Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week. job.title: Associate Producer - Schein Daily Sports Video Show
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post is the nation’s oldest newspaper with the youngest, most ambitious video department. We want to make our mark in digital video and create memorable work and new watching habits among our audience. The legacy of the great headlines conveys the attributes of our videos: bold, irreverent, judgmental, confident and clever. We want to make videos that surprise viewers. We seek someone who appreciates serious and quirky stories. Let’s talk! The New York Post video team is seeking an Associate Producer for “Schein Time” with Adam Schein, a new daily live sports show that is national in scope. This AP will play a key role in assisting all aspects of the daily production process and be responsible for creating compelling, shareable videos and disseminating the show across social platforms. These clips will help drive in tune-in and be content worth watching. The candidate we seek has deep knowledge of and interest in a wide range of sports, including NFL, MLB, NBA/WNBA, College Sports, NHL, emerging sports, gambling, fantasy, and current New York/California sports news. Per our publication’s mantra, you agree that news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. This is an opportunity to join an iconic media brand as it continues exponential digital growth. The New York Post has garnered more than a billion video views across various platforms in the past year. Responsibilities: Assist in all aspects of daily production for a nationally distributed live sports show Produce compelling, shareable short-form video clips to drive tune-in and audience engagement Lead the creation of thumbnails, headlines, and other visual/packaging elements optimized for digital and social platforms Manage and execute interactive promotion of show content across social media channels Socialize show clips strategically to maximize reach, viewership, and engagement Ensure smooth day-to-day production workflows while juggling multiple simultaneous tasks Collaborate with producers and team members to generate ideas and contribute to daily show brainstorming Support the production of digitally native video content tailored to platform-specific audiences Apply deep knowledge of sports—including major leagues, emerging sports, gambling, esports, and fantasy—to content creation and promotion Identify and help elevate unconventional, entertaining, and newsworthy sports stories in line with the publication’s brand voice QUALIFICATIONS : Minimum 2 years of experience in a digital/sports newsroom environment Encyclopedic sports knowledge including upstart sports, fantasy, and esports. Ability to pitch, produce, and script Ability to polish on camera talent Ability to work closely with internal stakeholders and reporters. Excellent communication and people skills Experience creating video for social platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, X and more a plus Strong news judgment, track record of successful video production Implement best practices for video metadata, thumbnails, and discovery on all videos Fluency with key tools in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) also a plus. Familiarity with the New York Post and our writing style Use web analytics to monitor audience engagement with our videos and strategize for growth on various platforms Excited about new types of multimedia storytelling Must enjoy working collaboratively and accurately in a fast paced but fun environment Strong news judgment and attention to detail and journalistic values a must NEEDS: · Resume and cover letter. NOTE: This is an in-office 5 day a week job with occasional weekend and evening work. job.title: Audience Development Specialist (SEO), The California Post
job.description: Job Description : The California Post is seeking an Audience Development Specialist to help execute our audience optimization strategy as we expand to California. This role will report into the Senior Audience Development Manager (California Post), working closely with cross-functional teams. The Audience Development Specialist will play a key role in driving multi-platform discoverability, ensuring our journalism reaches the widest possible audience across search, video, social, and emerging AI-driven platforms. Responsibilities: Work alongside the Sr. Audience Development specialist on audience optimization and discovery for tentpole events, ensuring optimized visibility across Google, YouTube, social, and AI-driven search. Pitch trending, evergreen and planned content strategies that strengthen The California Post’s authority and multi-platform presence. Contribute to optimization strategies for franchises, brand initiatives, and key content verticals, both on- and off-platform. Support execution of optimization strategies for homepage, landing pages, and article templates to enhance discoverability, engagement, and conversions. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders — including editorial, product, development, video, data, and marketing — to align audience strategies. Conduct keyword and platform research to identify content gaps, emerging trends, and audience demand. Monitor performance metrics, competitive benchmarks, and platform analytics to inform strategy and adjust in real time. Participate in editorial meetings and contribute real-time optimization insights to shape coverage. Conduct regular training sessions and audits to ensure best practices are embedded across the newsroom. Qualifications: At least 3 years of experience in SEO, audience development, or platform optimization within a newsroom or relevant digital media environment Expertise in multi-platform optimization (Google, YouTube, emerging AI search engines; social media optimization experience a plus) Experience using competitive SEO and analytics tools (SEMrush, Google Trends, Google Search Console, Google Analytics) Understanding of the SEO industry and Google’s evolving web standards; proficiency in structured data/schema.org is a plus Ability to balance priorities and thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment; experience in a California-based newsroom is a plus Ability to be both a self-starter and team player; strong interpersonal and communication skills are required Highly organized with excellent attention to detail Willingness to work nights and weekends as needed Note: This is an onsite role. Candidates may be based in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Sacramento, or New York and are expected to work from their nearest company office (Subject to change based on business needs) . The shift schedule for this position is Monday-Friday, 12 p.m.-8 p.m. PST.
