job.title: VP, Financial Controller - SESAC (Nashville)
job.description: SESAC is seeking a VP, Financial Controller to join our team in Nashville. In this position you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the company’s accounting and financial reporting. This includes managing a multi-entity general ledger, overseeing the monthly close and management reporting, quarterly and annual financial statements, monitoring cash flow, and overseeing revenues, royalties and payroll processes. The role also involves developing and maintaining internal controls, supporting budgeting and forecasting, and ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies. As the Controller you will collaborate closely with leadership and operations teams to analyze financial performance, provide decision-support reporting, and recommend process improvements that enhance transparency and efficiency. This position includes supervising and mentoring accounting staff, coordinating with external auditors, and helping drive disciplined financial management across the organization. You will also serve as a tactical and operational partner to department leadership. What You Will Be Doing: Overseeing the SESAC accounting team and ensuring accurate and timely dissemination of financial management reports including, but not limited to, internal and external monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and annual audits/budgets. Establishing, maintaining and enhancing financial systems and controls that verify the integrity of all procedures, processes and data, including balance-sheet reconciliations, accrual completeness, variance analysis, etc. Overseeing revenue and royalty accounting, including revenue accruals, accounts receivable (aging, billings and cash application), bad debt, prepaid royalties, etc. Delivering management reports and analytics to Department Leadership and acting as a strategic partner by, responding to requests with accurate, timely work. Supporting the drafting and review of the annual financial statements, including oversight of group reporting packages from subsidiary finance teams for consolidation, intercompany settlements, etc. under US GAAP. Providing inspirational people leadership. Setting clear goals, delivering honest and constructive feedback, and taking an active role in developing talent at every level. Leading with empathy and high standards — holding the team accountable while championing their growth, well-being, and long-term success. Actively modeling and reinforcing a respectful, collaborative, and congenial workplace culture. Assuming positive intent, and holding yourself and the team to a standard of professional courtesy and mutual respect across all interactions. Evaluating the accounting team structure and existing processes for continual improvement in efficiency and effectiveness. Partnering with FP&A and business leadership on the annual budget and periodic forecast cycles, providing accounting input on assumptions, accruals, and variance drivers. Reviewing technical accounting memos, concluding on accounting positions, proposing the resulting journal entries, and presenting and defending conclusions with the external auditors. Assessing and leading adoption of new accounting standards as needed. Integrating and standardizing finance functions of entities acquired in a business combination. Owning and managing the relationship with the external auditors. What Makes You Qualified: Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration or equivalent experience. CPA required; MBA preferred. 5+ years' public accounting experience. 3+ years’ experience leading a team as a Financial Controller or Assistant Controller (or equivalent), including multi-entity and/or international consolidation experience. Strong experience of financial accounting, reporting, and general ledger management, consolidation of foreign entities, the differences between US GAAP and International GAAP (IFRS / local GAAP), and accounting for holding companies and multi-entity structures. Deep knowledge of financial statements under the US GAAP, including experience with revenue under ASC 606, complex debt accounting, business combination, leases, divestitures, etc. Experience with financial statements drafting preferred. Brings a global mindset and the interpersonal range to lead effectively across diverse teams, locations, cultures, and stakeholders. Ability to design, implement, and maintain effective internal controls, policies, and procedures for safeguarding company assets. Working knowledge of tax withholding compliance, regulatory reporting, and coordination with external auditors and financial institutions. Strong soft skills to lead and develop the finance team and collaborate cross functionally, with strong interpersonal skills and an ability to build relationships with colleagues at all levels. Self-starter with excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a problem solver who anticipates next steps and questions. Strong quantitative skillset and expert Excel user; hands-on with close and reporting systems (Oracle, ADP, Tipalti, Bill.com). Ability to establish priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Strong ethical conduct and an ability to maintain confidentiality. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn, adapt to, and embrace new technologies, with a track record of applying emerging tools and platforms to improve efficiency and drive results. Analytical thinker who thrives in a team environment, balancing independent problem-solving with a collaborative approach to reach effective outcomes. This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description: Sinclair's content technology is central to operational excellence and to connecting audiences with trusted news across broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms. TNND is seeking an experienced, technology-focused Chief Engineer to lead engineering for its national news production operation. This role owns the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle of TNND's live-production and media systems. The Chief Engineer leads the engineering team and turns operational needs into dependable workflows in partnership with editorial, production, operations, and Corporate technology teams. Networking, enterprise monitoring, cybersecurity, and shared-infrastructure decisions are Corporate-led; the Chief Engineer supplies broadcast requirements, supports implementation, and keeps TNND systems aligned with those standards. The successful candidate combines hands-on engineering depth with calm incident leadership, disciplined planning, and a service-oriented approach to daily live news. Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership and Operational Ownership • Own the end-to-end technical health and operational readiness of TNND's production environment, with direct accountability for reliable daily live output across an extended and variable schedule. • Lead, develop, schedule, and set priorities for engineering staff and technical support coverage; establish clear escalation paths and ensure appropriate on-call response for critical operations. • Serve as TNND's senior engineering subject-matter expert and incident leader, coordinating rapid restoration, clear stakeholder communication, and follow-through during high-pressure production events. • Partner with editorial, production, operations, Corporate IT, digital, cybersecurity, facilities, and distribution teams to align technical systems with newsroom priorities; serve as TNND's broadcast liaison for Corporate-led networking, monitoring, security, and shared infrastructure. • Translate business and production requirements into documented architectures, standards, operating procedures, project plans, lifecycle roadmaps, and budget recommendations. Live Production and Control-Room Systems • Engineer, maintain, and support the integrated control-room ecosystem, including cameras and robotics, production switchers, automated production control, real-time graphics, studio displays, audio consoles and processing, intercom/IFB, teleprompters, tally, routing, multiviewers, sync/reference, video servers, record/playback, encoders/decoders, and contribution/distribution interfaces. • Administer and optimize Ross OverDrive automated production control for live news, including show and template configuration, rundown execution, device control, graphics/audio/robotics coordination, NRCS/MOS integration, operator workflows, recalls/macros, and tested manual fallback procedures. • Support Ross XPression Tessera/Tessera One and related XPression workflows for pixel-accurate, synchronized content across studio displays and video walls, including region mapping, real-time graphics and data, external video inputs, signal timing, playout control, and recovery procedures. • Validate software, firmware, control, graphics, and workflow changes in a test or rehearsal process before air; maintain approved configuration baselines and rollback plans. • Work directly with directors, producers, operators, editors, and graphics teams to improve repeatability while preserving the flexibility required for breaking news and late rundown changes. Newsroom, Media, and Distribution Workflows • Maintain dependable integrations among the newsroom computer system (NRCS), MOS-connected tools, ingest, editing, media asset management, shared storage, archive, graphics, playout, and distribution systems. • Support live feeds, file-based media, remote contributors, streaming, and broadcast contribution/distribution workflows, including metadata, timing, caption/data paths, and SCTE signaling where applicable. • Partner with content and operations teams to strengthen editing, live-production, field-gathering, remote-production, and multi-platform publishing workflows without compromising on-air reliability. Broadcast Systems and Corporate Technology Integration • Serve as the broadcast liaison to Corporate-managed technology services: define operational requirements and support implementation and troubleshooting of LAN/WAN connectivity, VLANs, QoS, multicast, routing, DNS/DHCP, secure remote access, identity, and time synchronization under Corporate architecture and policy. • Support TNND's current baseband SDI and compressed-IP media workflows, maintaining practical knowledge of applicable contribution, distribution, audio-over-IP, and production protocols such as NDI, SRT/RIST, and AES67/Dante where deployed. • Administer broadcast-specific Windows, macOS, and Linux systems and applications, coordinating shared-infrastructure changes involving virtualization, storage, databases, cloud services where applicable, patching, backups, access control, endpoint protection, and security hardening with Corporate IT and cybersecurity. • Create and maintain accurate signal-flow drawings, network diagrams, rack elevations, system inventories, configuration records, credentials-handling procedures, and support documentation. Monitoring, Reliability, Redundancy, and Disaster Recovery • Maintain broadcast-facing monitoring and use Corporate-approved enterprise monitoring, telemetry, logging, alarming, and reporting tools so engineering and operations have appropriate visibility into system health, quality, and service status. • Design and maintain redundancy for critical workflows; define recovery priorities with stakeholders; document and regularly test failover, backup, restore, and disaster-recovery procedures. • Lead incident, problem, and change management for production technology, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, maintenance windows, risk communication, and post-incident learning. • Manage preventive maintenance, lifecycle replacement, spares, warranties, software support, service contracts, and vendor escalation to reduce avoidable outages and technical debt. Projects, Vendors, Budget, and Team Development • Assess business needs, evaluate solutions and vendors, develop technical requirements, and lead design, procurement, installation, commissioning, documentation, acceptance testing, and operational handoff for capital and workflow projects. • Develop and manage engineering budgets, forecasts, purchase planning, and expense tracking; present clear options, risks, and lifecycle implications to leadership. • Build strong vendor and corporate-technology relationships, manage escalations, and ensure that work performed by integrators and contractors meets TNND's technical and operational standards. • Coach engineers and technical users, create cross-training and coverage plans, and promote consistent troubleshooting, documentation, safety, and change-control practices. Required Qualifications • Five or more years of progressive experience in television news engineering, broadcast production technology, or an equivalent live-media environment, including demonstrated technical leadership. • Hands-on experience administering or supporting Ross OverDrive automated production control in a live-news environment, including rundown/NRCS integration, device control, show configuration, and troubleshooting under air-critical conditions. • Working expertise with Ross XPression Tessera or Tessera One and XPression-based graphics/display workflows, including multi-display playout, synchronization, signal flow, and operational recovery. • Broad control-room engineering experience with cameras, audio and video systems, production switchers, graphics, routing, multiviewers, intercom, playback/record systems, encoders/decoders, monitoring, and computing infrastructure. • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, baseband and compressed-IP media, shared storage, media workflows, and structured troubleshooting, plus sufficient networking and monitoring knowledge to support TNND workflows and collaborate with Corporate technology teams. • Proficiency supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms and diagnosing hardware, software, network, and workflow failures. • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational problems, make sound decisions under pressure, communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and carry corrective work through completion. • Associate degree or higher in information technology, electronics, computer science, broadcast engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience. • A collaborative, service-oriented leadership style and a consistent commitment to quality, reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with additional Ross platforms such as XPression, DashBoard/CustomPanels, Carbonite or Acuity production switchers, Ultrix/Ultriscape routing and multiviewing, openGear, or Ross Platform Manager. • Experience with MOS/NRCS integrations, Avid editing and media workflows, media asset management, shared storage, newsroom playout, and multi-platform distribution. • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other cloud-native services supporting all-cloud broadcast or media workflows. • Experience partnering with Corporate IT and cybersecurity on access, patching, centralized monitoring, endpoint protection, and secure vendor access for broadcast systems. • Familiarity with applicable FCC requirements, video streaming protocols, SCTE signaling, caption/data workflows, and emerging broadcast standards. • Relevant Avid (including ACSR), SBE, or comparable broadcast-technology certification. Work Expectations • Ability to work a flexible schedule and participate in on-call support, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage as operational needs require. • Ability to work in control rooms, studios, equipment rooms, offices, and other technical spaces and to safely lift and move computers and equipment generally weighing less than 50 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as applicable. The base salary compensation range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. job.title: Content Creator
job.description: We’re a fast-moving, idea-sparking, deadline-crushing content team embedded inside one of the most dynamic entertainment companies in the country. On the Agile Content Creation Engagement Team (ACCET), we develop branded content, commercial creative, and social-first video that connects — emotionally and instantly. We are looking for a Content Creator to join our group! Our mission? Bring bold ideas to life across every screen. Whether we’re building campaigns for clients, developing killer creative for digital platforms, or producing memorable branded moments, our content doesn’t just fill space — it makes noise. WHAT YOU’LL DO: As a Content Creator, you’ll concept, write, shoot, and edit creative that stops thumbs, turns heads, and drives action. You’ll collaborate with a passionate crew of makers who understand that great storytelling is part emotion, part strategy, and all hustle. YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST: • Produce scroll-stopping, channel-agnostic content for TV, social, web, and wherever audiences are paying attention. • Partner with digital strategists and creative leads to develop work that aligns with brand goals and audience needs. • Write scripts, shoot footage, and edit everything from fast-turn social reels to longer-form branded videos. • Work directly with internal teams and external clients to bring visions to life. • Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront. WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE: • A passion for visual storytelling with a marketing mindset. • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud — especially Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator. • Camera skills and lighting savvy that make your footage shine. • A collaborative spirit with the confidence to lead a concept or run a solo shoot. • A portfolio that proves you can do the job — and push it further. job.title: Content Producer/Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description: About Criminally Obsessed: With 1,400 reporters spread across the country, Criminally Obsessed is first on the scene, uniting armchair detectives in their quest to crack the case. From short videos to long-form documentaries, our team of content producers and editors reaches millions daily across all our social media and digital platforms. Job Summary: You’ll pitch, research, script, edit, and produce compelling true crime content while working with reporters, researchers, newsrooms, and original sources to uncover the details that make a case truly captivating. As someone who’s obsessed with true crime, you’ll help create original, multi-platform true crime programming — from quick-turn and short-form videos to creator-led features, visual storytelling, and recurring franchises — with a focus on strong hooks, distinctive storytelling, and content audiences want to watch and share. This role requires a strong journalism background, expertise in video production, graphic design, and an innate ability to connect with true crime audiences across platforms. Travel may be required for content gathering, breaking news coverage, and professional development. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Original Content & Brand Franchises Attend Content Strategy Sessions to pitch and develop original, social-first true crime content, including short- and mid-form narrative stories and ideas that strengthen Criminally Obsessed content buckets and recurring franchises. Review assigned Sinclair markets, outside news sources, broadcasts, digital stories, raw footage, court coverage, social media and other relevant material to identify compelling stories and content opportunities. Monitor breaking crime events, press conferences, hearings, trials, livestreams and other major developments to identify timely coverage opportunities. Stay current on true crime trends, conversations and releases by regularly consuming relevant documentaries, series, podcasts, books, news coverage and social content, and bring those insights into pitches and content development. Lead reviews and coverage of true crime streaming content, including documentaries, series and other relevant releases, bringing a strong editorial perspective to Criminally Obsessed audiences. Serve as on-camera talent for breaking true crime news and major developments as needed, delivering timely, credible and engaging coverage across Criminally Obsessed platforms. Support Criminally Obsessed programming as backup on-camera talent for Anne and other hosts or franchises as assigned. Research, Reporting & Asset Gathering Research and report stories using public records and reporting tools, including court documents, PACER, FOIA requests, archival materials, reputable outside media sources and direct outreach. Actively pursue story leads, verify facts and gather the video, documents, images, interviews, social media posts and other assets needed to complete assigned content. Manage permissions and clearances for third-party video, images, social media content and other assets while coordinating with Sinclair news teams and outside organizations. Proactively communicate reporting needs, asset limitations, clearance issues, production delays, deadline risks and other potential blockers. Content Production & Platform Execution Pitch, script, shoot, present and edit original video content, and create supporting visual assets for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and other Criminally Obsessed platforms. Produce mid-form narrative and creator-led content while contributing quick-turn, short-form and daily news coverage based on editorial priorities. Create platform-specific videos, social graphics, thumbnails and promotional assets that follow Criminally Obsessed brand guidelines. Take ownership of assigned content from approval through completion, meeting editorial and production deadlines and ensuring all required publishing elements are prepared for delivery. Content Performance Review social and digital performance metrics and use audience insights to improve story selection, topics, hooks, formats, pacing, presentation and overall content performance. Apply performance insights to refine recurring content buckets and franchises, strengthen successful formats and identify new content opportunities for Criminally Obsessed audiences. KEY DELIVERABLES Review assigned Sinclair markets and relevant outside sources each morning. Submit 3-5 developed story pitches by 9:30 a.m. EST each day, identifying the proposed content bucket, audience hook/CO angle, available assets, key details, latest developments and recommended treatment. Produce 3–5 quick-turn or short-form in-feed videos and 2 mid-form narrative videos each week, with an emphasis on creator-led and on-camera storytelling. Complete a minimum of 5 videos per week. Maintain an active pipeline of original mid-form, on-camera and franchise ideas rather than relying solely on assigned content. Meet all assigned deadlines and communicate proactively when reporting, assets, clearances or other issues could put a deadline at risk. Once immediate assignments are delivered, proactively identify additional stories, pursue leads, gather assets, review upcoming coverage dates and deadlines, and prepare future productions. ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES Perform other job-related duties as assigned by the manager. Assigned schedule is generally 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. EST, including a one-hour meal break and two 15-minute breaks. Hours may flex based on business needs, including occasional after-hours or weekend coverage when warranted. Overtime must be approved in advance by a manager. Occasional travel, approximately 10–20%, may be required for conferences, training, content gathering, breaking news or on-site coverage. Must be able to safely lift, carry and maneuver equipment or gear weighing up to 25 pounds while following proper safety protocols. The base salary compensation range for this role is $70,000 to $90,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, quarterly and annual incentive plan bonuses, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Coordinator, Human Resources
job.description: We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced HR Coordinator to work for a dynamic media company, KUTV-TV! The HR Coordinator will help grow our team and be responsible for direct support and guidance in various functional areas of human resources, supporting the KUTV station employees. The ideal candidate has a minimum of two years of experience in human resources working in a fast-paced environment. Positive attitude, effective communication, follow-through, and attention to detail are must-have attributes for this position. The HR Coordinator supports processes associated with the employee lifecycle: recruitment, onboarding/exiting, benefits administration, training and development, and performance management. While no day will be the same, you’ll be involved in a variety of HR functions including but not limited to: Collaborate in a team-based environment, providing excellent, friendly, and responsive HR customer service to employees and managers. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our people, work, and culture. Ensure compliance with employment regulations, including, but not limited to, FMLA, FLSA, Worker’s Compensation, ADA, and EEO. Interpret and apply policies and procedures. Function as a liaison between managers and Regional HR Manager on employee relations matters, including disciplinary matters, complaints, and investigations. Coordinate onboarding and offboarding exiting processes, including presenting and gathering information. Support the recruitment process, i.e., post jobs in recruiting system, prepare offer letters, initiate background screening, etc. Ensure compliance with applicable regulations in all aspects of recruitment and hiring. Coordinate pre-employment processes, handle timely and professional communications with candidates, maintain tracking records, and follow through on all pre-employment requirements. Support the benefits administration process by maintaining working knowledge of company benefit plans, assist in the annual Open Enrollment process including employee education and communication, and participate in audits as needed. Support the performance management process and review process including compliance tracking and audits. Administer leave of absence cases according to company policy, benefits and state and local laws. Respond to unemployment claims, workers compensation claims, and employment verifications. Maintain electronic HR records, including personnel records. Assist in planning and coordinating team trainings, morale events, and activities. Perform other related duties and projects as required and assigned. Maintain strict confidentiality. This position is an onsite role. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related program of study Minimum of two years of HR experience Proficient in Microsoft Office Strong interpersonal, communication and multi-tasking skills with the ability to effectively communicate with employees at all levels, both verbally and in writing. Ability to exhibit a high degree of confidentiality and proper judgement under pressure and in sensitive situations. A positive attitude and high level of commitment to execution of job duties. Organizational and time management skills with expert attention to detail. Oracle HRIS experience a plus. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Digital Content Coordinator
job.description: At Sinclair Broadcast Group, our mission is to connect people with content everywhere – and a core part of this mission involves social media. job.title: Director, Production Finance
job.description: Tennis Channel is seeking a hands-on Director, Production Finance to lead and manage production budgeting, forecasting, accounting, controls, reporting, and continuous improvement across Tennis Channel production activities. This role sits within Tennis Channel Corporate Finance & Accounting and reports to the Controller / VP Finance, serving primarily as the finance partner in support of the head of production & programming and the related teams across live events, studio productions, original content, digital initiatives, creative, and production operations. The head of production & programming owns the department budget, including creative budgets; the Director role supports that responsibility through production-related financial management, reporting, analysis, and decision support. The Director will work closely with Production, Programming, Rights & Acquisitions, Creative, Operations, Legal, HR and Finance & Accounting, as needed, to support the production-related financial responsibilities. This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA. In this role, you will… Lead Strategic Production Finance & Planning Prepare annual production budgets, quarterly forecasts and long-range plans. Build financial models for productions/tournaments, seasonal coverage plans, and production cost centers to support staffing, resource allocation, and investment decisions. Lead PickleballTV joint venture production-related forecasting, actualization, and variance analysis in coordination with production leadership and Finance & Accounting. Prepare financial support for go/no-go decisions, cash flow, production economics, and financial risks. Oversee Production Accounting & Financial Controls Lead production accounting, including job costing, accruals, amortization, and close support. Track production costs, commitments, vendor obligations, and talent costs to support accurate reporting. Review production payables and purchasing card activity for proper coding, approvals, and controls. Prepare forecast updates and cost variance explanations for FP&A, Accounting, and Production. Drive Business Analytics & Executive Reporting Prepare KPI dashboards, forecast packages, cost summaries, and recurring reports for the Head of Production & Programming to support production planning, cost visibility, and decision making. Conduct post-event production cost reviews to explain variances, capture planning takeaways, and recommend improvements for upcoming productions. Summarize production financial insights for executive reporting and upcoming production planning. Champion Continuous Improvement Improve budgeting, forecasting, accounting, reporting quality, forecast accuracy, and decision support. Develop cost benchmarks, productivity metrics, savings trackers, and performance indicators across productions, vendors, staffing, travel, and operations. Implement automation, AI-enabled tools, templates, and reporting improvements to increase efficiency and financial visibility. Manage Financial Governance & Oversight Review production agreements, vendor arrangements, talent commitments, and related documents for financial terms, budget impact, cost tracking, and risks in support of the Head of Production & Programming. Coordinate with Legal, HR, Treasury, Tax, and Accounting as needed on production-related financial risks, labor costs, international requirements, cash flow, and compliance. Support international productions, including foreign costs, tax/VAT, payment timing, currency exposure, and compliance impacts. Maintain practical governance, controls, and processes that support growth, compliance, cost discipline, and operational effectiveness. Provide Leadership & Team Development Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and support to the Production Finance team. Set priorities, goals, development plans, and operating rhythms. Foster accountability, collaboration, financial discipline, improvement, and data-driven decision making. Key Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field. CPA preferred. 8+ years of progressive experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Media Finance, FP&A, or related disciplines. Experience in live production, sports media, entertainment, streaming, digital media, or content businesses preferred. Strong hands-on financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, accounting, controls, reporting, and analytical skills. Experience with project accounting, production costing, close support, operational budgets, and cost governance. Ability to partner with operational leaders and translate financial data into business recommendations. Experience with ERP/project costing systems, production accounting tools, Excel, and BI reporting; Oracle experience preferred. Strong communication, leadership, judgment, business partnership, and stakeholder management skills. Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. job.title: Director, YouTube Strategy and Operations
job.description: Sinclair is seeking an experienced YouTube Platform Lead to help own the strategy, performance, and operational excellence of our YouTube presence across podcasts, news stations, and social-first brands. This is a specialized platform leadership role, not a general social production position. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in how YouTube works as a distribution, discovery, and monetization engine. They understand content ID, copyright management, audience development, packaging, analytics, and revenue optimization at a level that allows them to shape strategy and improve performance across a broad portfolio of channels and brands. This person will help define how Sinclair uses YouTube to grow audiences, extend brand reach and generate revenue across news, sports and entertainment content. Key Responsibilities Serve as Sinclair’s internal subject matter expert on YouTube and help oversee YouTube strategy across podcasts, news stations, and social verticals, including channel architecture, programming, and publishing strategy. Build platform-specific growth strategies for each brand and content type, balancing reach, retention, frequency, and monetization. Partner closely with sales, editorial, production, social, legal, and product leadership to ensure YouTube is integrated into Sinclair’s broader digital strategy. Analyze KPIs such as views, watch time, CTR, retention, subscriber growth, RPM, revenue, and other key metrics to guide overall YouTube strategy. Translate platform changes, policy updates, and algorithmic shifts into actionable guidance for teams across the organization. Develop monetization strategies that maximize revenue while protecting brand safety, content rights, and long-term channel health. Create repeatable operating processes and training that help producers, editors, and channel managers build content that performs well on YouTube. Represent Sinclair in conversations with vendors, partners, creators, and internal stakeholders as the lead subject matter expert on YouTube. Qualifications 5+ years of experience working directly with YouTube in a strategy, operations, programming, growth, or monetization role. Deep understanding of YouTube ecosystem, including content ID, rights management, monetization rules, policy enforcement, and audience growth. Demonstrated success improving channel performance through better packaging, publishing strategy, analytics, and content optimization. Strong fluency with YouTube Analytics and related performance dashboards, with the ability to turn platform data into clear strategy and operating guidance. Experience working across editorial, legal, business, sales, and technical teams in a matrixed environment. Strong judgment, attention to detail, and comfort making decisions in a fast-moving, high-volume content operation. Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, with the discipline to build process and the flexibility to respond to platform changes quickly. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Experience managing a portfolio of YouTube channels at scale. Experience in news, podcasts, entertainment or sports environments a plus. Success in this role means Sinclair’s YouTube ecosystem becomes more intentional, more scalable, and more profitable. The YouTube Platform Lead will help us grow the right audiences, improve content performance and build a smarter operating model for one of our important distribution channels. job.title: Media Manager (Input)
job.description: Are you a strategic operations leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-volume environments? Do you enjoy turning complex workflows into clear, efficient systems—and helping teams perform at their best through change? The Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) is seeking an experienced Media Manager (Input) to lead and continuously improve centralized input operations across multiple markets. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible not only for daily execution, but for setting the operational direction that improves efficiency, consistency, capacity, and service across the organization. As Media Manager (Input), you will lead Senior Log Coordinators and Log Coordinators responsible for contracts, traffic, copy, reporting, and daily log execution. You will serve as the strategic operational connection between leadership, stations, output teams, and production partners—ensuring the work is prioritized, resources are used effectively, issues are resolved quickly, and processes evolve as the business grows. The ideal candidate is equal parts people leader, process strategist, and problem-solver: someone who can manage today’s operational needs while building smarter, more scalable ways of working for tomorrow. What You Will Do: Lead day-to-day execution for centralized input and log coordination teams across multiple markets, ensuring quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery. Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and accountability standards that keep work moving effectively in a fast-paced environment. Lead, coach, and develop Senior Log Coordinators and Log Coordinators, creating a high-performing team grounded in collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. Own staffing allocation, workload balancing, capacity planning, and coverage strategies to ensure the team can meet changing business needs. Oversee contracts, traffic, copy, reporting, inventory-related workflows, and other input functions to maintain operational continuity and accuracy. Analyze workflows, performance metrics, recurring issues, and team capacity to identify bottlenecks and implement practical, measurable improvements. Design and refine standardized processes, documentation, and best practices that reduce unnecessary variation and improve consistency across markets. Partner closely with ACCET leadership, Output teams, production, station stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to align workflows with broader business priorities. Translate operational needs into clear process solutions, helping shape system enhancements, automation opportunities, and future workflow modernization. Lead resolution of complex operational issues, balancing urgency with thoughtful decision-making and clear communication. Support major initiatives, new workflows, and organizational changes by developing scalable implementation plans and guiding teams through adoption. Build a culture of continuous improvement where team members are encouraged to identify opportunities, share knowledge, and help strengthen the operation. This Role is for you if: You are a strategic, hands-on leader who can see both the daily operational details and the larger business opportunity. You have a strong track record of improving workflows, building structure, and leading teams through change. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities, and resolving escalations in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You know how to use data, metrics, and team feedback to identify inefficiencies and improve performance. You are an effective coach who sets clear expectations, develops talent, and creates accountability without losing the human side of leadership. You communicate clearly and confidently with team members, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners. You are highly organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of quality or customer service. You are energized by building scalable systems and finding better ways to get work done. Experience with OSI, broadcast traffic systems, media operations, or multi-market workflows is strongly preferred. Broadcast television, media operations, traffic, or related operational leadership experience is preferred. Why You’ll Love It Here: Lead a growing centralized operation with the opportunity to directly shape how work is done across the organization. Drive meaningful improvements that make teams more efficient, consistent, and prepared to scale. Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation, operational excellence, and shared success. Build systems and processes that have a visible, organization-wide impact. Grow your leadership career in a dynamic, evolving multi-market media environment. Schedule: Monday–Friday | Standard Business Hours Ready to lead smarter, more efficient media operations? Apply now and help shape the future of ACCET Operations. job.title: Multimedia Journalist (MMJ)
job.description: KVII/KVIH is looking for a Multi-Media Journalist with a starting salary of $50,000 ($24.04/hr)! We are seeking a driven, curious, and community-minded journalist who understands that advocacy journalism is not a side project for us — it is who we are. This position is for someone who wants to do more than cover the news of the day. We are looking for a storyteller who is committed to asking tough questions, holding the powerful accountable, giving a voice to the voiceless, and following stories until they lead to answers, action, or change. Our best journalism identifies problems in the communities we serve and pushes for solutions. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can enterprise impactful local stories, develop strong sources, shoot and edit compelling video, and write clearly for broadcast and digital platforms. You should be comfortable working independently, turning daily content under deadline, and digging deeper when a story demands more context, follow-up, or accountability. Responsibilities include: Covering daily news, breaking news, and enterprise stories across the Texas Panhandle and surrounding communities Pitching and producing advocacy-focused stories that identify community concerns, expose problems, and seek meaningful responses Shooting, writing, editing, and presenting stories for television, digital, and social platforms Developing sources and building trust with viewers, community members, and local leaders Following up on stories to make sure questions are answered and concerns are not forgotten Using social media and digital tools to find stories, engage audiences, and expand the reach of our journalism Required skills and qualifications: Strong writing, storytelling, and news judgment Ability to shoot and edit video Comfortable reporting live and working under deadline pressure A commitment to accuracy, fairness, and ethical journalism A passion for local news and serving the community Strong communication and organizational skills A valid driver’s license and clean driving record Previous newsroom experience or a journalism degree is preferred, but we are most interested in candidates who are hungry to learn, eager to grow, and committed to making a difference through their reporting. Advocacy journalism is central to our mission. We believe local journalism should help people, demand accountability, and shine a light on issues that matter. We are looking for an MMJ who shares that purpose and wants their work to have impact. While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel. job.title: Product Manager
job.description: The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle management for a portfolio of enterprise applications that includes both custom-developed solutions and third-party SaaS or packaged products. This role partners with business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and support teams to deliver measurable business value, maintain reliable operations, and evolve products in line with user needs and enterprise priorities. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and maintain product vision, roadmaps, and outcome-based priorities for assigned applications. Balance new capabilities, technical debt, operational stability, compliance, and user experience. Stakeholder Partnership and Discovery: Engage business users and leaders to understand workflows, pain points, opportunities, and success measures. Translate insights into clear, actionable requirements and product decisions. Portfolio and Backlog Management: Own and prioritize the product backlog using business value, risk, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment. Ensure planned work is sufficiently refined for delivery teams and stakeholders have transparent visibility into priorities. Custom Application Delivery: Work closely with internal development, QA, architecture, and delivery teams throughout discovery, design, development, testing, release, and adoption. Provide timely decisions and clarifications during Agile ceremonies. Third-Party Application Management: Lead the business and product relationship for third-party applications, including vendor coordination, release-impact assessment, roadmap alignment, support escalation, and evaluation of configuration or enhancement opportunities. Requirements and Product Artifacts: Create and maintain product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, user experience mock-ups, release communications, and other artifacts needed to align delivery and business teams. Operational Ownership: Partner with production support and vendors to monitor service health, triage issues, communicate business impact, and prioritize corrective work. Help ensure a disciplined transition from delivery to sustainable support. Validation and Adoption: Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing, gather feedback, validate outcomes, and support rollout readiness, training, and adoption activities. Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Define and use product, operational, and adoption metrics to assess performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement. Required Experience and Skills Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business, computer science, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered. Five or more years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or comparable experience supporting enterprise applications. Experience managing a mix of custom-developed applications, integrations and third-party SaaS or packaged software. Strong ability to turn business needs into well-structured requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands using data, business value, risk, and operational impact. Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Comfort working with software vendors on product roadmaps, support escalations, releases, and enhancement requests. Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to lead through influence rather than formal authority. Ability to understand and troubleshoot complex software workflows and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. A customer-focused, curious, adaptable approach and commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting enterprise business systems in a complex, multi-stakeholder organization. Experience with product analytics, service management, or application lifecycle management tools (Azure DevOps experience preferred). Experience coordinating Tier 2 support activities and working across internal delivery teams and external vendors. Other duties as assigned. This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute. Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc. Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description: This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here. We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) Help Brands Thrive: Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision. Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients. Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success. What We're Looking For Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution. A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)! We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization. A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key. The Practical Stuff A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding. The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city. Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise. AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Creative Producer, Original Content
job.description: AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue. We are seeking a Senior Creative Producer, Original Content to develop, produce, and launch original, audience-first video and social franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that expand our shows beyond the core podcast, drive audience growth, and increase the long-term value of our talent and show IP. Partnering closely with leadership, content, social, production, and marketing, this role will proactively identify programming opportunities, pitch new concepts, and own approved projects from idea through delivery. They will also work with individual show teams to develop more creative, visual, and repeatable in-show formats designed to perform across YouTube, social, and the broader digital ecosystem. The ideal candidate is a highly creative video-first producer and director with exceptional original content instincts and the production experience to turn ambitious ideas into finished programming. They are a creator and storyteller, and understand how talent-led digital brands grow across YouTube and social platforms. They should be equally comfortable developing a franchise, directing talent in the field, managing a production budget and external crew, or helping a show producer build a stronger recurring segment. Strong hands-on video production skills are required. What You’ll Do Proactively develop, pitch, and produce premium original video franchises, recurring series, tentpole concepts, and shoulder programming built around AMP Sports shows and talent designed to drive audience growth. Own creative process from concept through delivery, including development, ideation, pre-production through post-production, and final delivery. Partner with show producers to level up existing programming through creative concepts designed to improve audience growth, retention, and engagement. Extend the AMP Sports talent and show IP beyond the core podcast, with a particular focus on premium YouTube video, repeatable franchises, and original concepts. Own the entire production process of original video content in, studio, field, and remote environments, maintaining a high standard of creative and technical execution. Direct on-camera talent, athletes, and creators in studio and on location, with the ability to shape story, conversation, performance, and creative execution. Lead post-production process, partner with editors and post-production teams to shape narrative through the edit, providing creative direction on larger projects. Ideate original programming built for discovery, distribution, and growth across YouTube and social platforms; use audience and performance insights to inform creative decisions. Work with show leads to develop and maintain a pipeline of programming ideas and opportunities; consult on new show launches and talent development when appropriate. Serve as a flexible senior creative resource across the portfolio, with the ability to step into lead producer responsibilities when needed. Assist developing and managing project budgets, and hire and oversee freelance production teams, vendors, and other external resources to execute approved concepts. Other duties as assigned. Who You Are 7+ years producing premium original digital video for a media or production company, sports or entertainment brand, agency, creator-led business, or similar. A highly creative developer and storyteller, with a proven track record of originating compelling programming, video concepts, recurring franchises, or similar and bringing them from concept through execution across YouTube, long-form video, social, and other digital platforms. A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional creative instincts and format development skills across premium digital content. Expertise producing, shooting, and editing content in both field and studio environments across a variety of formats. Exceptional storytelling skills and editorial instincts, with the ability to identify compelling narratives and turn those into high value content that connects with audiences. Experience directing on-camera talent, creators, athletes, and high-profile personalities, maximizing their skillsets. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (or similar), as well as hands-on production skills with cameras, lighting, microphones, etc. in field, studio, and remote settings. Strong understanding of social and YouTube best practices, audience retention, content packaging, SEO, and how content is consumed by audience across platforms. A self-starter, highly collaborative, and able to lead and work across multiple teams while also working independently without oversight. Someone who has a strong passion for creating digital-first content that cuts through the noise and drives significant audience growth. Experience developing and managing production budgets, and onboarding and managing freelancers, vendors, and other external resources is a plus. Highly organized and communicative, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring all projects stay on timeline and all key stakeholders are involved. job.title: Senior Manager, Integrated and Experiential Marketing
job.description: Sinclair is seeking a highly organized, solutions-oriented Senior Manager, Integrated and Experiential Marketing to lead the planning and execution of live events, experiential activations, brand experiences and campaigns, as well as hospitality programs for our podcast division. Reporting to the AVP, Marketing, this role will serve as the operational and marketing lead responsible for bringing activations and campaigns from concept to execution. The Senior Manager will oversee event logistics, production, vendors, venues, budgets, timelines, staffing, talent requirements, campaign management and on-site operations while partnering closely with Marketing, Creative, Content, Sales, podcast talent, and external production partners. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-moving live environments and combines strong event production and campaign experience with exceptional project management, financial discipline, and attention to detail. This individual is equally comfortable building a production timeline, managing vendors and budgets, troubleshooting on site, coordinating talent and VIP experiences, and collaborating with marketing teams to ensure each activation delivers against brand, audience, and business objectives. This role requires hands-on involvement and travel for events and activations as needed. Responsibilities Live Event & Experiential Operations Lead end-to-end operational planning and execution for live podcast events, experiential activations, consumer experiences, hospitality programs, partner events, and other priority brand moments. Translate event concepts into detailed operational and production plans, including timelines, staffing plans, production schedules, run-of-show documents, budgets, vendor requirements, and on-site execution plans. Manage venue sourcing and coordination, including site visits, contracts, production requirements, load-in/load-out schedules, venue rules, security, access, catering, parking, and other logistical needs. Coordinate technical and production requirements including audio, lighting, staging, video, scenic, signage, power, internet, livestreaming, recording, and other event infrastructure. Oversee event vendors and production partners from sourcing and bidding through contracting, execution, invoicing, and reconciliation. Develop and maintain comprehensive event timelines, production schedules, contact sheets, run-of-show documents, floor plans, credentialing plans, and other operational materials. Lead on-site event operations, serving as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, talent, vendors, venues, production teams, and partners. Anticipate operational risks and develop contingency plans to address production, talent, venue, weather, technology, staffing, and other potential event challenges. Coordinate event staffing, security, registration, guest management, hospitality, transportation, catering, and other event services as required. Partner with appropriate internal and external stakeholders to ensure events meet applicable safety, accessibility, permitting, insurance, and venue requirements. Podcast Talent & Guest Experience Partner with podcast teams and talent representatives to understand and execute talent requirements for live events and appearances. Coordinate talent schedules, green rooms, transportation, credentials, hospitality, rehearsals, backstage operations, and other on-site needs. Support the development and delivery of high-quality audience, talent, client, partner, and VIP experiences. Maintain discretion and professionalism when working with high-profile talent, clients, executives, and external partners. Experiential & Brand Activations Partner with Marketing, Creative, Content, Social, Sales, and podcast teams to operationalize experiential concepts and bring brand experiences to life. Help evaluate concepts for operational feasibility, production requirements, timing, budget, scalability, and audience experience. Ensure physical activations accurately and consistently reflect brand strategy, creative direction, sponsorship commitments, and program objectives. Identify opportunities to enhance the attendee experience through thoughtful programming, production, hospitality, technology, content capture, and physical environment. Lead campaigns from initial strategy and concept development through execution, optimization, and post-campaign analysis. Develop clear campaign objectives, audience strategies, messaging, channel plans, timelines, and KPIs. Collaborate with Marketing and Content teams to support opportunities to extend live experiences through social, digital, video, audio, and other channels. Client & Partner Activations Partner with Sales and Marketing teams on sponsored experiences, client activations, custom events, and integrated partnership programs. Translate sold concepts and sponsorship commitments into clear operational deliverables and production requirements. Participate in client and partner meetings when appropriate to communicate event plans, production considerations, timelines, and execution details. Track sponsorship and partner deliverables to ensure contractual event elements are executed accurately. Build strong working relationships with clients, agencies, venues, production companies, fabricators, experiential agencies, and other external partners. Budget & Vendor Management Develop and manage project-level event and activation budgets in partnership with Marketing leadership and Finance. Solicit and evaluate vendor bids, negotiate costs and scopes of work, and identify opportunities to maximize production value while maintaining financial discipline. Manage purchase orders, contracts, invoices, deposits, vendor payments, expense tracking, forecasts, and post-event reconciliation. Maintain accurate budget trackers and communicate financial risks, changes, and opportunities throughout the lifecycle of each event. Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the operational owner for multiple simultaneous events, campaigns and activations, establishing clear timelines, responsibilities, dependencies, and deliverables. Lead regular production and planning meetings with internal stakeholders and external partners. Proactively identify roadblocks, resolve issues, and communicate changes that could impact scope, budget, timing, or execution. Maintain organized event documentation, vendor records, production materials, budgets, contracts, and post-event reporting. Conduct post-event debriefs and document key learnings, operational improvements, and recommendations for future programs. Contribute to broader Marketing and podcast division initiatives, special projects, and live-event strategy as needed. Requirements 5–7 years of experience in live event production, integrated marketing, experiential marketing, event operations, entertainment production, or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing complex live events and experiential activations from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation. Strong knowledge of event production and operations, including venues, AV, staging, lighting, audio, scenic, staffing, hospitality, transportation, security, and event logistics. Proven ability to manage multiple vendors, production partners, venues, and workstreams simultaneously. Strong project management skills with experience developing production timelines, run-of-show documents, budgets, staffing plans, and detailed operational plans. Experience managing event budgets, vendor estimates, purchase orders, invoices, forecasts, and financial reconciliation. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed and make sound decisions in fast-paced live-event environments. Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Exceptional organization and attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through. Ability to collaborate effectively across Marketing, Creative, Content, Sales, Production, Finance, talent teams, and external partners. Ability and willingness to travel and work evenings, weekends, and nontraditional hours as required by event schedules. Experience working with talent, creators, athletes, celebrities, executives, clients, or VIP guests is preferred. Experience in podcasts, media, entertainment, sports, experiential marketing, or live events is strongly preferred. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Event Management, Production, Business, or a related field preferred. The base salary compensationrange for this roleis $110,000 to $130,000. job.title: Solutions Marketing Associate
job.description: The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations. For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings. This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting. The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared. What You’ll Do Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories. Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach. Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage. Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests. Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters. Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings. Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support. Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity. Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points. Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch. Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant. Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging. Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager. Sales Alignment & Enablement Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points. Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate. Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team. Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities. What Success Looks Like Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out. Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations. Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development. Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers. The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support. What You Bring 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role. Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges. Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment. Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs. Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests. A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed. Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus. Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement. job.title: Solutions Marketing Manager
job.description: The Solutions Marketing Manager leads the team responsible for turning customer challenges into insight-led, differentiated solutions. This role is both a people leader and a senior strategic partner to Sales, setting the standard for how the organization approaches complex opportunities, RFPs/RFIs, and high-priority client conversations. Rather than starting with a product or a predetermined activation, the Manager starts with the customer: What are they trying to accomplish? What does the market tell us? Which combination of capabilities can best address the challenge? And what is the most compelling story for why Digital Remedy can solve it? The Manager owns the strategic approach for the most complex opportunities while building a team and operating model that gives Sales the right level of support across the pipeline. What You’ll Do Lead Customer & Opportunity Strategy Partner with Sales on complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities to identify the underlying customer business and marketing challenge. Lead problem-led solution development that combines multiple products, audiences, platforms, media types, and services around specific customer needs. Define the strategic angle, narrative architecture, and recommendation for major pitches, RFPs, and RFIs. Challenge briefs and assumptions constructively when a stronger strategic approach can improve the opportunity. Translate customer objectives, audiences, KPIs, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations. Build Strategic Narratives & Solutions Develop executive-level client narratives that connect challenge, insight, strategy, solution, proof, and expected outcome. Ensure recommendations are integrated solutions rather than collections of disconnected capabilities. Lead custom research and insight development where it can materially strengthen the strategy. Simplify complex capabilities into persuasive stories for senior client and agency audiences. Lead quarterly business reviews for top strategic accounts, setting the standard for how the team frames performance, insight, and forward-looking recommendations that shape the client relationship. Lead the Solutions Marketing Team Manage, coach, and develop the Solutions Marketing Analyst and Solutions Marketing Associate. Establish intake, prioritization, routing, and quality standards so the team deploys strategic resources where they can have the greatest revenue impact. Create clear escalation paths from scalable sales support to custom strategy and executive-level opportunity support. Build the team’s skills in customer discovery, research, storytelling, strategic thinking, presentation development, and sales partnership. Measure team impact through pipeline support, meetings created, opportunity outcomes, turnaround time, and seller adoption, not presentation volume alone. Partner Across Marketing & Sales Work closely with the Marketing Manager, Product & Enablement to apply established positioning, messaging, GTM frameworks, proof points, and foundational materials to customer-specific opportunities. Provide feedback from live opportunities to Product & Enablement on recurring customer needs, competitive themes, content gaps, and emerging solution opportunities. Collaborate with Sales, Research, Product, Creative, and other subject-matter experts to assemble the right expertise around priority opportunities.
