job.title: Weekend Meteorologist Reporter
job.description: WSYX/WTTE, the market-leading news operation in Central Ohio, is looking for a dynamic Weekend Meteorologist/Reporter to join our award-winning weather team. This isn't just a weekend weather job. We're looking for someone who understands that weather is one of the biggest drivers of audience engagement across television, streaming, digital, social media, and mobile platforms. You'll be responsible for delivering accurate, compelling forecasts while helping our newsroom own severe weather coverage, producing impactful weather-related stories, and reporting on issues that matter to the communities we serve. As part of our commitment to innovation, you'll also have access to Central Ohio's only augmented reality weather presentation system —a market-exclusive forecasting tool that allows our meteorologists to create immersive, visually compelling weathercasts that help viewers better understand the forecast and stay safe during high-impact weather. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, confident in breaking weather situations, and passionate about serving our communities with clear, informative forecasting and compelling storytelling. What You'll Do Produce and present engaging weathercasts on ABC 6, FOX 28, streaming platforms, and digital channels. Utilize our market-exclusive augmented reality weather system to create innovative, immersive weather presentations that elevate storytelling and viewer understanding. Report from the field on weather events, breaking news, and enterprise stories that impact Central Ohio. Develop original weather-related and environmental stories that go beyond the daily forecast. Collaborate with newsroom leadership to identify and produce enterprise stories where weather intersects with public safety, transportation, infrastructure, health, agriculture, and community life. Deliver calm, confident coverage during severe weather and other high-impact weather events. Create original weather-related content for digital, social, streaming, and mobile platforms every day. Write and update forecasts for our website, mobile apps, and social media. Shoot, write, and edit stories as needed. Explain complex weather in a way that is easy for viewers to understand. Develop graphics that enhance storytelling and improve viewer understanding. Participate in community appearances, station initiatives, and public outreach events. Fill in on weekday newscasts and other shifts as needed. Looking For Someone Who Has exceptional forecasting skills and strong weather judgment. Is a journalist first and understands how weather affects people's daily lives. Thrives during severe weather coverage and can make quick, confident decisions under pressure. Is an engaging storyteller who can connect weather to the communities we serve. Understands today's audience consumes weather across television, streaming, digital, social, and mobile platforms. Can create compelling digital and social content that extends the life of every forecast. Enjoys experimenting with new technology and finding creative ways to enhance the viewer experience. Works collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented newsroom. Brings energy, curiosity, and a positive attitude every day. While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel. Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Journalism, or a related field (Meteorology preferred). AMS and/or NWA Seal or Certified Broadcast Meteorologist (CBM) designation preferred, or the ability to obtain. Three years of prior on-air forecasting experience preferred. Experience reporting, shooting, writing, and editing news stories is preferred. Strong knowledge of severe weather forecasting and live television. Experience with weather graphics systems and forecasting technology. Excellent communication, live reporting, and storytelling skills. Ability to work weekends, holidays, and flexible hours during breaking weather coverage. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY: Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: A&R Analyst - Sony Music Nashville
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As an A&R Analyst with Sony Music Nashville, you will have a central role in supporting our A&R team by providing important insights and data-driven evaluations on both rostered and undiscovered artists.

In this role, you will implement and manage data-driven methods to discover new artists, run daily reports to aid in artist discovery and analysis, construct statistical insights and predictive metrics, conduct research on artists and analyze new music – both signed and unsigned. This role is a unique opportunity to help the company discover our next superstars and help drive data-assisted decision making within the A&R team.

What you'll do:

  • Conduct research to evaluate new music and improve the A&R team’s understanding of new music metrics including social networking sites, data and analytics
  • Extract, prepare, analyze and present relevant music and social activity data to help identify new potential talent while also monitoring the marketplace and constructing new methods to draw insights from this data
  • Develop and implement new analytical processes, technologies and tools for use by the A&R team and other departments in support of trend identification, etc.
  • Regularly meet with A&R team to provide updates on activity and marketplace
  • Generate weekly reports and lead meetings to brief team on artists of interest
  • Work with internal teams as needed to create and troubleshoot queries, dashboards and other identification tools
  • Create artist-specific reports detailing audience growth and consumption relative to similar artists
  • Compile and monitor stream count and social media metrics for unsigned, undiscovered artists
  • Identify and interpret relevant data in the context of the current music landscape
  • Assess and summarize tendencies in consumption source across genres/subgenres

job.title: Associate Director, Audience Development - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard:

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director of Audience Development to join our New York-based Marketing Strategy & Audience Development team. This role will lead the day-to-day strategy and hands-on execution of first-party fan data acquisition campaigns (email & SMS), with a particular focus on building high-intent email and SMS audiences that can be converted into e-commerce merchandise buyers & beyond.

Reporting to the Vice President, Audience Development, this role combines strategic thinking, hands-on campaign execution and data-driven performance optimization. You’ll leverage proprietary technology, paid and organic marketing channels, live events and third-party audience tools to deliver measurable growth for artists and label partners across multiple genres and career stages.

Please note: This is a hands-on role that will occasionally require evening or weekend work to support priority releases & live events.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.

First-Party Data Acquisition Strategy

  • Partnering closely with our Marketing Strategists, you’ll lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists’ first-party fan audiences across email & SMS.
  • Use data to identify the right value exchange for each audience, including exclusive content, early merchandise access, contests, ticket presales, live-event activations and other fan experiences.
  • Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
  • Partner closely with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to ensure newly acquired fans enter CRM lifecycle journeys and receive a cohesive experience from initial sign-up through conversion and retention.

Campaign Execution & Optimization

  • Support our Marketing Strategists by owning the end-to-end execution of fan acquisition campaigns, including campaign planning, audience strategy, platform setup, landing pages, sign-up flows, testing, launch and performance reporting.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy & Global Paid Media teams to develop and optimize impactful paid lead-generation campaigns across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Establish testing frameworks and best practices across landing pages, forms, incentives, messaging and acquisition channels to improve both the volume and quality of acquired fans.

E-Commerce & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with D2C, CRM and Marketing Strategy teams to connect your acquisition campaigns to downstream product discovery, sales conversion and repeat-purchase opportunities.
  • Use transactional and behavioral data to identify the channels, campaigns and fan segments most likely to generate merchandise revenue.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to build clear handoff strategies that move newly acquired fans into personalized welcome, nurture and conversion journeys.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM and Global Paid Media to evaluate acquisition performance beyond initial sign-up volume, using metrics such as cost per acquired fan, subscriber quality, engagement, first-purchase conversion, revenue per acquired fan and return on investment.

Audience Insights, Measurement & Reporting

  • Develop reporting frameworks that connect fan acquisition activity to downstream engagement, streaming, ticketing and e-commerce outcomes.
  • Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
  • Analyze fan behavior to identify high-value audience segments, acquisition sources and conversion patterns.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for internal teams, artists and label partners.
  • Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.

Tools, Technology & Innovation

  • Oversee the strategic use of proprietary and third-party audience acquisition tools, landing-page platforms and CRM integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fan sign-up experiences, progressive data collection, audience segmentation, consent management and data enrichment.
  • Partner with Product, Design & Engineering teams to help guide the development of tools and features that improve first-party data acquisition and measurement.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy, Relationship Management, Fan Engagement & CRM, Privacy and Product, Design & Engineering teams to ensure acquisition campaigns comply with global privacy and consent requirements.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in evaluating and testing new fan acquisition technologies, platforms and partners.
  • Monitor emerging audience-development trends within music and across industries such as gaming, sports, television, film and retail.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Education

  • Partner with Relationship Management, Global Paid Media & Growth Strategy, Brand Marketing, Fan Engagement & CRM, D2C e-commerce and Marketing Strategy teams to integrate first-party data acquisition into artist campaigns.
  • Serve as an audience-development thought leader internally and as a trusted advisor to artist and label partners, providing best-practice guidance and data-driven recommendations.
  • Educate internal teams and clients on the role first-party fan data can play in driving long-term audience ownership and commercial growth.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in educating marketers across global markets on acquisition strategies appropriate to their local audiences, platforms, cultures and privacy requirements.
  • Help establish repeatable processes that make audience acquisition a consistent component of priority artist and release campaigns.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience within music, entertainment or another consumer-focused industry, including e-commerce experience.
  • Proven track record of growing first-party email and SMS audiences and connecting that growth to measurable business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing lead-generation campaigns across paid, organic, artist-owned and partner channels.
  • Experience with audience and marketing platforms such as Klaviyo, Laylo, Salesforce, Braze or similar tools, as well as e-commerce platforms like Shopify.
  • Understanding of conversion funnels, landing-page optimization, audience targeting, A/B testing and customer acquisition economics.
  • Deep understanding of first-party data strategy, including value exchange, audience segmentation, consent management and data privacy best practices such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using dashboards and KPI reporting to evaluate acquisition quality and downstream conversion.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator who can advise multiple stakeholders and translate complex audience strategies into clear, actionable plans.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic planning with detailed, hands-on campaign execution.
  • Passionate about music, fan behavior, e-commerce and the use of technology to build lasting artist-fan relationships.
  • Intrinsically motivated to find new and exciting ways to identify and acquire music fans, with a curious mindset and a strong desire to test, learn and scale successful approaches.
  • Comfortable working flexible hours when needed to support our partners, live events and high-priority releases.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Business and Legal Affairs Manager, The Orchard
job.description:
Bei The Orchard ist ab sofort eine Position im Bereich Business and Legal Affairs zu besetzen – an unserem Standort Berlin. Als Volljurist:in unterstützt Du das Tagesgeschäft und die rechtlichen Anforderungen unseres Business- und Legal-Affairs-Teams.

The Orchard ist ein führendes Unternehmen für Musikvertrieb und Artist Services mit Sitz in New York und in 45 Märkten weltweit tätig – im Vertrieb unabhängiger Künstler:innen wie Bad Bunny, Gorillaz und Raye. Mit modernsten Abläufen und einem einzigartigen globalen Team arbeiten wir mit Labels jeder Größe zusammen und machen deren Musik und Videos bei Hunderten von digitalen und physischen Händlern rund um den Globus verfügbar.

Leidenschaft für Musik und die Musikbranche ist ein Muss. Mit Deinem professionellen und souveränen Auftreten baust Du starke Beziehungen zu Kolleg:innen und externen Kund:innen auf und pflegst diese. Dafür schaffen wir ein angenehmes, offenes und inspirierendes Umfeld, das Produktivität und Kreativität fördert.

Das Team von The Orchard trifft sich von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro. Freitags wird in der Regel im Homeoffice gearbeitet.

Was du tun wirst:

  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertriebsverträgen mit Labels und Künstler:innen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Musikverlags- und Merchandising-Verträgen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertragsänderungen, Abtretungen und Kündigungen nach Bedarf.
  • Unterstützung bei Mergers & Acquisitions im deutschen Markt.
  • Beratung der Business- und globalen Legal-Teams zu Fragestellungen des deutschen Rechts und der hiesigen Praxis.
  • Mitarbeit im globalen Legal-Team, um Stakeholder:innen vor Ort rechtlich zu beraten.
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung, Optimierung und Aktualisierung von Standardvertragsmustern.
  • Mitverantwortung für die Bearbeitung und Beilegung rechtlicher Ansprüche.

Wer du bist:

  • Juristischer Abschluss und 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position und Branche.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Musikrechts.
  • Erfahrung mit Vertriebsverträgen.

  • Ausgeprägt selbstständige Arbeitsweise und nachweisliche Erfahrung im erfolgreichen Abschluss von Deals.

English Translation:

The Orchard has an immediate opening in Business and Legal Affairs at our Berlin office. As a qualified lawyer, you will support the day-to-day legal needs and requirements of our Business and Legal Affairs team.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution and artist services company headquartered in New York and operating in 45 markets worldwide – distributing music from independent artists including Bad Bunny, Gorillaz, and Raye. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, we partner with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world.

A passion for music and the music industry is a must. Your professional and confident approach will enable you to build and maintain strong relationships with your colleagues and external clients. In turn, we provide a comfortable, social, and engaging environment that encourages productivity and creativity.

  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising music publishing and merchandising agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising amendments, assignments, and terminations as needed.
  • Assistance with mergers and acquisitions in the German market.
  • Advising the business and global legal teams on issues particular to German law and practice.
  • Working within the global legal team to provide in-territory legal advice to stakeholders.
  • Assisting to create, refine, and update standard contract forms.
  • Co-managing legal claim resolution processes.

Who You Are:

  • Law Degree and 2-4 years of experience in a similar position and industry.
  • Thorough knowledge of German music law.
  • Experience with distribution contracts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent drafting skills.
  • Specialised knowledge throughout all facets of the music business.
  • Highly organised with an ability to track and prioritise a high volume of projects and adjust to changing priorities.
  • Strong autonomous working style with a proven ability to close deals.

job.title: Business Solutions Architect - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

The Architect is our platform strategist and systems thinker: the person who ensures our business systems ecosystem scales cleanly as it grows, while staying close enough to the business to know why it needs to. This role owns the center of excellence: defining the guardrails, patterns, and integration standards that every Business Solutions Specialist builds on, while remaining hands-on and business-facing rather than operating purely as a back-office architect.

What you'll do:

  • Define and evolve platform architecture standards and development guardrails across our core business systems
  • Partner closely with the SVP, Engineering and backend engineering on API and integration architecture
  • Evaluate and help the team adopt adjacent tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Pipedream, Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) as workflows expand
  • Provide architectural guidance and escalation support to the Business Solutions Specialists across business units
  • Engage directly with senior stakeholders to understand cross-business-unit operations and the broader ecosystem
  • Own the technical roadmap for platform scalability and maintainability
  • Lead complex data migrations across multiple business units
  • Contribute hands-on scripting/development work (integration scripts, workflow extensions) as needed
  • Support scoping and discovery for complex, multi-BU initiatives
  • Document standards, patterns, and best practices for the team
  • Define the team's AI enablement strategy — the standards, playbooks, and success metrics Specialists use to drive sustained AI adoption within business units, including tools like Claude Cowork
  • Own governance guardrails for AI-enabled workflows in partnership with Legal, InfoSec, and Privacy, ensuring new automation and AI use cases meet enterprise compliance requirements
  • Define measures of success for the Business Solutions platform and AI enablement program; use adoption and usage data to evaluate outcomes and inform roadmap priorities

Who you are:

  • 8-12 years in solutions architecture, business systems architecture, or platform engineering, with substantial experience designing and scaling enterprise-grade no-code/low-code business systems, built to be secure, scalable, and well-governed, not just functional
  • Track record designing and scaling automation/workflow architecture across multiple business units or departments
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., JavaScript, Python) for automation and integration work
  • Experience integrating no-code platforms with enterprise systems (CRM, ticketing, ERP) via APIs or middleware
  • Strong business acumen, able to translate business needs into technical architecture and back
  • Excellent stakeholder management; equally credible with engineers and business executives
  • A systems thinker and tool-agnostic problem solver, comfortable picking up new platforms as our stack evolves
  • Extensive A.I. experience implementing or using tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Google Gemini
  • Experience building or leading a center of excellence, AI governance body, or platform governance function
  • Demonstrated ability to define measures of success and use data to evaluate outcomes and drive accountability
  • Experience working within enterprise environments with established governance, privacy, security, and compliance expectations
Nice to Have (not required)
  • Experience in music, media, or entertainment, particularly around rights, royalties, or metadata
  • Deep, hands-on Airtable expertise (our current core platform), including advanced automations and scripting extensions

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Catalogue Growth & Commercial Manager
job.description:
The Senior Executive / Manager, Catalogue Growth & Commercialization plays a hybrid role across catalogue operations and commercial growth for Sony Music Entertainment Malaysia. This role is responsible for backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and M&A-related due diligence support, while also driving opportunities across D2C, website, AVOD monetization, SEO, analytics and DSP/platform optimization. Success in this role means ensuring catalogue assets are operationally ready, commercially optimized and positioned to maximize long-tail audience growth and revenue.

What you'll do:

  • Works independently as well as closely with various departments within Malaysia, the Asia Pacific region and external partners to support both Catalogue/Ops and Commercial Growth priorities.
  • Manages backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and digital supply chain workflows for acquired, legacy and M&A-related assets, covering product registration, metadata validation, delivery, scheduling, quality control, digitisation and operational readiness across DSPs, video platforms and partner services.
  • Supports M&A evaluation and due diligence by reviewing sales and performance reports, validating catalogue data and coordinating asset submission requirements for potential acquisition opportunities, including audio, video, metadata, artwork, rights documentation and related historical materials where applicable.
  • Supports Sony Music Malaysia’s commercial growth initiatives across D2C and e-commerce for artist merchandise and physical products, website upkeep and optimisation, AVOD and channel monetisation, and wider catalogue commercialisation opportunities.
  • Analyses and optimizes performance across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and other partner services by improving metadata, release setup, content packaging, channel hygiene, discoverability and audience signals to strengthen algorithmic performance, engagement and revenue.
  • Tracks and reports catalogue, website, D2C and partner platform performance, supports SEO and discoverability improvements, and identifies actionable optimization opportunities to improve long-tail catalogue value and monetisation outcomes.
  • Assists the team in solving operational and platform issues when required, including metadata mismatches, DSP mapping issues, delivery issues, rights conflicts, YouTube blockage issues and other backend or optimization-related matters.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in music business, digital business, marketing, e-commerce, media, analytics, business management or any related field is preferred.
  • At least 4-6 years of relevant work experience for Senior Executive level, or stronger experience for Manager level, across digital operations, catalogue management, digital marketing, e-commerce, analytics, SEO, AVOD or related commercial digital functions.
  • Strong understanding of digital music and video ecosystems, DSP servicing, metadata, platform workflows and catalogue optimization; familiarity with D2C, website management, SEO and analytics is an added advantage.
  • Able to review and interpret sales and performance data, with an understanding of discoverability drivers, partner platform best practices and optimization levers across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and similar services.
  • Extremely detail-oriented and organized, capable of managing multiple workflows and timelines, while being proactive, commercially aware, adaptable and confident working cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • Industry leading benefits across the board to all employees – from discounts on private health insurance and Sony products, to progressive wellbeing services including an award winning EAP and complimentary subscriptions to apps, telehealth, salary packaging for novated car leases, and life insurance and income protection… and of course, many music biz perks
  • We invest in your professional growth & development

job.title: College Marketing Representative, Atlanta - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a paid part‑time employee of The Orchard, you’ll serve as a key advocate for the artists we distribute. Each month, you’ll promote 10–20 artists through a mix of digital and in‑person marketing across your campus and college town. You’ll be a tastemaker in your community, collaborating with student organizations, local businesses, record stores, DJs, promoters, and more to build meaningful visibility for new releases and touring artists across a wide range of genres.

In this role, you’ll lead listening events, organize campus activations, and create social media content that directly supports our artists. You’ll gain hands-on experience in music marketing while staying ahead of the curve on emerging talent and new music, all while shaping how students in your market discover and engage with The Orchard’s roster.

What you'll do:

  • Organically create awareness of The Orchard’s artists by cultivating authentic relationships with key campus and local influencers including college radio, student organizations, newspapers, and community media to unlock opportunities for reviews, radio plays, interviews, and standout exposure.
  • Maintain a local social media presence that promotes the artists you’ll be working with, utilizing a mix of digital assets that are supplied to you and creating your own content to support The Orchard’s artists
  • Implement in-person marketing initiatives at record stores, lifestyle shops, and on campus
  • Research appropriate online sites, forums, and networks for the key 18-24yr old demographic for each artist
  • Research & attend local and campus events that will best facilitate the promotion of our artists
  • Attend our artists' shows to hand out promotional tools and get feedback from fans
  • Submit a detailed report on your marketing successes and initiatives for each campaign you run

Perks:

  • You will gain real world music industry experience that will be a great addition to your resume
  • You have the opportunity to express your creativity through your locally run social channels, in our team brainstorms, and in your concert/album reviews
  • You’ll have access to inside information that will improve your marketing outreach
  • You’ll receive free ticket(s) into our artists’ shows & possible meet and greet passes
  • You’ll build valuable relationships within your local music industry
  • + many more!

Who you are:

  • You are an Undergraduate Student currently enrolled in a 4 year university in Atlanta with a minimum of 2 years left prior to graduation
  • You are able to manage your own hours and be accountable for the work assigned to you
  • You have a passion for music, an understanding of how your peers discover and consume music, and a deep interest in music business & marketing
  • You have an understanding of social media marketing, you stay current on trends, and you have an active presence creating content on TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube
  • You have availability of 20 hours per week
  • You’re well-written, well-spoken, a team player, and an excellent communicator
  • You have transportation methods and live within 30 minutes of Atlanta
  • You have a flexible schedule for team conference calls and tour coverage

What We Give You

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • Opportunities to connect with our valuable resources, such as our Counsel of Equity & Progressive Action (CEPA), a group created by our employees tasked with developing and implementing innovative solutions to advance a globally-shared goal of ensuring fair and inclusive spaces for all
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.title: Community Manager, Rap and RnB - RCA
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Community Manager is a core driver of the Audience Development Team, leading strategy and execution to build, grow, engage, and activate artist fan communities across social platforms and owned channels.

This role oversees the development of digital campaigns aligned with each project’s creative direction, timeline, and target audience, ensuring every activation supports broader fan growth and engagement goals.

In close partnership with artists and their management teams, the Community Manager shapes a consistent and compelling content pipeline. This can range from early-stage ideation and mood boards to hands-on content capture with talent, depending on the needs of the campaign.

The position also manages third-party partners, including agencies and independent contractors, driving alignment, maintaining creative standards, and maximizing output across all campaign touchpoints.

As one of five Community Managers, this role holds primary ownership of the R&B & K-Pop genres and leads all campaigns within the space as the central point of accountability.

What you'll do:

  • Artist-Lead Shortform Content & Coaching
  • Community Platform Management (Reddit/Discord/Twitch)
  • Content Marketing Copy & Tags
  • Digital Advertising
  • Email & Text List Management/Messaging
  • Fan Data Acquisition
  • Fan Page Management & Coordination
  • Influencer Campaigns
  • Seeding
  • Social/Content Calendars
  • Social Platform Management (TikTok, Instagram, etc.)
  • UGC/Clipping

Who you are:

  • 3+ years in entertainment or lifestyle-based digital marketing or community management.
  • Deep knowledge of the R&B & K-Pop genres and their surrounding cultures.
  • Firm understanding of fan psychology, digital tribes and platform-specific behaviors.
  • Experience using data to analyze campaign performance, fan sentiment and audience health.
  • Strong communication skills with an adaptive tone to collaborate with peers, senior management and artists.
  • Expertise in all social media and community platforms.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, social analytics platforms, and fan/creator management tools.

job.title: Consultant - Product Manager
job.description:
As Product Manager – Fan Platform & D2C, you will work closely with our SaaS partner, UI/UX, Marketing, and Product teams to develop and enhance features across our fan platform. You'll translate user and business requirements into clear product specifications, help design and optimize Artist Pages and customer journeys, and support the launch of digital products and experiences across content, commerce, and fan engagement. Success in this role means delivering intuitive, user-centric features that improve the fan experience and contribute to the platform's growth.

What you'll do:

  • Work closely with our SaaS partner and UI/UX team to design, develop, test, and launch new features and enhancements across the Fan Platform
  • Help design and optimize Artist Pages, fan journeys, and other platform experiences to improve usability, engagement, and conversion.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, and product documentation, ensuring features align with business objectives and user needs.
  • Coordinate with Marketing, CRM, Content, and Product teams to support feature launches and ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Monitor platform performance, analyse user behaviour and feedback, and recommend improvements based on data and insights.
  • Gather business and user requirements and translate them into clear product specifications, user stories, and functional requirements.

Who you are:

  • Previous Experience: ~5 years of experience in Product Management, Digital Product Development, UI/UX, or Business Analysis, with experience working on consumer-facing web or mobile applications. Experience collaborating with engineering teams or SaaS platforms is preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, or a related field. Certifications in Product Management, UX, or Agile are a plus.
  • Skills: Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, user journey mapping, wireframing (Figma or similar), product documentation (PRDs, user stories), Agile methodologies, and product analytics. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Interests: Passion for digital products, consumer technology, music and entertainment, fan communities, and creating intuitive user experiences that solve real customer needs

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Content Planning Assistant Manager
job.description:

job.title: Coordinador, PX & Manejo Oficina, Costa Rica
job.description:
El Coordinador de Experiencia de las Personas (PX) y de Oficina (Consultor) proporcionará apoyo esencial al Socio Comercial de PX y al Presidente CAC en general en la gestión de diversos procesos relacionados con las personas y la administración de la oficina. Este rol se centra en asistir en la gestión del ciclo de vida del empleado desde la incorporación hasta la salida, el desarrollo del desempeño, las iniciativas de compromiso y el cumplimiento de las políticas de PX y la legislación laboral local, asegurando un entorno de trabajo positivo y colaborativo.

El rol contribuye a asegurar una experiencia consistente, justa y de calidad, impulsando el engagement, el desempeño, el desarrollo y la efectividad organizativa mediante prácticas centradas en las personas y basadas en datos.

Lo que haras:

  • Apoyo de Business Partnering
    • Actuar como primer punto de contacto (con supervisión) para consultas de gerentes y empleados/as dentro de su perímetro.
    • Dar soporte al/la PX Business Partner en el día a día de temas de personas, asegurando consistencia con políticas internas y prácticas laborales locales.
  • Ciclo de vida del empleado/a
    • Apoyar procesos de onboarding, seguimiento de periodo de prueba, movilidad interna y offboarding.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de hitos clave del ciclo de vida, garantizando una experiencia positiva y documentación en tiempo y forma.
    • Apoyar los procesos de incorporación, el seguimiento del período de prueba, la movilidad interna y las actividades de desvinculación.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de los hitos clave en el ciclo de vida del empleado, asegurando una documentación oportuna y una experiencia positiva para los empleados.
  • Desempeño y desarrollo
    • Apoyar los ciclos de desempeño (objetivos, seguimiento, evaluación): comunicación, coordinación de tiempos, soporte en herramientas y reporting.
    • Colaborar con el Socio de Negocios de PX para identificar necesidades de capacitación y coordinar acciones con The Learning Curator, Latin-Iberia o proveedores externos.
    • Asistir en el apoyo logístico para los ciclos de desempeño, incluyendo la programación de evaluaciones y el seguimiento de plazos.
  • Engagement y cultura
    • Liderar iniciativas de engagement y cultura, colaborando con y apoyando a los comités internos (p. ej., Comité de Cultura) y Comunicación.
    • Contribuir a la planificación y ejecución de acciones de experiencia alineadas con los valores de la compañía (GPP).
  • Procesos y políticas de People
    • Apoyar el despliegue de políticas, guías y actualizaciones de procesos; ayudar a que los managers comprendan y apliquen los criterios.
    • Mantener documentación de procesos y FAQs; proponer mejoras a partir de dudas recurrentes y feedback.
  • Datos y reporting
    • Recopilar y dar seguimiento a métricas de personas (movimientos de plantilla, ausencias, completitud de ciclos, acciones de engagement, etc.) bajo la guía del Socio de Negocios de PX.
    • Preparar reportes básicos e insights para el PXBP/PX Leadership; asegurar la calidad del dato en sistemas de RR. HH.
  • Relaciones laborales / Employee Relations (rol de apoyo)
    • Apoyar la gestión administrativa de casos (registro, documentación, seguimiento) o cualquier problema de gestión de rendimiento, bajo la guía del PXBP o equipo de People Relations.
    • Coordinar reuniones, comunicaciones y próximos pasos, manteniendo confidencialidad y cumplimiento normativo.
    • Apoyo en proyectos especiales ad hoc y en la administración según sea necesario.
  • Manejo de Oficina
    • Actuar como punto de contacto principal con el propietario del inmueble en relación con todos los asuntos pertinentes a la oficina.
    • Manejar contratos con proveedores, reparaciones y cumplimiento de normativas operacionales de la oficina.
    • Supervisar y coordinar la empresa de limpieza, asegurando el mantenimiento y limpieza general de la oficina, así como gestionar y dar seguimiento a los proveedores externos responsables de servicios y mantenimiento de la oficina.
    • Gestionar el envío y la recepción de correspondencia y paquetería, asegurando su correcta distribución y registro cuando sea necesario.

Quien eres:

  • 3 – 4 años de experiencia en RR. HH., People, Talent, People Ops o funciones similares.
  • Conocimiento intermedio de procesos de RR. HH.: ciclo de vida, desempeño, formación y reporting.
  • Capacidad para manejar información confidencial con rigor y discreción.
  • Organización y seguimiento: gestión de múltiples tareas, cumplimiento de plazos y control documental.
  • Orientación a datos: manejo de Excel/Google Sheets y capacidad de elaborar reportes básicos.
  • Comunicación clara y efectiva (oral y escrita) y capacidad para interactuar con distintos niveles de la organización.
  • Nivel de inglés: Fluidez en inglés (oral y escrita) requerida
  • Empatía y orientación a las personas; capacidad de escucha activa.
  • Proactividad y mentalidad de mejora continua.

job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. We have nurtured some of music's most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

What you will do:

  • Financial Modeling: Build and own the financial models underpinning valuation and deal structuring.
  • Commercial Analysis: Conduct industry and competitor analysis to evaluate potential acquisition and investment targets, joint ventures, and strategic initiatives.

  • Deal Execution: Support the end-to-end deal process from initial assessment through closing.
  • Presentation: Draft investment memos to communicate with senior management, crafting compelling stories and presentations that convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Internal Reporting: Maintain the regional deal pipeline and report on the performance of completed investments against the original investment thesis.

job.title: Director (m/w/d) Corporate M&A - Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
Vollzeit, ab 01.08.2026, unbefristet, Standort Berlin

Du begeisterst Dich für die Entwicklung der Musikindustrie und bist neugierig auf die Bedeutung von strategischen Investitionen und Unternehmenskäufen bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft? Verfügst Du über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, einen scharfen Blick für Details und die Fähigkeit, über den Tellerrand zu schauen?

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Teams in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz bei allen Aspekten regionaler M&A-Transaktionen, strategischer Investitionen, Joint Ventures, Veräußerungen und ähnlicher Transaktionen im Unternehmen.
  • Entwurf, Verhandlung und Abschluss einer breiten Palette von Verträgen im M&A Bereich, darunter Mandatsvereinbarungen, Genehmigungsvorlagen, Geheimhaltungsvereinbarungen und Term Sheets sowie Joint-Venture-Vereinbarungen und Firmenbeteiligungs- und Kaufverträge (Share- und Asset Deals).
  • Steuerung und Management der Due Diligence-Prüfung, Erkennen und Bewerten (rechtlicher) Risiken, Koordination interner Stakeholder und Genehmigungsprozesse sowie die Anleitung externer Kanzleien und sonstiger Berater.
  • Leitung funktionsübergreifender Arbeitsabläufe in Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Finance, Ventures & Investments, Steuern, Personal, Operations und anderen internen Partnern während des gesamten Life Cycles der jeweiligen Transaktion.
  • Allgemeine rechtliche Beratung in Bezug auf und Steuerung von Governance-Fragen und andere Themen im Zusammenhang mit vergangenen und aktuellen Transaktionen.
  • Optimierung von Transaktionsprozessen durch Beratung zu Best Practices, Entwicklung skalierbarer Verfahren und Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen bei Due-Diligence- und Ausführungsabläufen.

Wer du bist

  • Volljurist*in nach deutschem Recht (erstes und zweites Staatsexamen)
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in einer größeren Wirtschaftskanzlei, idealerweise mit substanzieller Verantwortung in M&A-Transaktionen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Handels- und Gesellschaftsrecht
  • Starke Verhandlungsfähigkeit und ein präziser Umgang mit Sprache – auch bei komplexen Sachverhalten
  • Ausgeprägtes Kommunikations- und Analysevermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, rechtliche Themen verständlich und adressatengerecht zu vermitteln
  • Teamplayer mit ausgeprägtem Servicegedanken und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam erfolgreiche Transaktionen umzusetzen
  • Souveräner Umgang mit mehreren Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld, gepaart mit hoher Genauigkeit und fundiertem Urteilsvermögen
  • Flexibel und offen, auch über M&A hinaus bei allgemeinen rechtlichen Fragestellungen zu unterstützen, je nach geschäftlichem Bedarf

Wir bieten dir

  • Raum für Vielfalt und für Innovation. Die Freiheit, Prozesse und Methoden zu challengen und zu revolutionieren.
  • Individuelle Benefits-Pakete kombinierbar aus ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Job-Rad und einem Sport-Abo.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein Streaming-Abo deiner Wahl.
  • Sowie Konzerte und Events in ganz Deutschland und in unserem schicken Headquarter mitten in Schöneberg.
  • Exklusive Trainings in der hauseigenen Academy.
  • Sowie das Vertrauen, deine Projekte in Eigenregie zum Erfolg zu führen.

Wie du dich bewirbst

Dein Foto, Alter, Familienstand, deine Herkunft, Zeugnisse, die Jobs deiner Eltern und andere Merkmale benötigen wir nicht.

Zeige uns in einem CV oder einer anderen kreativen Form, was dich ausmacht, was du kannst und warum Sony Music mit dir besser klingt!

Wir freuen uns auf dich.
Sony Music sounds better with you

job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is home to a broad roster of artists across genres, and our direct-to-fan merchandise and e-commerce activity continues to grow rapidly. With the huge recent growth of direct-to-fan sales, we are seeking a person who can coordinate the entire process of running an artist online store from start to finish, including product ideas, asset creation, inventory management, P&L, ticket bundles and merch ranges.

Ceremony of Roses is a global media, branding, design and events company with a full service music merchandise arm, covering every aspect of merchandise sales, production and distribution worldwide. Founded in 2016 by music and fashion entrepreneur Brad Scoffern, the company has worked with artists including Adele, Olivia Rodrigo, The Kid LAROI and Lil Nas X. A creative force in developing futuristic branding and merchandising services for artists using a blend of custom-manufactured and stock garments, Ceremony of Roses is a market leader in artist merchandise.

What you'll do:

  • Set up the official artist store, collaborating with various internal UK / US teams and serving as the point person for artist management and internal colleagues regarding each artist store.
  • Liaise with the design team to create the merch range, obtain artist approval and get the range into production, ordering appropriate quantities and pricing accordingly.
  • Manage the life cycle of album pre-orders, bundles, ticket bundles and inventory levels, working closely with CRM / Digital teams and advising on best practice for social media assets, digital spend and strategy / execution.
  • Ensure each store is appropriately linked.
  • Maintain on-store merch ranges by staying on top of trends and initiating exciting new drops.
  • Liaise with the Operations Manager to ensure stock is ordered and delivered within the expected timeframe.
  • Generate pre-order / sales reports and inventory reports.

job.title: Finance & Royalties Intern
job.description:
The application window for this role has been extended: Please apply by September 3rd at 10:00

At Sony Music Entertainment, we’re not just part of the music industry - we’re leading it. By bringing together music, technology, and culture, we’re creating real impact for our artists, our people, and the world around us. Here, you’ll be part of a global, collaborative community that’s constantly evolving, innovating, and shaping what’s next.

This is your opportunity to contribute meaningfully, while gaining a unique, end-to-end understanding of how a major music company operates—from financial decision making, to artist payments and beyond.

The Royalties & Finance (R&F) department at Sony Music is split into two main operational areas – Central R&F, and Label R&F.

There are two roles on offer in each of the R&F teams meaning four roles in total across central and label R&F giving fantastic opportunities for individuals who are analytical, curious, and eager to understand the bigger picture behind the music.

Please note: This application form cannot be saved part-way through. We recommend preparing your answers in a separate document and then copying them into the form when you’re ready to submit. If you’d like to take additional time to complete your application, please ensure you gather your responses externally before submitting in one go. If you are encountering any issues in your application, please apply via our UK careers site

If you have any reasonable adjustment requests, please reach out to recruitment.support@sonymusic.com.

Role Overview:

Ways of Working

  • Office attendance: Monday to Thursday in the office, Friday is our work from home day
  • Offsite working: No offsite working opportunities

What you'll do:

Cross-Team Collaboration & Broader Exposure

  • Work closely with both the Finance and Royalties teams, supporting key day-to-day operations and long-term projects
  • Liaise with departments such as Marketing, Legal, Sales, and Global Finance to understand how financial and contractual data flows across the business
  • Gain exposure to artist contract administration, budgeting processes, third-party reporting, and performance analysis

Central Finance Responsibilities

  • Support the consolidation and timely submission of group financial results to our parent organisation
  • Collaborate with the Central, Label and “New Business” teams on month-end reporting, budget tracking, and forecasting activities
  • Responsible for Group Reporting Packs delivered to CFO. These detail and summarise financial performance in the month, YTD and full year (forecast) across the business
  • Help prepare reports and analysis for business partners, including executive stakeholders
  • Reconcile financial data and identify anomalies in balance sheets to ensure accurate financial statements
  • Work closely with cost center owners to manage purchase orders and ensure timely supplier payments
  • Raise invoices and respond to finance-related queries, developing a strong understanding of end-to-end financial operations

Central Royalty Responsibilities

  • Manage the Royalty Query Log, acting as a first point of contact for standard queries from artists, producers, and managers, while coordinating with Royalty Managers on more complex cases
  • Assist in setting up new artist, producer, and licensee contracts in our royalty system (EROS), learning how accurate contract entry ensures artists are paid correctly
  • Support the collection and validation of banking and identity information for artist payments
  • Track and invoice third-party royalties, monitor sales data, and process royalty VAT invoices
  • Prepare monthly royalty statements and help with month-end balance sheet processes
  • Generate and circulate reports such as the CARMA report, gaining insights into contract and usage tracking

Label Finance Responsibilities

  • Support the team in preparing and submitting accurate month end label results - includes preparing and posting journals as required
  • Create and update daily streaming reports to be sent this to senior executives
  • Assist the marketing, production, and department cost center owners with our purchase order system to ensure timely payments of suppliers. You’ll also train new starters on how to use this system
  • Maintain and distribute weekly sales trackers for active/major artists
  • Work closely with Marketing and A&R executives to conduct regular meetings and ensure forecasts are accurate and up to date
  • Support the team in running key financial reports and analysis using various systems
  • Raise invoices and respond to finance-related queries, developing a strong understanding of end-to-end financial operations

Who you are:

Essential

  • Highly numerate and detail-oriented, with a strong interest in finance, accounting and royalties
  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, and financial systems
  • Keen to understand how different departments work together to support artists and the business

Nice to have

  • You’re curious, analytical, and passionate about understanding how a global music company works—especially the financial and contractual mechanisms behind it all. You’re ready to work with multiple teams, ask the right questions, and take ownership of your learning journey
  • Collaborative by nature, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Organised and methodical, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Proactive and resourceful—you don’t wait to be told what to do

What we give you:

  • An annual salary of £28,480 (London Living Wage)
  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development such as focused workshops and a dedicated mentor, enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

  • Candidates who pass this stage will then be invited to the final stage of the process, an in-person assessment centre in early November. We will send further information on this stage before the date arrives.

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time.

What you'll do

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

What we give you

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
The Finance Director is the strategic finance business partner to the Country General Manager and regional leadership, providing commercial and financial leadership to drive sustainable business growth and value creation. The role is responsible for leading the country's financial planning and analysis, business partnering, commercial deal evaluation, financial reporting, governance, and compliance, while ensuring strong financial controls and operational excellence.

Working closely with commercial, marketing, A&R, business development, legal, and regional finance teams, the Finance Director provides financial insights to support strategic initiatives, artist investments, licensing and distribution agreements, and other commercial opportunities. The role leads budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and performance management to support informed decision-making and deliver business objectives.

In addition to its strategic focus, the role oversees all aspects of the country finance function, including accounting, treasury, cash flow management, financial reporting, tax, audit, internal controls, and statutory compliance, ensuring adherence to company policies, IFRS, and local regulatory requirements. The Finance Director also drives process improvements, cost optimisation, and effective risk management while partnering with regional finance and shared service teams to deliver a high-performing finance function.

What you'll do

Business Partnering, Commercial Finance & Strategic Planning

  • Partner with the Country General Manager (GM), Regional Managing Director, and cross-functional teams including Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Business Development, Legal, and Business Affairs to evaluate business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the trusted finance business partner, providing commercial and financial insights to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and commercial transactions by developing financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the country, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Deliver insightful management reporting, financial analysis, and performance scorecards to country and regional leadership, providing recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Commercial Transactions, Artist Deals & Strategic Investments

  • Provide financial leadership and commercial support for artist signings, licensing agreements, royalty arrangements, publishing, distribution, and other commercial transactions.
  • Evaluate deal economics, profitability, recoupment structures, investment returns, and financial risks associated with artist contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Partner with Legal and Business Affairs during contract negotiations and deal execution.
  • Support strategic investment initiatives and M&A activities by performing financial analysis, due diligence, valuation, and post-investment performance monitoring where applicable.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management

  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial planning in accordance with global finance processes.
  • Ensure accurate revenue, cost, and cash flow forecasting while monitoring performance against financial targets and key business metrics.
  • Prepare monthly management reports, financial dashboards, variance analyses, and forecasts for country management and regional finance.
  • Manage affiliate performance reporting and maintain a single source of financial data for business decision-making.

Finance Operations & Financial Control

  • Lead the country finance function, overseeing accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, payroll, royalty processing, cash flow management, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) in accordance with IFRS, company policies, and local statutory requirements.
  • Drive operational excellence, finance process improvements, and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency and strengthen financial controls.
  • Maintain effective governance frameworks, finance policies, and internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance.

Risk Management, Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, IFRS, local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and internal control standards.
  • Manage statutory audits and maintain relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Oversee corporate income tax, GST/VAT, withholding tax, transfer pricing, and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and financial risks while safeguarding company assets and investments.
  • Drive cost control initiatives, manage operating expenses and headcount budgets, and ensure efficient use of financial resources.
  • Ensure timely royalty processing, financial reconciliations, and resolution of operational backlogs.

Who you are

Experience

  • 10–15 years of progressive finance experience spanning commercial finance, FP&A, financial control, and business partnering, with a proven track record in multinational organisations. Experience in the media, entertainment, consumer, or other fast-paced industries is an advantage.
  • Solid experience within a medium-sized to large international organisation, partnering closely with regional finance teams while serving as the finance lead for an in-country business.
  • Proven ability to act as a strategic finance business partner within a matrix organisation, influencing senior stakeholders and supporting commercial decision-making.
  • Demonstrated track record of combining strong financial and commercial acumen to identify business risks and opportunities, drive FP&A initiatives, and support sustainable business growth.

Capabilities

  • Strategic Finance & Business Partnering: Strong expertise in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, business case development, performance reporting, and commercial decision support.
  • Finance Leadership & Operational Excellence: Proven ability to lead finance operations, strengthen governance and internal controls, optimise finance processes, and drive continuous improvement through automation and operational excellence.
  • People & Stakeholder Leadership: Effective leader with experience developing high-performing teams and building trusted relationships with business leaders, regional finance, artists and their ecosystem, and internal and external stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
  • Commercial & Analytical Acumen: Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate financial insights into actionable recommendations, balancing commercial objectives with financial discipline and risk management.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline; an MBA in Finance or Accounting is an advantage.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent preferred, with strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, tax, statutory compliance, ERP systems, and advanced financial analysis tools.
  • Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.

What we give you

  • An opportunity to influence the strategic direction of our Southeast Asia business
  • The ability to foster innovation and make a significant impact on the domestic music industry in Southeast Asia
  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community that empowers you to drive the creative journey
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • We are committed to investing in your personal growth and development.

Equal Opportunities:

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.
We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.
