job.title: VP, D2C Fan Engagement
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a VP, Fan Engagement to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the Fan Engagement function within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C fan engagement across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six spanning creative direction and design systems, design and production, D2C product management, and CRM and lifecycle marketing. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.
  • Depth varies by situation. On a frontline release the team is advisory. Between release cycles, on evergreen catalog, it is the primary owner of D2C activity with label approval. On superstar campaigns it is fully engaged alongside label and international teams.
  • Depth also tapers by label. Heavier engagement early where D2C capability is thin, lighter as the label staffs up — every label lands in the same place.
  • Always-on, not campaign-by-campaign. Label marketing works per release; international marketing works per market, per release. This team spans releases and keeps D2C running between them.

What you'll do:

Creative

  • Build the D2C design system — templates, asset taxonomies and scalable creative frameworks that let labels and territories execute high-quality D2C creative at volume across markets.
  • Establish D2C visual and email standards, including motion templates, content hierarchy, build quality and testing practice, with labels supplying artist voice and brand direction.
  • Produce merchandise and D2C product creative that labels do not produce in-house — pack shots, product mockups, banners and bundle imagery.
  • Produce D2C social assets and CRM builds when label teams lack the capacity, and refine or extend existing creative for D2C where core assets are limited.
  • Create pitch decks and D2C creative concepts that help label teams sell campaign ideas internally and to artist teams.
  • Resolve international asset adaptation, where D2C creative differs meaningfully by territory and is today handled late and inconsistently.
  • Supply campaign creative and merchandising direction to the Store Experience team, who build and run the storefronts.

Product

  • Establish the process linking D2C with marketing, sales and merchandising — the coordination gap labels consistently identify as their biggest constraint, where marketing learns of product and release decisions too late to build a proper campaign.
  • Develop D2C product insight across bundles, exclusives, premium formats and drops, proposed to the label for approval.
  • Own D2C pricing and promotional recommendations across markets, with label approval and international input from the commercial strategy team.
  • Run competitor scanning, launch retrospectives and evergreen product ideation, bringing trend and net-new format thinking to label and commerce teams.
  • Build lifecycle and scarcity frameworks — pre-order windows, limited editions, flash drops, live-show tie-ins, gated access and evergreen replenishment.
  • Ensure D2C approaches are globally consistent where scale matters and locally adapted where fan behaviour, language, pricing, territory, chart rules or fulfilment realities require it.
  • Partner with operations on launch readiness, product setup and localisation, and supply demand signals into the forecasting and insights team.

Marketing, CRM & Campaign Operations

  • Train label teams to think D2C natively — what assets are needed, at what cadence, and which products fit which moments.
  • Build the D2C campaign cadence, framework and schedule that keeps label campaigns on track — a named gap where no one currently owns the rhythm of D2C activity across a release.
  • Own domestic D2C CRM and lifecycle marketing across the full fan journey — email, SMS and owned channels — including automated journeys that keep fans engaged between release moments, not only campaign sends.
  • Develop a fan segmentation framework spanning casual fans, active fans and superfans, enabling more personalised communication and experiences across every channel.
  • Build the first-party data strategy that captures fan preferences and behaviours to create richer fan profiles, and own domestic fan acquisition.
  • Provide D2C budget deployment and retargeting guidance, developed with the label.
  • Create D2C paid media best-practice frameworks across Meta, TikTok and Google, with clear guidance on campaign structure, audience strategy and measurement. D2C performance marketing is a distinct discipline from awareness and engagement advertising and is not resourced consistently across labels today.
  • Define flywheel analytics, channel health standards and reporting — tracking acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation, and how fans move from streaming, social and owned properties into D2C channels.
  • Establish best practice for loyalty and VIP programmes that reward engagement rather than purchase alone, social commerce integrations, and creator and affiliate partnerships — with labels executing against those standards.
  • Advise label teams on preorder strategy, launch timing, segmentation, local market messaging and campaign optimisation, and drive a test-and-learn culture across creative and messaging.
  • Over time, develop predictive audience modelling to identify high-value fans and churn risk, and prepare the design system and asset taxonomy for AI-assisted asset generation.

Partnership & Interlock

  • Serve as the central D2C fan engagement partner to labels, artist teams and territories — including Columbia, RCA, Epic and the UK — and to Ceremony of Roses, The Orchard and merchandise partners.
  • Define and operate the interlock with the international marketing team, who own market localisation and in-territory execution for US repertoire. This role owns the domestic equivalent and sets the global standard; the handoff between the two requires clear, agreed triggers.
  • Work across The Greenhouse with the Store Experience, Business Operations, Commercial Strategy and Customer Satisfaction functions, whose scope adjoins this team’s at multiple points.
  • Build the relationships and credibility to influence without authority across a highly matrixed global organisation.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years across fan engagement, D2C marketing, CRM, eCommerce, merchandising or digital marketing in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder environment; music or entertainment experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of music fan behaviour, artist marketing, D2C commerce and fan engagement ecosystems.
  • Track record of enabling distributed teams — building playbooks, standards and frameworks that others execute — rather than only running work centrally. Comfortable moving between doing the work and teaching it.
  • Able to operate through influence rather than authority, and to build the trust that makes label teams want to work with a central function.
  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle marketing, CRM platforms, email and SMS execution, segmentation and first-party data strategy. Familiarity with Shopify ecosystems and D2C storefront operations.
  • Practical experience with D2C performance marketing — paid media planning, audience targeting and return on ad spend — or the judgement to build that capability.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating across design, marketing, merchandising and product functions, with the credibility to work alongside label creative teams.
  • Experience building scalable campaign workflows, design systems and operational best practice in high-volume environments.
  • Global mindset and sensitivity to local market nuance — fan behaviour, pricing, language, cultural context, release priorities, chart rules and fulfilment realities.
  • Passion for music, fandom, culture and evolving consumer experiences.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

At SoundCloud, we believe growth is not the responsibility of a single channel. Growth happens when products, experiences, customer journeys, marketing channels, creators, communities, and partnerships work together as a unified system.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Integrated Marketing & Growth to oversee SoundCloud's growth marketing ecosystem and connect every customer touchpoint into a unified engine that drives acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and advocacy. Working closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Community, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Executive Leadership, you will drive integrated campaign orchestration across the business, modernize marketing measurement and experimentation, and build and lead a high-performing growth organization.

Reporting to the Chief Growth & Marketing Officer, you will be ultimately responsible for how users discover, engage with, subscribe to, and advocate for SoundCloud, maximizing long-term customer value across our entire ecosystem.

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing growth organization grounded in a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and data-driven accountability

  • Experience leading large-scale acquisition, retention, and lifecycle programs for subscription or consumer businesses

job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. As a Senior Principal Engineer, you will combine deep technical expertise with strategic vision and people leadership to drive the development of large-scale recommendation, personalization, and search systems. The mission is clear: architect systems to extract high-fidelity insights from user interactions with the world’s largest audio dataset to connect artists and fans through music. You will define the technical North Star for ML across engineering, delivering impactful data-driven products while leading and growing a high-performing team of Engineers and Scientists. This role reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer and will work in lockstep with the Music Intelligence, Content, and Recommendations teams. You will also be part of a small group leading the charge in architecting the agentic workflows and LLM-assisted systems that will allow us to ship Musical Intelligence at 10x the speed of traditional teams.

  • Lead the technical strategy and execution for SoundCloud’s ML systems (e.g., recommendation, ranking, personalization), including model development, deployment, and scaling
  • Lead the exploration of advanced modeling techniques including Deep Neural Networks, LLMs, large recommender systems, multi-modal embeddings and transformer-based architectures to create unique and impactful listening experiences

  • Lead the leveraging of agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier to work at 10x the speed of traditional methods

Experience and Background:

  • Proven track record of defining technical strategy and driving execution for large-scale ML systems, particularly in recommendation, personalization, or search
  • Experience setting technical roadmaps, influencing cross-functional priorities, and balancing business, product, and engineering trade-offs at an organizational level

job.title: Senior Product Designer - Creator Analytics & Tools
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

As a Senior Product Designer on the Creator Team, you will be a driving force behind defining and designing intuitive, impactful, and innovative tools for artists, producers, and music creators. A massive part of this role will focus on data storytelling: taking complex streaming analytics, audience demographics, and financial metrics, and turning them into clear, actionable insights that help artists grow their careers.

This role requires an entrepreneurial and autonomous mindset. You will have a high degree of ownership and must be comfortable leading complex design initiatives from zero to one with minimal product management support. You will bridge the gap between product strategy and execution, using deep product thinking to define what we build, not just how it looks.

Applications without portfolios will not be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design high-craft, intuitive product experiences that turn complex streaming analytics, audience metrics, and monetization insights into elegant, actionable dashboards for creators, using exceptional typography, visual hierarchy, and interaction detail
  • Own and drive the end-to-end design process for creator-focused products. Step up to define product scope, requirements, and strategy when product management support is light
  • Translate vague, complex user problems and business goals into clear, elegant, and intuitive product workflows

job.title: Media Sales Specialist – Sydney, NS
job.description: Department Sales Location Sydney (NS) Stingray is a leading global music, media and technology company, and Canada’s premier radio broadcaster. At Stingray, creativity, collaboration and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA. As a valued team members prepares for retirement, we are currently looking for a Media Sales Strategist to join our Sydney team and cover the Cape Breton Regional Municipality! This position reports to the Retail Sales Manager for Hot 101.9 and New Country 103.5/Sydney . Stingray offers one of the most robust multimedia platforms for businesses to market and sell their products and services, locally, nationally or globally. Our ideal candidate has a strong multimedia marketing and sales background, and has demonstrated the ability to manage and grow an active client list, while understanding the importance of a team mentality with a desire to be part of the fabric of the community. Located on beautiful Cape Breton Island, Sydney serves as the gateway to the Cabot Trail, the Cape Breton Highlands National Park, and several other cultural attractions. With a diversified economy, it’s the largest urban centre on the island with a population of approximately 100,000 and serves as its healthcare, educational, and transportation hub. Your day-to-day Be a local sales leader of the Hot 101.9 and New Country 103.5, Stingray-owned radio stations. You will have the opportunity to harness the power of these popular stations while also representing all Stingray Radio Stations from Vancouver to St. John’s, unlocking vast sales potential across a nationwide network. Leverage a diverse range of media solutions including radio, programmatic display, programmatic video, connected TV, digital out-of-home, YouTube, search, social, and our proprietary retail media platform – to help clients grow and succeed. Own the full sales process from lead generation and prospecting to client needs analysis, solution presentation, negotiation, and closing. Drive revenue growth and achieve revenue targets through consultative sales and development of strategic proposals. Manage and grow your client base while identifying new business opportunities . Collaborate with internal teams (promotions, programming, creative, production, digital campaign managers) to deliver impactful, multi-platform advertising campaigns. Help handle the administrative responsibilities of the Sydney Sales Department, including building client/station proposals; coordinating the remote booking process/wrap-up reports (for both local and national opportunities); and representing the stations at client and community partner events. Your qualifications You have 2+ years of in-person, consultative sales or account management experience (experience in multi-media advertising or digital media is a plus). Ability to self-manage, proven high-achieving performer in all facets of life with a track record of consistently achieving and exceeding sales targets. You are comfortable building ground-up ideas and presenting your strategies to business owners and operators. You are an excellent communicator, presenter, and negotiator with a history of building strong, lasting, business relationships. You are well-organized, accountable, and skilled at managing time and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with a team-focused mindset. You live in or would relocate to Sydney, NS; have a valid driver’s license; access to a vehicle; and valid vehicle insurance. Life at Stingray A positive, team-oriented work environment An opportunity to work with and learn from the best in the business Pension Plan and Share Purchase Plan (with a contribution from Stingray) Comprehensive benefits plan and Employee and Family Assistance Plan Hybrid work policy (for positions that qualify) And much more! Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination. About the Role We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store. This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that. You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R What You'll Do Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn Qualifications You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO) You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business You use AI to get more done than one person normally could You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down Additional Notes Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC. job.title: Social Media Community Manager
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role We’re looking for a Social Media Community Manager to be the voice of Suno across our social platforms and the daily connective tissue between our fans, creators, and brand. This is a full time role reporting to the Director of Social Media, and it sits at the heart of how Suno shows up in culture—shaping the tone, energy, and relationships that turn casual listeners into passionate advocates. In this role, you’ll live inside our comments, DMs, replies, and community spaces—engaging with Suno’s audience in a way that feels human, witty, and unmistakably on-brand. You’ll partner closely with the social, brand, and content teams to surface cultural moments, amplify creators, and translate community signal into insight that shapes how we talk and what we make. You’ll help build a community that feels alive, inclusive, and creatively inspired. This is a role for someone who genuinely loves the internet—who can spot a meme before it peaks, write a reply that earns a screenshot, and spark conversations that make people feel seen. You understand the rhythm of platforms like TikTok, Instagram, X, and Reddit, and you move with the speed and fluency that real-time community work demands. You’re equally comfortable celebrating a creator’s moment, defusing a tense thread, and turning a random comment into a reason for a thousand more. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/D0jCWAkn2JR4Kzik What You’ll Do Own day-to-day community engagement across Suno’s social channels (TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms), responding to comments, DMs, and mentions in a voice that is distinctly Suno. Build genuine relationships with Suno creators and superfans —celebrating their work, surfacing their songs, and helping them feel recognized as part of the Suno story. Spot cultural moments, memes, and trends in real time and partner with the social team to jump on them quickly with on-brand, high-quality responses. Moderate community spaces (Discord, Reddit, comments sections) with care and good judgment—keeping conversations healthy, welcoming, and aligned with our community guidelines. Act as the first line of listening for the brand —tracking sentiment, surfacing emerging themes, and escalating issues, bugs, or sensitive conversations to the appropriate teams. Drive a proactive social listening practice —monitoring conversations across owned channels, broader social platforms, and creator communities to identify recurring themes, sentiment shifts, white-space opportunities, and early signals of issues. Translate those themes into clear, prioritized actions : content ideas for the social team, talking points for brand and PR, product feedback for the Suno team, creator outreach opportunities, and adjustments to community strategy. Share these insights through regular readouts so listening consistently turns into decisions and meaningful follow-through. Partner with the Director of Social Media to shape community strategy, contribute to content ideas, and help plan engagement around launches, campaigns, and cultural moments. Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Support, and Trust & Safety to ensure community feedback informs how we build, communicate, and respond. Develop lightweight community rituals —weekly highlights, creator spotlights, AMAs, and other recurring programs that give fans something to show up for. Maintain playbooks and documentation for response guidelines, escalation paths, tone of voice, and community best practices. Report on community health and engagement —tracking qualitative and quantitative signals that help the team understand what’s resonating and where to invest next. Champion the Suno community internally, ensuring creators and fans are represented in the decisions we make. What You’ll Need 2+ years of community management or social media experience , ideally at a consumer tech company, music or entertainment brand, creator platform, or culture-forward agency. A strong, distinctive writing voice —you can match a brand’s tone while still sounding like a real person, and you know when to be playful, warm, hype, or measured. Deep fluency in internet and platform culture —TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Discord, and Reddit each have their own norms, and you understand them intuitively. A love of music and creativity —you get why Suno matters to people and are excited to build community around the act of making something. Excellent judgment and emotional intelligence , especially in sensitive, ambiguous, or high-visibility moments; you know when to engage, when to listen, and when to escalate. Experience moderating online communities and navigating feedback, criticism, and the occasional troll with grace and confidence. Comfort with the pace of real-time work —you can move quickly without sacrificing quality, and you’re energized (not overwhelmed) by a full inbox and a lit-up mentions tab. Familiarity with community and social tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Khoros, Discord admin tools, native platform analytics) and a willingness to learn new ones. A collaborative, low-ego approach —you partner well with designers, writers, producers, and cross-functional teammates, and you’re excited to build something together. Bonus: personal experience as a creator, musician, or active participant in online communities. Additional Notes: Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. This is an in person role working at our NYC or LA office. Perks & Benefits Company Equity Package 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k) Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options) 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave Creative Education Stipend Generous Commuter Allowance In-Office Lunch (5 days per week) Compensation Base salary: $82,000 - $107,000 (before equity) Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

El rol requiere una combinación de visión comercial, conocimiento técnico, capacidad analítica y habilidades de relacionamiento , siendo un punto de conexión entre clientes, agencias, equipos internos y partners tecnológicos. Experiencia en creación y gestión de Private Marketplace Deals (PMP) . Conocimiento de conceptos de compra programática como RTB, DSP, SSP, Header Bidding, audiencias e inventario digital . Experiencia en análisis y optimización de campañas digitales con base en KPIs. Conocimiento de métricas y estándares de publicidad digital como viewability, brand safety, conversiones y rendimiento de campañas . Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting y resolver problemas relacionados con la implementación de campañas digitales. Inglés B1-B2 . Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento con clientes y stakeholders internos. Pensamiento estratégico y orientación a resultados comerciales. Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de manera clara a audiencias no técnicas. Proactividad, orientación al cliente y capacidad para trabajar con múltiples equipos. Habilidad para construir relaciones comerciales de largo plazo y detectar oportunidades de crecimiento. Capacidad de liderazgo e influencia sin autoridad formal. Será un plus si tienes Certificaciones de Google Ads / Google Ad Manager u otras plataformas digitales. Experiencia con Facebook/Meta Ads . Conocimiento de herramientas de analítica y visualización como Google Analytics, Looker, Looker Studio o Tableau . Conocimientos de SQL . Experiencia con DMP, CDP u otras tecnologías de gestión de datos. Conocimiento del ecosistema de medios digitales y streaming. Experiencia trabajando directamente con publishers, plataformas tecnológicas o empresas de medios. Benefits Ser parte de un equipo que está transformando el ecosistema de publicidad digital y programática. Exposición a clientes, agencias y partners tecnológicos estratégicos. job.title: HR Project Manager Co-Op-Temp
job.description: ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: TelevisaUnivision is looking for a HR Project Manager to join our team. ABOUT YOU: You are a highly organized and strategic project manager who thrives on bringing structure, visibility, and accountability to complex HR initiatives. You excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, and partnering with stakeholders across Human Resources, Technology, Finance, and the business to deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for continuous improvement and enjoy building governance, creating transparency, and helping leaders make informed prioritization decisions. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of transforming ideas into well-executed projects while ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and available capacity. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (aka Responsibilities) · Establish and continuously enhance the HR Project Management Office (PMO) framework, governance, and project delivery methodology, including standardized processes for project intake, prioritization, planning, execution, implementation, and post-launch support. · Coordinate and administer the HR Portfolio Management process, including project intake, prioritization, roadmap management, governance, status reporting, and executive communications. · Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, IT, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and business stakeholders to define project scope, business requirements, timelines, dependencies, and success measures. · Facilitate portfolio governance meetings, maintain project documentation, and provide regular updates on project health, risks, issues, milestones, and resource capacity. · Monitor project progress, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery. · Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards, project metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into delivery status, resource utilization, business value, and strategic alignment. · Support business case development by evaluating project requests for business impact, effort, complexity, risk, regulatory requirements, and organizational readiness. · Drive continuous improvement of HR project management methodologies, governance frameworks, templates, and operational processes. · Coordinate testing, change management, communications, training, and deployment activities as needed to support successful project implementation. · Foster strong relationships across HR and business functions, ensuring collaboration, accountability, and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications) · Experience in project management, preferably supporting Human Resources, HRIS, People Operations, or enterprise transformation initiatives. · Experience managing multiple cross-functional projects within a structured project management or portfolio management environment. · Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches. · Demonstrated experience facilitating governance, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder communications, and executive reporting. · Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess business needs and recommend practical solutions. · Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. · Experience working with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar platforms. · Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is preferred. · Experience supporting HR technology implementations (such as Workday or other HCM platforms) is strongly preferred. · PMP, CAPM, Agile, or similar project management certification is a plus. · Bilingual English and Spanish skills are preferred. TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Jefe de Administración de Riesgos
job.description: Jefe de Administración de Riesgos Ubicación: Ciudad de México Modalidad: Presencial, San Angel Sobre el rol y el equipo En TelevisaUnivision buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Jefe de Administración de Riesgos , quien tendrá un rol clave en la identificación, evaluación, monitoreo y mitigación de riesgos que puedan impactar la operación y los objetivos del negocio. Formarás parte de un entorno dinámico y multidisciplinario, colaborando con diferentes áreas de la organización y con stakeholders nacionales e internacionales, así como con aseguradoras, brokers y especialistas en gestión de riesgos. Esta posición ofrece exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y la oportunidad de contribuir al fortalecimiento de una cultura de prevención y gestión de riesgos. Sobre la posición Serás responsable de coordinar y dar seguimiento a la administración de riesgos corporativos , generando análisis e información que permitan identificar escenarios, evaluar posibles impactos y definir acciones de mitigación. Trabajarás de manera transversal con diferentes áreas para dar seguimiento a riesgos, incidentes, seguros y planes de mitigación, proporcionando información y recomendaciones que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Buscamos una persona con pensamiento analítico, sólidos conocimientos cuantitativos y capacidad para transformar información compleja en análisis y recomendaciones claras para el negocio. Sobre ti Buscamos una persona analítica, estructurada y orientada a resultados , con experiencia en Administración de Riesgos, seguros, análisis financiero, estadístico, actuarial o áreas relacionadas. Deberás tener capacidad para analizar información, identificar escenarios de riesgo, evaluar posibles impactos y desarrollar recomendaciones prácticas. También deberás contar con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento, ya que trabajarás de manera transversal con diferentes áreas y stakeholders nacionales e internacionales. Tu día a día Coordinar la identificación, evaluación y monitoreo de riesgos que puedan impactar la operación y los objetivos del negocio. Analizar información financiera, estadística, actuarial y operativa para identificar escenarios de riesgo. Evaluar posibles impactos y dar seguimiento a las estrategias y acciones de mitigación. Elaborar reportes ejecutivos, análisis y presentaciones para facilitar la toma de decisiones. Analizar incidentes y siniestros, identificando causas, impactos y oportunidades de prevención. Administrar y mantener actualizada la documentación relacionada con seguros, siniestros y gestión de riesgos. Coordinar y dar seguimiento a la relación con aseguradoras, brokers y proveedores especializados . Colaborar con áreas como Finanzas, Jurídico, Fiscal, Tesorería, Compras, Recursos Humanos y Operaciones en la identificación y mitigación de riesgos. Participar en la implementación y actualización de políticas, procesos y estrategias de Administración de Riesgos. Investigar tendencias, metodologías y mejores prácticas para fortalecer los procesos de gestión de riesgos. Preparar análisis e información para stakeholders nacionales e internacionales. Facilitar la comunicación y coordinación entre diferentes equipos y áreas. Participar en iniciativas de capacitación y comunicación para fortalecer la cultura de gestión de riesgos . Identificar oportunidades de mejora, automatización y uso de datos para hacer más eficientes los procesos del área. Tú deberás tener Licenciatura en Actuaría, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Economía, Finanzas, Estadística o carrera afín. +3 años de experiencia en Administración de Riesgos, seguros, análisis financiero, estadístico, actuarial o evaluación de riesgos. Experiencia en análisis e interpretación de información financiera y estadística. Conocimiento de modelos estadísticos, probabilísticos y financieros . Conocimiento de evaluación y cuantificación de riesgos. Experiencia en elaboración de reportes ejecutivos y análisis para la toma de decisiones. Inglés avanzado . Excelentes habilidades analíticas, numéricas y de síntesis. Capacidad de organización y planeación. Habilidades de negociación y manejo de stakeholders. Capacidad para identificar problemas, evaluar escenarios y proponer soluciones. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita. Orientación a resultados y atención al detalle. Capacidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios y multiculturales. Será un plus si tienes Estudios o certificaciones en Administración de Riesgos, Finanzas, Actuaría o Seguros . Experiencia trabajando con aseguradoras y brokers . Experiencia en administración de pólizas y gestión de siniestros. Conocimiento de Data Management y análisis de información. Experiencia con herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos. Conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial aplicada al análisis de información o automatización de procesos. Experiencia en continuidad de negocio y planes de contingencia. Experiencia previa en empresas multinacionales. Experiencia en industrias de medios, entretenimiento, tecnología o servicios . Lo que encontrarás con nosotros Formar parte de TelevisaUnivision , una empresa global de medios y entretenimiento. Exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y proyectos multidisciplinarios. Colaboración con equipos nacionales e internacionales. Interacción con especialistas y proveedores relacionados con Administración de Riesgos. Participación en iniciativas orientadas a la prevención, continuidad y protección del negocio. Desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico y multicultural. La oportunidad de contribuir a la evolución y fortalecimiento de las prácticas de gestión de riesgos. Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. job.title: Line Producer
job.description: JOB TITLE: Line Producer LOCATION: Miami ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: The Network News team at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Line Producer to join our team! This is a chance to help shape one of our daily news programs for N+Univision, streaming 24/7 on our hit platform ViX . The Line Producer will be responsible for managing the production of daily shows, supporting the Executive Producer with preproduction and team management — and will also play a role in our special programs, beyond the daily news cycle. This role carries real editorial weight: you won't just be executing a rundown, you'll be shaping it — bringing sharp news judgment, sourcing strong stories, and making the split-second calls that define how our audience experiences the news. ABOUT YOU: If you have strong sharp instincts for breaking news, knowledge of TV production and a genuine passion for journalism, this role is for you. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: Own the daily rundown — story selection, placement, and editorial direction, with a strong voice in what makes the show and why. Bring sound news judgment to every decision: vetting sources, assessing newsworthiness, and shaping the editorial angle of each story. Execute the timing of live shows from the control room, making confident, last-minute calls under pressure. Work closely with the Associate Producer and/or Graphics Producer on the development and production of daily news graphics. React quickly to breaking news, adjusting the show in real time to keep our coverage first and accurate. Participate in special news programming and coverage, beyond the daily shows, including field coordination. Maintain close communication with the assignment desk, production, and technical crews to keep every show running seamlessly. Back-time shows and adjust rundowns effortlessly while on air. Flexible schedule including weekends and holidays. YOU HAVE: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Journalism or Communications. Minimum 5 years of experience line producing/producing. Strong news judgment and a deep, current knowledge of the news landscape. Experience with social media platforms. Bilingual in English/Spanish, written and oral. Knowledge of iNews or similar newsroom systems (e.g., Dalet). OUR BENEFITS: TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive y competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options. #LI-ONSITE TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Manager, Digital Content Producer - Streaming
job.description: The Manager, Multimedia Content, Live Video Streaming & Programming will lead TelevisaUnivision Local Media's live video strategy and programming across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms. This role will lead a team responsible for live production, digital video, and social content, while overseeing programming strategy, content execution, audience growth, and monetization. The Manager will combine strong editorial judgment, digital expertise, and operational leadership to develop engaging, culturally relevant content that connects with Latino audiences across the U.S. ABOUT YOU: You are a dynamic digital media leader with a passion for live content, audience growth, and innovative storytelling. You thrive in fast-paced environments, know how to turn breaking moments into compelling digital programming, and bring strong editorial judgment and platform expertise. You are a hands-on people leader who can inspire a team, collaborate across functions, and use data and audience insights to continuously improve content and drive results. Experience engaging U.S. Latino audiences and a strong understanding of digital video platforms are highly valued. YOUR DAY-DAY: Strategy, Programming & Team Leadership Lead the Local Media live video and multimedia content strategy, aligning programming with audience growth, engagement, and monetization goals. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of social media editors, video producers, and livestreaming specialists, establishing clear priorities, workflows, and performance expectations. Develop and manage a dynamic programming calendar for digital-first live content and related Video on Demand (VOD) assets, adapting programming to breaking news, cultural moments, and audience interests. Monitor digital video trends, platform developments, audience insights, and competitive activity to continuously evolve programming and content strategy. Partner with editorial, marketing, PR, sales, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated content execution and cross-platform promotion. Live Content Production & Execution Oversee the production of compelling live programming, including breaking news, interviews, special events, community programming, and other original content. Establish rapid-response workflows and production capabilities to quickly activate live coverage around breaking news and high-priority stories. Ensure content is editorially sound, culturally relevant, visually engaging, and tailored to Latino audiences across the U.S. Build relationships with journalists, newsmakers, creators, and other talent to develop compelling programming and expand audience reach. Audience Growth & Platform Optimization Develop strategies to increase discoverability, viewer retention, engagement, and audience growth across platforms. Optimize titles, descriptions, thumbnails, SEO, metadata, calls-to-action, and other platform-specific elements to maximize performance. Incorporate cross-promotion within live streams through slates, lower-thirds, and calls-to-action that drive audiences to other Local Media content, digital products, and platforms. Establish and maintain community engagement and moderation standards that foster safe, inclusive, and active live audiences. Performance, Analytics & Monetization Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including concurrent viewers, watch time, engagement, audience growth, and monetization. Use performance data and audience insights to make programming decisions and continuously improve content strategy. Partner with video and social teams to maximize the value of live content by repurposing streams into short-form clips, reels, and long-form VOD content. Identify opportunities to increase revenue and monetization through programming, audience growth, partnerships, and platform capabilities. YOU HAVE: Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in digital video, live streaming, social media, digital programming, or multimedia content production. Strong knowledge of YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and other emerging video platforms, including platform-specific best practices. Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, SEO, algorithms, and social engagement strategies. Experience developing and managing a programming calendar or content grid across multiple platforms. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news or media environment, including rapid-response coverage. Strong editorial judgment with the ability to identify compelling, culturally relevant content for Latino audiences. Experience using audience analytics and performance data to make programming and content decisions, including KPIs such as watch time, concurrent viewers, engagement, and audience growth. Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and productions simultaneously. Bilingual English/Spanish preferred, with strong understanding of U.S. Hispanic/Latino audiences and cultural trends. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position. job.description: ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: The Multimedia Producer is responsible for administering the development and production of promotional content for news and commercials including TV, radio, digital, print, local live broadcast events, and execution of station event activations. This is a hands-on position that requires the ability to work with clients and internal departments on the creative execution of all campaigns and assign projects to a team of producers, editors and on-air talent. This position requires the ability to write scripts, do camera work in studio and on field, edit video and audio, and manipulate design and motion graphics. Candidates need to be well versed in conceptualization, storytelling and able to maximize usage of multimedia resources. Applicants should be able to take a project from start to finish under minimal supervision, be social media savvy and have knowledge of content production for linear, online and digital outlets. Applicants should be able to execute operational needs for Activations, Promotions, Production, and Special Events reporting to the Director Operations. This role involves shooting and editing commercials for clients and coaching them during the production process to ensure the best on-camera performance and visual storytelling. The Multimedia Producer collaborates with the sales team to understand client visions and develop engaging multimedia solutions that drive results. Most importantly, the perfect candidate should have good attitude, be sociable, organized, motivated, be proactive and work well in a fast-paced deadline driven environment. Work closely with the sales team to understand clients' vision and come up with a great concept. Coach clients during the shooting of commercials to enhance their confidence and on-camera presence. Guide clients through the commercial production process, helping them deliver their message effectively. Oversee station events and special executions of local campaigns looking to maximize the promotional and executional impact by utilizing all operational resources. Performs other tasks as directed. This role combines exceptional on-air performance with digital content creation across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, social media, and live events. The ideal candidate is a storyteller, influencer, and content creator who understands how audiences consume media and can develop compelling, platform-first content that grows engagement and extends the station's brand beyond traditional radio. ABOUT YOU: You are an energetic, interactive, and social media savvy media personality who understands that today's talent represents the station both on and off the air. You are equally comfortable entertaining listeners on the radio, engaging audiences on social media, creating digital first content, and helping shape the sound and strategy of a growing multimedia brand. You embrace emerging technologies and understand how to build meaningful audience connections across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, websites, mobile apps, video platforms, and social media. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: Create engaging, audience-focused content across broadcast, digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media. Build authentic audience relationships through compelling storytelling, creativity, and consistent brand representation. Leverage audience insights, analytics, and emerging trends to optimize content performance and audience growth. job.title: Sales Operations Analyst
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our properties, which span digital, streaming, social, audio, linear and live events. We’re growing our offerings, building on the recent launch of our successful streaming platform, ViX. We were the fastest growing major media company in the U.S. The Sales Operations Analyst supports the management, analysis, and optimization of linear advertising inventory across the portfolio. Working closely with Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, and other internal partners, the Analyst helps ensure inventory is accurately maintained, effectively utilized, and aligned with revenue and client-delivery objectives. The role combines day-to-day inventory management with analytical problem solving and will increasingly leverage AI, automation, and data-driven tools to identify inventory risks, recommend actions, and improve yield. ABOUT YOU The successful Sales Operations Analyst will move beyond simply reporting on inventory conditions to understanding why they exist and recommend what the business should do about them. Over time, as reporting and transactional work become increasingly automated, the role will place greater emphasis on analysis, exception management, validation of AI-generated recommendations, and improving inventory utilization and yield. You are an Excel rock star, who enjoys analyzing numbers and data to provide insights into our sales organization. For you, every challenge is an opportunity to find a solution. YOUR DAY TO DAY Monitor inventory availability, capacity, sellout levels, and utilization across networks, dayparts, programs, and high-profile events. Identify inventory risks and opportunities and recommend actions to improve utilization, protect revenue, and support client delivery. Partner closely with Planning teams to ensure proposals, allocations, stewardship decisions, and inventory changes reflect current availability and business priorities. Support management of oversold inventory, preemptions, underdelivery, liability, and other inventory exceptions. Analyze supply and demand trends and provide actionable recommendations to Planning and Sales leadership. Maintain and validate inventory-related data, including capacities, format grids, ratecards, program information, and other inputs used in planning and inventory systems. Support inventory requirements for tentpoles, live sports, and other high-profile programming. Partner with Programming, Traffic, Planning, and Sales Operations to resolve inventory issues and execute approved changes. Use WideOrbit and related systems to manage inventory and support transactional workflows. Leverage reporting, analytics, AI, and automation tools to improve inventory decision-making and reduce manual processes. Review and validate AI-generated inventory recommendations as new optimization capabilities are introduced. Help define business rules and identify exceptions that should inform future automated inventory workflows. Develop a strong understanding of inventory economics and the relationship between pricing, demand, capacity, client commitments, and yield. Document processes and contribute to consistent inventory operating procedures and team knowledge. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects as needed. YOU HAVE Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in media, advertising, sales operations, inventory, planning, analytics, or a related field preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Strong Excel skills; experience with reporting or data-visualization tools is preferred. Experience with WideOrbit or other advertising sales/traffic systems is a plus. Comfort working with data, emerging technology, AI, and automated workflows. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, Finance, and other functions. Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn both the commercial and technical aspects of inventory management. ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS Must be willing to work onsite from the NY office location Employment/education will be verified Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location: Base annual salary: 64,000 – 70,000 OUR BENEFITS TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We're investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. We continue to expand our global footprint through our flagship streaming platform, ViX. The Senior Software Engineer, Backend will join our Core Digital Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and evolving the backend services that power products used by millions of users across the U.S., Mexico, Spain, and Latin America. The Senior Software Engineer will design and develop highly scalable distributed systems, resilient microservices, and cloud-native applications that support one of the largest Spanish-language streaming platforms in the world. Working closely with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), QA, Security, and fellow engineering teams, this role will help deliver reliable, high-performance backend systems while contributing to the evolution of our engineering standards and platform architecture. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, building software at internet scale, and continuously improving platform performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. ABOUT YOU: You are passionate about building software the right way. You believe maintainable code, scalable architectures, automation, and engineering excellence are essential to delivering world-class digital products. You enjoy diving deep into technical challenges, understanding systems end-to-end, and designing backend services that remain reliable as traffic, complexity, and business demands continue to grow. You naturally raise the engineering bar through thoughtful technical design, high-quality code reviews, mentorship, and continuous learning. You thrive in collaborative environments where ownership, innovation, and engineering excellence are highly valued. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (Responsibilities) Design, build, and maintain highly scalable backend services and microservices supporting TelevisaUnivision's digital products. Develop secure, resilient, and high-performance RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services consumed by millions of users. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code using modern software engineering practices, including unit, integration, and performance testing. Design distributed systems capable of supporting high traffic, low latency, and high availability. Optimize application performance across services, databases, caching layers, messaging systems, and cloud infrastructure. Participate in architecture reviews and influence technical decisions for new products, platform enhancements, and modernization initiatives. Take ownership of backend services throughout their lifecycle, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement. Serve as a technical leader on complex engineering initiatives by helping guide architectural decisions, establishing engineering best practices, and influencing technical direction across the team. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, DevOps, QA, Security, and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Perform thoughtful code reviews while mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices across the organization. Improve platform observability through centralized logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, and performance metrics. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and continuous delivery initiatives that improve software quality and release velocity. Drive technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and adoption of modern backend engineering practices. Participate in production support, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements. Influence engineering decisions through data-driven problem solving, technical expertise, and collaborative partnership across teams. YOU HAVE: (Qualifications, Experience) 6+ years of professional experience building backend applications in production environments. Strong experience designing distributed systems and scalable service-oriented architectures. Expert-level proficiency in at least one modern backend programming language such as Go, Java, Python, C#, or a comparable language. Extensive experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services. Strong understanding of software architecture principles, including SOLID, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and common design patterns. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with caching technologies such as Redis or Memcached. Experience with asynchronous messaging and event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub, or similar technologies. Experience deploying and operating services within cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS. Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native application development. Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. Familiarity with observability tools including centralized logging, monitoring, metrics, and distributed tracing. Strong understanding of backend security best practices, including authentication, authorization, API security, and secrets management. Experience working within Agile software development environments. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from design through production while balancing scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Excellent analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Advanced English proficiency. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience supporting products serving millions of daily active users. Experience building highly available, low-latency backend platforms operating at internet scale. Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar). Experience optimizing cloud infrastructure for scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency. Experience contributing to backend platform modernization, cloud migration, or large-scale architectural transformation initiatives. Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership across multiple engineering initiatives. Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, production operations, and operational excellence. Experience working with AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude Code, or similar) to improve engineering productivity and software quality. Experience working within globally distributed engineering organizations across multiple time zones. Experience within streaming, media, entertainment, or large-scale consumer technology organizations. Eligibility Requirements Employment and education verification required Must be authorized to work full-time in Mexico Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Art Director
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

Job Description

The New York Times Advertising is hiring for an Art Director to join our T Brand Studio. As an Art Director, you will lead the visual execution of assigned projects. Art Directors do the following: they imagine ways to tell stories visually. They present visual ideas and recommendations internally and to our clients. They find visual reference, specifically relevant to each idea, project, and opportunity. They contribute to and oversee the creation of great mood boards, inspired type treatments, exceptional color palettes, and page layouts.

About the Role

You will oversee the design of presentations which enhance our work, the assembly of excellent paid posts in webflow, the design of impactful print ads, and work with developers internal and external on complex custom projects. You will mentor Designers and Senior Designers, and collaborate with external partners, building relationships and guiding them through insightful feedback to create their best work. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Design. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to and oversee excellent design work on client and internal projects, with guidance from Design Directors, and Creative Directors.
  • Translate conceptual and strategic ideas into impactful visual solutions.
  • Contribute creative concepts to client and internal projects, brainstorming with other teams.
  • Design iteratively with an easy command of typography, composition, messaging hierarchy, layout, and other fundamental principles of graphic design, and give pointed feedback to designers which directly improves their work.
  • Research and oversee selection of visual reference that inspires (Design, Page Animation, Illustration, and Photography), and build a mental reference library of styles, approaches, creators, and projects.
  • Manage Designers, delegate work to resourced Designers and Senior Designers based on workload, capabilities, and experience. Contribute to the professional growth of direct reports through mentorship, and feedback.
  • Select, brief, and direct outside collaborators to create their best work.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional work experience in the art industry
  • 5+ years of experience with Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma) and modern digital publishing platforms such as Webflow.

You will bring advanced editorial design experience, strong project management skills to support daily deadline pressure, a deep passion for journalism, and a portfolio demonstrating versatile, high-impact narrative storytelling.

job.title: Assistant Editor, Fine Arts
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times Culture desk covers the arts and culture to help people understand the world. Through our reporting, criticism and service journalism, we provide trusted guidance to help people live fuller, more considered lives.

We are seeking an Assistant Editor, Fine Arts to help shape and elevate our coverage of visual art, architecture and design; museums and other art institutions; and auctions, with an eye toward ambitious, distinctive journalism that reaches a broad, curious audience. You should have expertise that will produce stories that lead readers into the boardrooms and the studios of today's cultural influencers and will also develop stories about the intersection of art and new media, including artificial intelligence.

You will work closely with the art discipline editor, critics and reporters to determine coverage, assign, edit and second edit news, features, reviews and visual story forms.

You'll also manage a critic and assign and oversee the work of freelancers. You should have a deep understanding of fine arts and art institutions, strong editing skills across formats and platforms and a track record of guiding world-class journalism.

This is a hybrid position, based in New York City, and includes regular attendance in the office at least four days each week.

Responsibilities:

  • Help identify and prioritize key fine-arts storylines, from breaking news to longer-term investigations, profiles and criticism that illuminate how the arts intersect with politics, power and the broader culture
  • Assign, shape and edit daily art stories, including news, features, criticism, service pieces, visual pieces and enterprise projects
  • Assign and edit news of institutions, including museums, art galleries, auction houses and non-profits, throughout the U.S. and Europe
  • Respond to news events in the art world by assigning and editing timely stories, explainers and off-the-news pieces that give readers essential context and insight
  • Plan and assign advance obituary coverage of notables in art
  • Coordinate with our European cultural editor on coverage of major events including biennales and museum openings
  • Manage and direct the work of at least one critic
  • Assign, schedule and edit freelance reviews for Weekend Arts, including the weekly Galleries section
  • Identify and shape features and profiles for the weekly Arts & Leisure page
  • Collaborate with photo, design, visual and video editors on stories across a variety of formats
  • Help foster a collaborative, inclusive culture on the desk, modeling clear communication, constructive feedback and high editorial standards
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • You will report to the Art Editor

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7–10 years of editing experience, ideally as an editor in a newsroom
  • Knowledge of and curiosity about visual art
  • A track record of editing a variety of story forms and formats
  • Ability to meet deadlines, juggle multiple stories at once and make sound editorial decisions under pressure
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to manage complex workflows and coordinate across multiple teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supervising or mentoring journalists, including guiding reporters from pitch through publication
  • Experience working closely with visual, audio and video teams on digital storytelling, and a willingness to experiment with new formats
  • Familiarity with Times style, standards and journalistic independence, and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • A demonstrated ability to collaborate across desks and disciplines, building strong working relationships in a large, complex newsroom
  • A passion for expanding the audience for arts coverage and making our journalism accessible, surprising and indispensable to a global readership
