job.title: Account Lead
job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. How we LEAD: Virgin Music is looking for a superstar Account Lead/Manager to join our industry-leading Commercial Marketing team. This role will build go-to-market commercial release plans, identify and execute innovative commercial opportunities, and develop creative release strategies while nurturing key relationships with our commercial accounts, artists, and label partners. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience building, optimizing, and managing YouTube channels on behalf of artists , with a deep understanding of the platform’s underlying mechanics. They are fluent in YouTube’s ecosystem—from content strategy and audience development to monetization and discovery levers—and know how to leverage the full suite of YouTube tools to grow artist presence, engagement, and global reach. This individual will also possess exceptional relationship management skills, be proactive and results-oriented, and demonstrate strong strategic and analytical thinking. They must thrive in a fast-paced environment and serve as a passionate advocate for Virgin’s artists and label partners. How you'll CREATE: Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with DSPs and streaming partners while also serving as a key YouTube platform expert—driving storytelling, content strategy, and audience growth initiatives. Collaborate with playlist/genre leads and platform representatives by utilizing cultural insight, marketing strategy, and data to deliver against targets. Support asset collection, optimize content delivery, and manage pitch administration. Attend regular meetings and maintain in-person relationships with partners. Partner Account Manager: Represent Virgin Music Group repertoire as the Account Lead across various commercial accounts, including YouTube as a core strategic platform . Maintain a deep, working knowledge of best practices, tools (e.g., YouTube Studio, Content ID, Official Artist Channels), and opportunities across accounts. Lead release strategies, long-lead planning, and campaigns while pitching and securing opportunities that drive visibility and discovery for artists. Label Relations: Work directly with Virgin Music Group labels to identify opportunities across release schedules, including YouTube-first or YouTube-enhanced strategies (premieres, Shorts, live content, catalog optimization). Educate teams on platform best practices and ensure alignment on KPIs, reporting, and performance tracking. Streaming and Commercial Marketing Strategy: Create dynamic release plans that integrate YouTube as a central discovery and fan engagement engine , leveraging content formats, release timing, and platform features to maximize impact. YouTube Channel Strategy & Optimization: Lead the development and ongoing management of artist YouTube channels, including channel optimization, content programming, metadata strategy, release cadence, audience segmentation, and growth tactics . Utilize YouTube analytics and insights to inform strategy, improve performance, and drive subscriber and viewership growth. Data Analysis: Provide daily and in-depth analysis across platforms, with a strong emphasis on YouTube performance metrics (audience retention, CTR, watch time, traffic sources, etc.), translating insights into actionable recommendations. Label Meetings: Communicate release performance and strategic recommendations, including YouTube-specific insights and optimization opportunities , while building forward-looking plans. Digital Marketing Strategy: Partner with label digital teams to ensure campaigns are innovative and platform-native, with a strong emphasis on video strategy, fan engagement, and discovery through YouTube and emerging formats (e.g., Shorts) . Experience with application security testing technologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and penetration testing methodologies. Experience working with modern application architectures, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies. Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows. Experience working within AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments. Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization technologies including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and JWT. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. How we LEAD: Universal Music Group is seeking a Campaign Manager to execute and optimize always-on paid media for IGA’s frontline D2C roster. This role will report into the Global Media Team but will be deeply embedded into IGA’s operations and based out of our Santa Monica offices. This is a permanent, full-time position working in a cross-functional team of D2C & digital marketing experts. You’ll split your time across media planning, execution, optimization, and reporting, working collaboratively to refine campaign performance. We are seeking a highly motivated and organized individual who excels in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of all digital advertising channels, including paid search, social, programmatic, display, video, mobile, as well as emerging media and new technology platforms. They’re experienced in building full-funnel campaigns, with a strong focus on performance marketing, and can communicate strategy effectively and simply. This hands-on role requires someone who thrives on managing multiple workstreams and communications simultaneously, paying close attention to detail in campaign management, optimization, and analytics, and is driven by measurable results. How you’ll CREATE: Execute and optimize full funnel, always on paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic, and other performance channels. Collaborate with the Performance Marketing Lead & Director of Advertising Strategy to plan and launch campaigns that align with the label’s D2C calendar and business priorities. Manage day-to-day campaign operations, including audience targeting, trafficking, pacing, and budget optimization. Analyze campaign performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights and optimization recommendations for improvement Identify target audiences and analyze their characteristics, behaviors, and media habits. Experience with a customer data platform is considered an asset. Implement A/B testing for creative, ad copy, audience strategies, and report findings in a clear/concise manner Experience building ad reports for various levels of the business, including senior executive stakeholders Work collaboratively with a team for more complex and large-scale campaigns when needed ​​Understand pixel implementation on websites for data collection and conversion tracking and help build new infrastructure that ties into audience measurement. Bring your VIBE: Bachelor's degree, preferably with a concentration in advertising, marketing, business administration, or communications preferred 1+ year of experience in paid media with an emphasis on social platforms, including full ownership, ranging from strategy to execution Experience with media planning and buying through Meta, Google AdWords, TikTok, X, Snapchat, and other DSPs Understanding of Google Merchant Center, Google Tag Manager, Facebook Catalog Manager, TikTok Catalog Manager, and Shopify Experience with DoubleClick, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Linkfire, Big Query, Datorama, DOMO, etc. Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for insights and action Must have a 'can do' attitude with an entrepreneurial mindset and be comfortable working in a dynamic, unstructured environment on complex projects Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment Passionate music fan with insight into different music fandoms, how fans engage/interact online, CRM tactics, audience building/lead-gen strategy – all a huge plus. Perks Playlist: Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. job.title: Director, Catalog Digital Marketing Urban
job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. This leader will partner closely with the Department Head and all departments within IGA (A&R, Revenue, Creative, Digital, PR, Radio) to build and execute fully integrated, progressive, and culturally fluent marketing strategies that resonate with both legacy audiences and the next generation of fans. The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of music history, especially Hip-Hop and R&B, paired with a strategic, forward-thinking marketing mind, strong cultural awareness, trend fluency, and the maturity to bridge legacy artistry with modern audience behavior. This person blends creative instinct, data-driven thinking, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration—always keeping artist brand integrity, fan experience, and long-term impact at the center. How You’ll CREATE Urban + Multi-Genre Catalog Strategy Develop and execute innovative catalog marketing strategies for Urban (Hip-Hop/R&B) artists while applying equal expertise across all genres. Identify opportunities to pull forward catalog moments that resonate with today’s youth—balancing cultural nostalgia with modern relevance. Build long-tail strategies that strengthen artist legacy while tapping into emerging discovery behavior, cultural moments, and platform trends. Creative Ideation & Cultural Fluency Bring strong creative instincts and a modern marketing mindset—someone who sees possibilities, not limitations. Develop big ideas, tentpole moments, viral concepts, and culturally relevant activations that stretch across platforms and audience groups. Ensure ideas honor the artist’s legacy while making them meaningful and exciting for new generations. Trend Awareness & Viral Opportunities Stay deeply connected to cultural trends—especially TikTok, social audio moments, memes, and youth-driven behavior. Recognize viral patterns early and develop strategies to enhance, accelerate, or originate viral catalog moments. Bring forward new ideas using remixes, edits, challenges, influencers, and micro-moments that leverage platform algorithms. Research, Data, and Insights Integration Tap into all research and data sources—internal insights, data analytics, consumer behavior, streaming patterns, social sentiment, and cultural research. Use data to validate opportunities, uncover blind spots, and inform go-forward strategy. Ensure the team utilizes internal tools, processes, and cross-functional expertise to maximize performance and efficiency. Frontline + Catalog Alignment Understand frontline release cycles and how they influence catalog moments. Work across current genres and frontline teams to ensure that catalog strategy complements and enhances artist development across the roster. Seamlessly bridge catalog and frontline marketing—ensuring holistic, year-round artist narratives. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Catalog and Core Label teams including Marketing, A&R, Digital, Creative, International, Commercial, Revenue, and Artist Management to support priority Urban and multi-genre catalog projects. Maintain proactive, clear communication with all stakeholders—deadlines must be met, and alignment must be constant across all moving parts. Serve as a key partner to Artist Management, ensuring that campaigns support artist brand integrity and long-term vision. Execution, Analysis & Optimization Guide and oversee the creation of all marketing materials and original content for campaigns. Regularly interface with artists and management to ensure alignment on all aspects of release plans and catalog marketing strategy. Analyze streaming, sales, radio, and social performance to adjust strategies in real time. Use audience insights to optimize rollouts, messaging, formats, and content across channels. This role combines catalog expertise, marketing strategy, project management, and business development. job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. Job Summary We are currently seeking an Identity & Access Management Engineer with specialization in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) to join UMG’s global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the VP, Tech Security & Identity, this is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise IGA capabilities across a complex, global environment. This engineer will play a critical role in governing digital identities, access entitlements, and lifecycle processes for employees, contractors, and non-employee populations. The role emphasizes strong engineering execution, automation, and operational discipline, partnering closely with security, HR, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure access is provisioned appropriately, reviewed regularly, and removed in a timely manner. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with modern IGA platforms, strong understanding of access governance controls, and the ability to operate at scale in a regulated enterprise. Job Functions Design, engineer, deploy, and operate Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the enterprise. Implement and manage identity lifecycle processes including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows for employees and non-employee identities. Engineer and maintain access request, approval, and provisioning workflows integrated with HR systems, directories, and enterprise applications. Design and operate access governance controls including role models, entitlement catalogs, access certifications, and periodic access reviews. Partner with application owners and platform teams to onboard applications into IGA and remediate access governance gaps. Develop and maintain automation and integrations for IGA workflows using scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g., PowerShell, Python). Support segregation of duties (SoD) controls, access policy enforcement, and audit readiness activities. Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity lifecycle, provisioning, and access-related issues across integrated systems. Collaborate with Security, HR, Compliance, and Infrastructure teams to ensure identity governance controls align with security policies and regulatory requirements. Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks to support scalable and repeatable IGA operations. Continuously identify opportunities to improve access governance maturity, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation and platform enhancements. Job Requirements Essential Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management or Security Engineering roles, with a strong focus on Identity Governance & Administration. Demonstrated experience implementing and operating enterprise IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent). Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, role-based access control (RBAC), and entitlement governance. Hands-on experience designing and supporting access certification campaigns and remediation processes. Experience integrating IGA solutions with HR systems, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise applications. Proficiency in scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments (Azure and/or AWS) with IAM integrations. Ability to independently own complex technical deliverables while collaborating effectively within a global organization. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Desirable Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience with advanced IGA capabilities such as role mining, access analytics, or policy-based provisioning. Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, or similar. Professional certifications such as Saviynt Certified Professional, SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, Security+, or CISSP. Experience operating IAM or identity governance platforms within a large, global, or highly regulated enterprise environment. Managing Pop/Rock and Urban catalogs requires an understanding that creator strategies differ by genre—from storytelling style and platform behavior to cultural context and creator communities—while still laddering up to a cohesive catalog vision. Apply genre-aware thinking when recommending creators, formats, and platforms—recognizing that Pop/Rock and Urban audiences engage with content differently. Recommend creators for key territories when campaigns require international amplification. Support initiatives tied to anniversaries, classic albums, reissues, remasters, box sets, archival releases, and cultural milestones. Campaign Development & Execution Manage creator sourcing, outreach, briefings, deliverable tracking, approvals, and ongoing communication. Maintain clear, professional communication between creators, internal teams, artist partners, and estates. Activate creator content around key release moments, platform trends, cultural conversations, and genre-specific cycles. Ensure all creator output aligns with campaign objectives, artist legacy, and broader catalog strategy. Insights, Data & Optimization Use platform analytics, cultural trends, and genre knowledge to identify creators who feel authentic to each campaign. Track creator performance across platforms and compile insights for internal teams. Identify opportunities to scale high-performing content or optimize underperforming activations. Incorporate cross-market insights when evaluating creator effectiveness and reach. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Catalog and Core label teams across Marketing, Digital, Creative, A&R Research, Production, Revenue, and Commercial to support catalog priorities. Support integration of Capitol Records’ broader creator and content networks across Pop/Rock and Urban initiatives. Ensure creator content reinforces artist brand, campaign narrative, and long-term catalog positioning. Stay aligned with Digital Marketing leadership to ensure execution reflects overall strategy and priorities. job.title: Manager, eCommerce Marketing
job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more. How we LEAD: Merchandise and commerce are part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent. The Manager, Site Marketing turns traffic, campaign demand, product priorities, and artist moments into high-impact storefront strategies that drive conversion, sell-through, fan engagement, and revenue growth. This role owns the non-creative site strategy across merchandising, product placement, promotional planning, campaign destinations, homepage, and collection strategy, PDP optimization, key shopping moments, and alignment with CRM, paid media, and other acquisition channels. Core responsibilities of this role include: Lead on-site marketing programming across the sites, including promotions, to achieve store revenue and conversion goals. Optimize fan journeys from traffic source to product discovery, storytelling, offer, and purchase. Align cross-channel execution with paid media, email, CRM, social, label, and artist teams. Merchandise and prioritize products, collections, campaigns, and offers on the storefront to drive engagement, conversion, and revenue. Identify opportunities to improve site performance through testing, merchandising adjustments, landing page optimization, offer strategy, and improved shopping paths. Translate artist priorities, label needs, inventory considerations, product performance, and commercial goals into an actionable site plan. This role requires a strategic, commercially minded, highly collaborative manager who can balance long-term planning with fast-moving priorities. The ideal candidate understands how fans shop, how campaigns translate across ecommerce storefronts, and how product performance should inform merchandising, promotional, and customer journey decisions. They should be comfortable leading workstreams, making clear recommendations, building alignment across cross-functional partners, and bringing structure, judgment, and momentum to a high-volume environment. How you'll CREATE: Site Marketing Strategy & Commercial Planning Own site marketing strategy for a portfolio of artist stores, ensuring storefront activity aligns to commercial priorities, artist moments, fan demand, and revenue goals. Build and manage site marketing calendars that coordinate releases, product drops, promotions, tour moments, seasonal opportunities, CRM pushes, paid media campaigns, and evergreen selling periods. Prioritize the highest-value opportunities across stores and campaigns, balancing business impact, artist priorities, product performance, traffic drivers, and operational feasibility. Translate campaign demand, product priorities, and artist moments into clear storefront plans that define what should show up, where it should appear, when it should launch, and how it should support conversion. Lead planning conversations with cross-functional partners to ensure site strategy is proactive, commercially grounded, and clearly connected to broader marketing and revenue goals. On-Site Campaigns, Promotions & Merchandising Lead planning and execution of on-site marketing campaigns that support new releases, product launches, catalog moments, artist exclusives, preorders, restocks, tour activity, limited-edition drops, and seasonal moments. Own merchandising recommendations across homepages, collections, product pages, campaign destinations, navigation paths, cart moments, and other key storefront placements. Determine how products, collections, campaigns, and offers are surfaced, sequenced, and prioritized to improve product discovery, fan engagement, conversion, average order value, and sell-through. Develop promotional strategies across sitewide and artist-specific moments, including offer placement, messaging, landing page strategy, timing, and coordination with CRM, paid media, and other marketing channels. Use proven ecommerce levers such as discounts, bundles, free shipping, gift-with-purchase, exclusives, presale access, urgency messaging, and limited-time moments to support demand capture and conversion. Ensure storefront plans reflect artist brand, campaign strategy, customer needs, and commercial opportunity while making it easy for fans to discover and purchase priority products. Fan Journey & Storefront Optimization Shape customer journeys from traffic source to product discovery, storytelling, offer, purchase, and repeat engagement. Develop landing page and campaign destination strategies, including product hierarchy, content flow, collection logic, module placement, CTA strategy, and shopping paths. Identify opportunities to improve site flow, content clarity, product visibility, merchandising logic, and conversion paths across priority stores and campaigns. Partner with CRM, paid media, and label marketing teams to ensure traffic-driving efforts connect to the right site destinations, messaging, products, and commercial priorities. Recommend updates before, during, and after key campaigns based on fan behavior, business performance, and real-time opportunities. Performance, Insights & Optimization Monitor store, campaign, product, and customer journey performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, sell-through, average order value, engagement, and revenue. Partner with Insights and other Commercial teams to understand product trends, inventory opportunities, pricing sensitivity, conversion behavior, and underperforming SKUs. Translate performance insights into actionable site marketing recommendations, including merchandising updates, campaign pivots, promotional tests, product recirculation, landing page adjustments, and shopping path improvements. Develop clear readouts and next-step recommendations that connect site performance to commercial outcomes. Support testing opportunities across promotional mechanics, merchandising approaches, landing page structures, product sequencing, content placement, and conversion paths. Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment Act as a strategic connector across Commercial, CRM, Paid Media, Creative, Product Performance, Analytics, Operations, labels, artist teams, and storefront/site partners. Ensure campaigns are aligned across site strategy, traffic-driving channels, product priorities, promotional timing, creative needs, messaging, and business goals. Lead cross-functional planning conversations, bringing clarity to priorities, timelines, dependencies, owners, and next steps. Proactively surface risks, blockers, tradeoffs, and opportunities, while helping teams move toward practical, commercially sound decisions. Build trust with partners by communicating clearly, following through consistently, and balancing strategic thinking with operational discipline. Manager-Level Ownership & Judgement Bring structure, prioritization, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment with multiple stores, campaigns, stakeholders, and competing priorities. Make informed recommendations with confidence, using commercial context, customer behavior, product performance, and business goals to guide decisions. Exercise strong judgment when balancing artist needs, revenue opportunities, customer clarity, operational realities, and timing considerations. Build alignment with cross-functional partners, using clear rationale, data, and strong relationship-building. Anticipate needs before they become blockers and help create a more proactive, strategic, and performance-focused site marketing function. Operate with ownership, accountability, curiosity, and a solutions-oriented mindset, while remaining adaptable as priorities evolve. Bring your VIBE: 5+ years of experience in site/D2C marketing, ecommerce, digital marketing, site merchandising, campaign marketing, promotional strategy, or a related field. Strong understanding of ecommerce strategy, storefront merchandising, promotional planning, customer journeys, conversion optimization, and performance-driven growth. Proven ability to translate commercial priorities, campaign goals, product performance, and customer behavior into clear site marketing strategies and actionable plans. Experience managing multiple campaigns, calendars, launches, priorities, and stakeholders in a fast-moving ecommerce or digital environment. Comfortable using performance data to identify insights, make recommendations, influence decisions, and optimize campaigns before, during, and after launch. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex inputs into clear briefs, recaps, recommendations, and next steps. Excellent judgment and prioritization skills, especially when balancing artist needs, revenue opportunities, customer clarity, operational constraints, and competing deadlines. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and accountable, with strong follow-through and the ability to keep workstreams moving without constant direction. Confident leading cross-functional conversations, aligning stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities, timing, dependencies, and ownership. Strong relationship-builder who can earn trust across teams, influence without authority, and bring partners along through clear rationale and collaborative problem-solving. Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to anticipate risks, surface tradeoffs, and recommend practical paths forward. Curious about fan behavior, artist culture, digital commerce, and how storefronts can deepen the fan-to-artist connection while driving measurable business results. Strong instincts as an online shopper and a clear point of view on what makes a storefront compelling, easy to shop, and commercially effective. Balanced leadership style with confidence, humility, adaptability, and a no-ego approach to collaboration. Familiarity with email/CRM, paid media, social commerce, affiliate, or other acquisition channels. Experience with site merchandising, CMS tools, landing page strategy, PDP optimization, cart strategy, or frontend QA. A plus, but not required: Experience in music, entertainment, fashion, streetwear, consumer products, artist merchandising, or fan commerce. Experience with Shopify or similar ecommerce platforms. Understanding of UX principles, consumer behavior, analytics, A/B testing, or conversion rate optimization. Project management experience or experience leading complex workstreams across multiple teams. job.title: Senior Coordinator, Content Strategy
job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more. How we LEAD: Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent. At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists with fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. From artist storefronts and ecommerce experiences to campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement programs, the Design & Direction team is responsible for defining the creative vision that brings artist brands to life across every digital touchpoint. The Creative Direction team establishes the creative frameworks, visual identities, and experience principles that guide how work is conceived, developed, and executed. Working closely with Design, Content Production, Development, Project Management, and Client teams, we ensure every experience balances artistic expression, audience engagement, and business performance. Role Overview The Senior Coordinator, Content Strategy is responsible for the planning, governance, and execution of content placement across UMG's eCommerce experiences. Working closely with Creative, Merchandising, Content Production, Development, and Project Management teams, this role owns the creation and oversight of eCommerce placement plans, ensuring every product is accurately represented from planning through launch. Serving as the central source of truth for product assets and placement requirements, this role is responsible for maintaining the integrity of content across our eCommerce storefronts. Through rigorous quality control, they ensure all products, imagery, copy, and associated assets align with approved placement plans prior to photography and publication, helping deliver a consistent and high-quality customer experience. The Senior Coordinator plays a critical role in connecting cross-functional teams, maintaining visibility across content readiness, and ensuring assets, documentation, and placement standards remain accurate, organized, and accessible throughout the campaign lifecycle. They proactively identify content gaps, resolve discrepancies, and drive operational consistency to support successful product launches. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about eCommerce operations, digital merchandising, and content excellence. They thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy building structure through process, and take pride in ensuring every customer-facing experience is executed with accuracy and consistency. How You'll CREATE: eCommerce Content Strategy & Placement Own the creation, maintenance, and execution of eCommerce placement plans across artist and label storefronts. Develop merchandising placement strategies that ensure products, collections, and campaigns are accurately represented across all digital storefronts. Partner with Creative, Merchandising, Client Services, and Production teams to align placement plans with campaign objectives and commercial priorities. Translate campaign requirements into clear content placement documentation that serves as the single source of truth for execution. Continuously review and optimize placement standards to improve consistency, customer experience, and operational efficiency. Content Quality Control & Asset Governance Lead quality control reviews of all products and associated assets against approved placement plans prior to photography and site publication. Validate that products, imagery, copy, collections, variants, and metadata are complete, accurate, and aligned to merchandising requirements. Identify and resolve content discrepancies before they impact downstream production or customer-facing experiences. Maintain ownership of content accuracy across eCommerce platforms, ensuring consistency across all artist storefronts. Act as the central source of truth for product assets, ensuring all approved creative and content is current, accessible, and properly version controlled. Content Operations & Coordination Coordinate content readiness across Creative, Production, Merchandising, Development, and Project Management teams. Manage content timelines, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure assets are available ahead of key campaign milestones. Support product launches by ensuring all required assets, approvals, and placement documentation are complete. Maintain content documentation, placement guides, and operational standards across multiple concurrent projects. Proactively identify risks, blockers, or gaps that may impact content readiness or launch timelines. Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the primary point of contact for content placement and asset management across cross-functional teams. Partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, Content Production, Client Services, and eCommerce Operations to ensure seamless execution. Facilitate communication around content changes, asset updates, and placement requirements throughout campaign lifecycles. Support continuous improvement of content workflows, documentation, and governance processes. Champion consistency and best practices across all eCommerce content operations. Bring Your VIBE: 3–5 years' experience in eCommerce, digital content, merchandising, content operations, or project coordination. Strong understanding of digital merchandising principles and online customer experiences. Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple launches, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Meticulous attention to detail and a passion for content accuracy and quality. Experience managing digital assets, product information, or content management systems. Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across creative, commercial, and technical teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Passion for music, eCommerce, digital retail, and fan experiences. Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities. A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for creating scalable processes and operational excellence. What Success Looks Like: eCommerce placement plans are accurate, complete, and delivered on time for every campaign. Products consistently pass quality control before photography and launch, minimizing downstream issues and rework. Asset libraries remain organized, accurate, and trusted as the single source of truth across the business. Cross-functional teams have clear visibility into placement plans, content status, and launch readiness. Product launches are executed with a high degree of accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency. Content governance standards continue to evolve, improving quality, scalability, and execution across all eCommerce experiences. At Digital Creative& Experience, we create content that connects artists with fans across every touchpoint of the digital experience. job.description: At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: Curiosity : We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. job.title: Director, Strategic Insights and Advertising Research
job.description: Director, Strategic Insights & Advertising Research Position Summary Allen Media Group is seeking an exceptional strategic thinker to join our National Advertising Sales organization as Director, Strategic Insights & Advertising Research . This highly visible role sits at the intersection of advertising sales, audience intelligence, measurement innovation, consumer insights, and marketplace strategy. This individual will partner closely with executive sales leadership to transform data into compelling stories that drive advertiser investment across Allen Media Group's expanding portfolio, including The Weather Channel, Local Now, HBCU GO, CBS Late Night programming, local television stations, digital platforms, and strategic partnerships. This is far more than a traditional research role. We're looking for a business strategist who combines analytical expertise with exceptional storytelling skills to influence sales strategy, shape marketplace positioning, and help define the future of advertising measurement. Key Responsibilities Develop compelling marketplace positioning that differentiates Allen Media Group and creates competitive advantage. Partner with Sales Leadership to support upfronts, scatter, new business, client pitches, and cross-platform advertising initiatives. Deliver proactive category, consumer, and advertiser insights that help advertising sales win new business and grow existing partnerships. Design and execute custom research, campaign effectiveness studies, and advertiser case studies that demonstrate measurable ROI. Lead and develop relationships with key measurement and research partners including Nielsen, VideoAmp, Comscore, MRI-Simmons, YouGov, and other emerging platforms. Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, consumer behavior, and evolving media measurement to keep our organization ahead of the marketplace. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Planning, Programming, Product, and Executive Leadership to develop data-driven revenue strategies. Create thought leadership presentations, white papers, and executive reports, and represent Allen Media Group's position within industry conferences and trade shows. Identify innovative research methodologies and emerging technologies, including AI-driven analytics, that enhance sales effectiveness and advertiser value. Qualifications 8-12+ years of experience in advertising sales research, audience insights, media analytics, or strategic planning within television, streaming, digital, or cross-platform media. Strong understanding of television, streaming, CTV, digital, social, and cross-platform measurement. Expertise with industry tools such as Nielsen, VideoAmp, MRI-Simmons, Comscore, and related syndicated research platforms. Demonstrated ability to transform complex data into persuasive, executive-level presentations and sales narratives. Experience managing custom research projects from concept through client presentation. Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, and data visualization platforms such as Tableau or Looker. Outstanding communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing multiple priorities. This position requires a minimum of three days a week in the NYC office. Willingness to travel. Bachelor degree required. Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States. Preferred Experience Experience with advanced advertising, attribution, audience targeting, campaign measurement, AI-enabled analytics, retail media, and cross-platform measurement solutions is highly desirable. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly collaborative, and passionate about media, advertising, consumer behavior, and innovation. You enjoy solving complex business challenges, influencing strategy through data, and presenting compelling stories that inspire clients and drive revenue. Why Allen Media Group? This is an opportunity to help shape the future of one of the nation's fastest-growing independent media companies. You'll work directly with executive leadership while influencing sales strategy, advertising measurement, and marketplace positioning across a rapidly expanding portfolio of premium television, streaming, digital, and local media brands.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description: Senior QA Automation Engineer Local Now | Remote (United States) About Local Now Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably. We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. The work is tangible: every improvement we make is felt by millions of viewers. The Role We are hiring a Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and scaling of our automated testing strategy as our LN 2.0 streaming platform launches and stays exceptional across every device family we ship on. You will work closely with our QA Manager and the engineering team to architect test frameworks, design test coverage, and drive end-to-end automation for a product where playback quality and ad reliability directly affect business outcomes. This is a senior individual-contributor role with high technical ownership. You will be the foundational automation lead in the new QA practice we are building, establishing the tools, standards, and pipelines that will scale with our platform. What You Will Do Architect, build, and scale maintainable test automation frameworks across mobile, connected TV (CTV) platforms, and web. Drive the test automation roadmap, establishing automation best practices, framework architecture, page-object models, and test data strategies. Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins) for continuous regression, deployment health checks, and release gating. Test video playback (live and VOD), ad insertion (client-side and server-side), and quality-of-experience (QoE) scenarios. Test and debug API/microservice integrations for data integrity, performance, and contract validation. Validate privacy and consent flows: CMP behavior, preference persistence, DSAR-affected paths, and PII boundaries. Report bugs with the rigor that engineers actually want to read — clean repro steps, environments, logs, and severity assessment. Partner with engineering leads on triage, regression coverage, architecture reviews, and quality metrics. Contribute to a device lab strategy and solve the practical realities of automating and testing across many CTV platforms. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of QA experience on consumer software, with at least 3 years leading automation efforts on multi-platform mobile and/or CTV products. Proven track record of architecting automated test frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, or CTV using modern tools (e.g., Playwright, Appium, Detox, XCUITest, Espresso, or Robot Framework). Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD test pipelines. Streaming video QA experience — playback, manifests, ad pods, DRM, QoE. Hands-on testing and automation familiarity on Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, Android TV, Tizen, or Vizio platforms. Strong analytical and bug-investigation skills; able to isolate environmental, timing, and platform-specific issues. Clear written communication; excellent at writing reproducible bug reports and concise automation docs and test plans. Self-directed technical leader who thrives in a remote, distributed engineering culture. Nice to Have Experience with consent / privacy testing or compliance-driven regression suites. Hands-on experience using AI tools like Cursor and Claude to accelerate test authoring, triage, and analysis. Experience setting up physical or cloud-based device farms (e.g., AWS Device Farm, Sauce Labs, HeadSpin) for automated CTV/mobile testing.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Privacy
job.description: Role Overview The Technical Product Manager (TPM) for Privacy will own the technical and product execution of the company's privacy program, translating the VP of Privacy's regulatory and governance requirements into concrete product requirements, system architecture, and engineering roadmaps with a primary focus on streaming, subscription, and ad-supported video services. This role is the technical bridge between the Legal/Privacy team and disparate Engineering teams. Product & Technical Execution Translate privacy, legal, and regulatory requirements into clear technical specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering teams. Own the cross-brand roadmap for privacy-by-design initiatives across multi-platform platforms, data warehouses, identity systems, and streaming applications. Partner directly with data engineering, ad tech, and product teams to embed privacy controls into system architecture, data flows, and consent infrastructure. Drive technical implementation of consent and preference management, cookie/SDK governance, and identity resolution controls across CTV/OTT, mobile, and web. Develop, own and manage the privacy testing automation suite product across engineering groups, ensuring uniformity across brands, platforms and delivery Direct OneTrust configuration and integration work from a technical standpoint Cross-Functional Delivery Serve as the primary technical point of contact between the Privacy/Legal team and Engineering, removing ambiguity in how policy requirements get built and shipped. Manage sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and delivery timelines for privacy engineering initiatives. Run technical reviews of new features and data flows in partnership with the VP of Privacy, flagging architecture-level risks before launch. Direct OneTrust configuration and integration work from a technical standpoint Streaming, Subscription & Adtech Own technical requirements for VPPA-compliant handling of viewing data and subscriber information across SVOD, AVOD, and hybrid models. Define and build technical solutions for ad targeting, attribution, personalization, and cross-device identity that satisfy state-law opt-out/consent requirements. Build and maintain technical controls for account hierarchies/households, content recommendations, and churn/retention analytics that meet privacy requirements. Manage opt-out mechanisms and sensitive-data restrictions within ad-supported streaming (AVOD/FAST) workflows. Metrics & Reporting Build and maintain technical KPIs/dashboards. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field required. 6+ years in technical product management, with 3+ years working on data privacy, data governance, or trust & safety initiatives ideally in digital media, streaming, or subscription businesses. Previous engineering or data engineering experience is preferred Hands-on experience translating legal/regulatory requirements into engineering specs and shipped product. Expert knowledge of OneTrust or comparable privacy management platforms; comfortable partnering on technical configuration, not just policy administration. Deep understanding of VPPA and U.S. state privacy laws (CA, CO, VA, etc.) as they apply to targeting, cross-context behavioral advertising, and data architecture. Experience working with data engineering teams on data mapping, identity systems, and consent infrastructure at scale. CIPT certification is a plus (not required). Equal Opportunity Allen Media Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. adversarial testing of application and AI systems Experience with policy-as-code, IaC scanning, container/image security, software supply-chain security, SBOMs, provenance, attestation, and secrets management Familiarity with cloud security across AWS and/or GCP and the application-layer implications of cloud-native architectures Experience in regulated, audit-sensitive, or event-critical environments where evidence, controls, and operational rigor matter Experience building metrics, dashboards, or reporting that show AppSec posture and remediation progress Experience mentoring Together, these brands and businesses produce hundreds of live events annually, serve partners across the globe, and reach hundreds of millions of fans worldwide. POSITION SUMMARY TKO is looking for a VP, Recruiting to lead talent acquisition for UFC, WWE, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), and Zuffa Boxing. Reporting to the SVP, Global Recruiting and based in Stamford, CT, this leader will manage a team of three recruiters, oversee strategic search as well as TKO’s early careers internship program. This is a role for someone who takes immense pride in their work, brings high standards, and earns a reputation as a trusted partner across the business. The VP, Recruiting will be just as comfortable building relationships on the floor of a live event as they are driving process and strategy from their desk. Presence and proximity to the businesses matter here. This person will be in Stamford 3–4 days per week, visit the NYC office frequently, and travel regularly to Las Vegas and Fort Worth to stay immersed in each business, know its leaders and employees, and maintain a pulse on the candidate market. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the team. Manage, develop, and inspire a team of three. Set high standards. Create an environment where the team does their best work, holds themselves accountable, and takes pride in the quality and consistency of what they deliver. Set recruiting strategy.
